TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_SEQ_00: Swift has an involved assignment for a veteran adventurer.
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_SEQ_01: High Commander Swift explains that the number of kidnappings perpetrated by the Amalj'aa is once again on the rise. Report to Commander Gisilbehrt, head of security in Little Ala Mhigo in southern Thanalan, and learn what must be done to stem this disturbing escalation in abductions.
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_SEQ_02: According to the briefing you received from Commander Gisilbehrt, the Amalj'aa in southern Thanalan have begun to strike out with ever greater frequency. Hurry to the site of a potential ambush, and prevent the beastmen from claiming yet another victim.
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_SEQ_03: The leader of a small band of Amalj'aa that foiled the kidnapping attempt of their kin has expressed an interest in making your acquaintance. Make your way to the Ring of Ash, and speak with Hamujj Gah.
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_SEQ_04: Hamujj Gah and his Brotherhood of Ash are soldiers that detest the cowardly actions of their fanatic brethren. Recognized for your part in bringing down the Lord of the Inferno, you have been invited to join in their efforts to restore the honor of a once-proud warrior tribe.
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_SEQ_00: Hamujj Gah, warleader of the Brotherhood of Ash, wishes to unleash you upon his craven brethren.
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_SEQ_01: The Flamefangs, a faction of the Zanr'ak Amalj'aa, are on the prowl for fresh victims. Lie in wait at the merchant's location in the Red Labyrinth, and foil the attack.
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_SEQ_02: You have defeated the Flamefang raiding party. Speak with the skittish salesman and see that he has not come to harm.
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_SEQ_03: The merchant thanks you for your timely assistance. Return to the Ring of Ash and speak with Loonh Gah.
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_SEQ_04: Loonh Gah appears to recognize your martial ability, but is still wary of your presence in the camp. Leave the Miqo'te to her mistrust, and report to Hamujj Gah with an account of the battle.
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_SEQ_05: Though you have rescued one traveling peddler from an unpleasant fate, the Flamefangs continue to target the weak and unwary. Deepen your ties with the Brotherhood of Ash, and assist them in opposing their fanatic kin.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_SEQ_00: Hamujj Gah wishes to hurl you into the heart of enemy territory, as he would a spear.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_SEQ_01: The warleader has received a report from Loonh Gah describing a vicious assault perpetrated by the Flamefangs upon a Forgotten Springs hunting party. Rendezvous with Loonh Gah to the southwest of the Ring of Ash, and rescue the surviving U tribe Miqo'te.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_SEQ_02:
Loonh Gah has devised a rescue plan that requires you to provide an explosive distraction. Mounted upon the Miqo'te warrior's cavalry drake, you are to use the creature's Fiery Breath to destroy the barrels of oil stockpiled about the Zanr'ak encampment.

※Speak with Loonh Gah southwest of the Ring of Ash to borrow her cavalry drake.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_SEQ_03: You have destroyed the barrels of oil in a series of spectacular explosions. Make good your escape from the encampment, and rendezvous with Loonh Gah to the southeast.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_SEQ_04: After charging you with seeing the rescued huntress safely home, Loonh Gah abruptly departs for the Ring of Ash. Speak with U'napa to offer her an escort.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_SEQ_05: It appears that U'napa has more to tell you about “U'loonh.” Speak with the huntress in the settlement of Forgotten Springs.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_SEQ_06: U'napa seems convinced that Loonh Gah is the U'loonh she once knew─a Miqo'te who used to dwell in Forgotten Springs. Speak with huntresses around the settlement, and piece together what you can of the Brotherhood warrior's past.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_SEQ_07: At your prompting, the rangers of Forgotten Springs reveal that U'loonh's tale is one of tragedy and loss. Return to the Ring of Ash and speak with Loonh Gah.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_SEQ_08: Loonh Gah brusquely explains her decision to become a Brotherhood warrior, and spurns any sympathy at the loss of her Miqo'te heritage. Seemingly unwilling to discuss the subject further, she orders you to make your report to Hamujj Gah.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_SEQ_09: Hamujj Gah praises your efforts in rescuing the Miqo'te huntress from a nightmarish fate at the hands of the Flamefangs. Restating the warrior creed of the Brotherhood of Ash, the warleader bids you join his soldiers in the traditional Amalj'aa pursuit of honorable strength.
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_SEQ_00: Hamujj Gah has a task for you that his Amalj'aa soldiers cannot accomplish.
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_SEQ_01: Hamujj Gah reveals that tempered spies have infiltrated the security of Little Ala Mhigo. With the Amalj'aa unable to approach the settlement without fear of igniting hostilities, it falls to you to broach the issue with Commander Gisilbehrt.
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_SEQ_02: While confirming Commander Gisilbehrt's suspicions concerning the security breach in the settlement, you are interrupted by reports of an Amalj'aa attack on a travelers' caravan. Head south of Little Ala Mhigo, and rendezvous with the undermanned squad deployed by the commander.
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_SEQ_03: One of the new flame recruits has revealed himself as a tempered spy. Accost the traitor, and learn what manner of scheme is afoot.
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_SEQ_04: You have defeated the Flamefang soldiers. Turn your attention back to the flame recruit traitor.
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_SEQ_05: Loonh Gah fells the fleeing traitor, only to join you in an Amalj'aa trap. The apparent leader of the ambush, Zagozz Teh, taunts the Miqo'te warrior, then easily defeats her as she attempts to loose an arrow at his heart. The raiders depart, sparing you to send a message to Hamujj Gah. First, however, you must return to Little Ala Mhigo and report events to Commander Gisilbehrt.
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_SEQ_06: The Immortal Flames commander is stricken with guilt at the news of the betrayal, and begs you to rescue the surviving captives from the clutches of the Flamefangs. Return to the Ring of Ash, and seek the counsel of Hamujj Gah.
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_SEQ_07: After explaining how each new tempered slave bolsters the strength of the enemy, the warleader bids you free those taken captive in the recent raid. Ambush the Amalj'aa gaolkeepers in the Zanr'ak encampment, and seize from them the keys to the captives' cages.
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_SEQ_08: You have slain the gaolkeepers, and obtained a fistful of keys. Locate the makeshift cages within Zahar'ak and rescue the kidnapped victims from their captors.
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_SEQ_09: You have succeeded in freeing the captives from their cages. Return to the Ring of Ash and report to Hamujj Gah.
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_SEQ_10: Even as the warleader praises your efforts, an infuriated Loonh Gah stalks into the cave, promising a grisly demise to Zagozz Teh. Though Hamujj Gah rebukes the young warrior and her reckless plans, he offers no aid in bringing the Flamefang leader to justice. It seems that the Miqo'te is to find her own strength, and resolve her blood vendetta alone...
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_SEQ_00: Yadovv Gah, in stark contrast to his usual stoic warrior demeanor, appears highly agitated.
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_SEQ_01: According to Yadovv Gah, it appears that Loonh Gah has embarked on a reckless quest to claim vengeance against Zagozz Teh. Report her absence to Hamujj Gah.
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_SEQ_02: The warleader seems saddened at Loonh Gah's rash decision, but shows no intention of chasing after her. Convey his words to Yadovv Gah.
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_SEQ_03: After speaking with Yadovv Gah, the distraught Amalj'aa warrior begs you to follow after the impulsive Miqo'te in his stead. Head into Zahar'ak, and find Loonh Gah.
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_SEQ_04: You catch up to Loonh Gah, who, after an initial outburst, tasks you with freeing a prisoner being held deeper within Zahar'ak. Locate Blazehorn Monabb Chah, and liberate the cage key.
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_SEQ_05: You have obtained the cage key from Blazehorn Monabb Chah. Use it to unlock the door of the prisoner's cage.
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_SEQ_06: Loonh Gah's reunion with her tempered mother is interrupted by the arrival of a mocking Zagozz Teh. Before setting off in pursuit of the Flamefang leader, the furious Miqo'te requests that you destroy the three Ifrit's beacons found within Zahar'ak.
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_SEQ_07: You have destroyed Ifrit's beacons. Seek out Loonh Gah that you might stand witness to her confrontation with Zagozz Teh.
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_SEQ_08: With the death of Zagozz Teh, Loonh Gah has finally put her years-long vendetta to rest. Return to the Ring of Ash, and speak with Hamujj Gah.
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_SEQ_09: Coupled with the death of their leader, your tireless efforts have ensured that the Flamefangs are no longer a potent force in the lands of Thanalan. Return to the Hall of Flames in Ul'dah, and report to Commander Swift.
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_SEQ_10: Commander Swift is satisfied that your deeds have freed the people of Thanalan from the constant threat of kidnapping. Though the problems posed by the beastmen are yet many and varied, he bids you enjoy your triumph with a brief respite from the chaos.
TEXT_BANAMA101_01222_SEQ_00: Fibubb Gah seeks your aid in preparing for a traditional Amalj'aa battle divination.
TEXT_BANAMA101_01222_SEQ_01: In order to replenish the Brotherhood's stock of divination materials, Fibubb Gah asks you to slay iron tortoises and wildfire sprites. Hunt down the specified creatures to obtain a tortoise shell and two red-hot cores.
TEXT_BANAMA101_01222_SEQ_02: You have been successful in your hunt. Deliver the iron tortoise shell and fire sprite cores to Fibubb Gah at the Ring of Ash.
TEXT_BANAMA101_01222_SEQ_03: You have delivered the shell and the cores to Fibubb Gah. The Amalj'aa appears pleased with your contributions, and bids you continue to offer your assistance in the days to come.
TEXT_BANAMA102_01223_SEQ_00: Fibubb Gah wishes you to make an example of some encroaching scouts.
TEXT_BANAMA102_01223_SEQ_01: Fibubb Gah has tasked you with slaying enemy scouts who have begun encroaching on the Brotherhood's territory to the north of Zanr'ak. Seek out and eliminate the Amalj'aa thaumaturges and lancers.
TEXT_BANAMA102_01223_SEQ_02: You have slain the thaumaturges and lancers that creep near the borders of the Ring of Ash. Report to Fibubb Gah.
TEXT_BANAMA102_01223_SEQ_03: Fibubb Gah is pleased with your measured slaughter. Stand ready to slay more scouts should they again grow bold enough to approach the lands of the Brotherhood of Ash.
TEXT_BANAMA103_01224_SEQ_00: Fibubb Gah seeks aid to replenish the Brotherhood's stock of healing salves.
TEXT_BANAMA103_01224_SEQ_01: Fibubb Gah explains that a true warrior needs to be as concerned with the arts of healing as with the arts of war. Seek out succulents within Zanr'ak and harvest their rejuvenating sap.
TEXT_BANAMA103_01224_SEQ_02: You have obtained a supply of rejuvenating sap. Return to the Ring of Ash and deliver the healing salve to Fibubb Gah.
TEXT_BANAMA103_01224_SEQ_03: You have delivered the rejuvenating sap to Fibubb Gah. The proud warrior commends your efforts, claiming that a Brotherhood soldier would sooner die in battle than on a sickbed.
TEXT_BANAMA104_01225_SEQ_00: Fibubb Gah seeks your aid in preserving the Amalj'aa holy land.
TEXT_BANAMA104_01225_SEQ_01: You have accepted the duty of removing a dire threat to the sacred lands of Zanr'ak. Slaughter bronze tortoises until Lacovie appears, then slay the ever-spawning matriarch herself.
TEXT_BANAMA104_01225_SEQ_02: You have defeated the ground-shaking Lacovie. Return to the Ring of Ash and report to Fibubb Gah.
TEXT_BANAMA104_01225_SEQ_03: You have delivered news of your success to Fibubb Gah. Though pleased with your deeds, the Brotherhood soldier warns that the emergence of a new matriarch is only a matter of time.
TEXT_BANAMA105_01226_SEQ_00: Fibubb Gah is incensed at the dishonorable tactics of his enemies.
TEXT_BANAMA105_01226_SEQ_01: Fibubb Gah has tasked you with depriving his fanatic kin of the firesand they use in their cowardly traps. Speak with the drake whisperer to the west of the Ring of Ash, and climb atop one of his scaly charges.
TEXT_BANAMA105_01226_SEQ_02:
Ride the cavalry drake into Zanr'ak, and destroy the stockpiles of firesand using your mount's Fiery Breath.

※Speak with the drake whisperer west of the Ring of Ash to mount a cavalry drake.
TEXT_BANAMA105_01226_SEQ_03: With the aid of your fire-breathing mount, you have successfully destroyed the barrels of firesand. Return to the Ring of Ash and report to Fibubb Gah.
TEXT_BANAMA105_01226_SEQ_04: Fibubb Gah expresses fierce joy at the sounds of exploding barrels. He cautions you, however, to stand ready for whatever depraved strategy the foe will next attempt to employ.
TEXT_BANAMA106_01227_SEQ_00: Fibubb Gah wishes your aid in removing a blight from the land.
TEXT_BANAMA106_01227_SEQ_01: You have been tasked by Fibubb Gah with extinguishing the unnatural flames of the Amalj'aa beacons. Take the ritually prepared smothering ash and use it to deprive the foes of the Brotherhood of their enhanced blessings.
TEXT_BANAMA106_01227_SEQ_02: You have used the smothering ash to extinguish the tainted fires of the Amalj'aa beacons. Return to the Ring of Ash and report to Fibubb Gah.
TEXT_BANAMA106_01227_SEQ_03: Fibubb Gah praises your efforts, claiming that the land itself breathes easier in the absence of the foul Amalj'aa beacons. He bids you stand ready to offer your aid should his vile kin once more ignite their vile flames.
TEXT_BANAMA107_01228_SEQ_00: Fibubb Gah requests your assistance in testing a new remedy.
TEXT_BANAMA107_01228_SEQ_01: Fibubb Gah has entrusted you with the Brotherhood of Ash's latest weapon in their kin war─a possible remedy for the madness of the tempered. Subdue the tempered found at the tempering ground in northern Zanr'ak, and test the efficacy of the sacred ash.
TEXT_BANAMA107_01228_SEQ_02: You have tested the sacred ash on the tempered with uncertain results. Return to the Ring of Ash and report to Fibubb Gah.
TEXT_BANAMA107_01228_SEQ_03: Though disappointed at the remedy's apparent failure, Fibubb Gah vows that the Brotherhood will continue its efforts toward creating a cure for the tempered. He muses that perhaps you just might be the one who tests the first successful batch.
TEXT_BANAMA108_01229_SEQ_00: Fibubb Gah laments the endless madness of his misguided kin.
TEXT_BANAMA108_01229_SEQ_01: Fibubb Gah regards the creation of every new tempered slave as a slight against the honor of all true Amalj'aa. He bids you hunt for Flamefang ravagers in the north of Zanr'ak, and liberate the keys they hold.
TEXT_BANAMA108_01229_SEQ_02: You have slain the ravagers and obtained their keys. Locate the cages they open, and free the Miqo'te prisoners to flee into the desert.
TEXT_BANAMA108_01229_SEQ_03: You have unlocked the cages and freed the captive rangers. Suspicious and fearful, the U tribe Miqo'te waste no time in putting Zanr'ak behind them. Return to the Ring of Ash and report to Fibubb Gah.
TEXT_BANAMA108_01229_SEQ_04: Fibubb Gah's wrath at the actions of his fanatic kin seems greatly assuaged by the success of your mission. He bids you remain at the Ring of Ash, and promises enrichment in return for the glory you win for the Brotherhood.
TEXT_BANAMA109_01230_SEQ_00: Fibubb Gah wishes to salvage the honor taken from his people.
TEXT_BANAMA109_01230_SEQ_01: Fibubb Gah, unable to overlook the common thievery of the fallen Amalj'aa, wishes you to reclaim the ancestral weapons of the Forgotten Springs Miqo'te. Recover the unearned spoils of war from the crude gold coffers found in Zanr'ak, and also from the cooling corpses of an Amalj'aa brigand and an Amalj'aa scavenger.
TEXT_BANAMA109_01230_SEQ_02: You have retrieved the Miqo'te weapons. Deliver the assorted arms to Fibubb Gah at the Ring of Ash.
TEXT_BANAMA109_01230_SEQ_03: Though he claims no ties of fellowship with the U tribe, Fibubb Gah nevertheless feels honor-bound to return the unfairly won weaponry to Forgotten Springs himself. The Brotherhood soldier praises your well-rounded warrior spirit, and is certain that your feet are firmly planted on the path to greatness.
TEXT_BANAMA110_01231_SEQ_00: Fibubb Gah wishes to entrust you with a new task.
TEXT_BANAMA110_01231_SEQ_01: Fibubb Gah has bid you strike out at the unholy altars of the Brotherhood's hated kin. Locate and destroy the flaming beacons in the west of Zahar'ak.
TEXT_BANAMA110_01231_SEQ_02: You have destroyed the flaming beacons. Return to the Ring of Ash and report to Fibubb Gah.
TEXT_BANAMA110_01231_SEQ_03: Fibubb Gah praises your worthy display of courage. Though the warrior exults at the blow you have struck for the Brotherhood, he warns that the fallen Amalj'aa will not be so easily dissuaded from their mad pursuit for power.
TEXT_BANAMA201_01232_SEQ_00: Narujj Boh wishes to capitalize on the panic you have sown.
TEXT_BANAMA201_01232_SEQ_01: Narujj Boh bids you infiltrate the Zanr'ak encampment and hunt down the agitated Amalj'aa clergy members. Slay Zanr'ak thaumaturges for their ritual tools, and Zanr'ak pugilists for their ritual offerings.
TEXT_BANAMA201_01232_SEQ_02: You have slain the clergy members and their bodyguards. Return to the Ring of Ash, and deliver the ritual materials to Narujj Boh.
TEXT_BANAMA201_01232_SEQ_03: Narujj Boh is pleased with the disruption your deeds have caused among the enemy's ranks. Without the necessary ritual materials, the clergy's plans to summon their god have been substantially delayed.
TEXT_BANAMA202_01233_SEQ_00: Narujj Boh is eager for you to spill the blood of the enemy.
TEXT_BANAMA202_01233_SEQ_01: In an effort to weaken the forces of the Flamefangs, Narujj Boh has bid you slay the Zanr'ak lancers and Amalj'aa archers found within the Zanr'ak encampment.
TEXT_BANAMA202_01233_SEQ_02: You have slain the soldiers beholden to the Flamefangs. Return to the Ring of Ash and report to Narujj Boh.
TEXT_BANAMA202_01233_SEQ_03: Satisfaction was writ plain upon your face, and in an instant did Narujj Boh recognize that your mission was a success. To face the enemy in his own domain and triumph is no small feat, and the Amalj'aa is grateful to have such a competent soldier as you pledged to the Brotherhood of Ash.
TEXT_BANAMA203_01234_SEQ_00: Narujj Boh is troubled by reports of frenzied nighttime rituals.
TEXT_BANAMA203_01234_SEQ_01: Narujj Boh shares with you news of a new form of ritual taking place at the Zanr'ak altar. He asks that you search the area of the Zanr'ak encampment and altar for weapon caches, and seize the armaments scouts claim were enchanted with unholy flames.
TEXT_BANAMA203_01234_SEQ_02: You have obtained the flame-sanctified weapons. Return to the Ring of Ash, and deliver the armaments to Narujj Boh.
TEXT_BANAMA203_01234_SEQ_03: You have brought the enchanted weapons to the Ring of Ash. Narujj Boh seems amused at the time and effort his foes have invested, only to have their new toys taken away. Pleased by your deeds, the proud warrior suggests you take your rest until your next task is decided.
TEXT_BANAMA204_01235_SEQ_00: Narujj Boh wishes to entrust you with a tiresome─but necessary─task.
TEXT_BANAMA204_01235_SEQ_01: Though the Brotherhood of Ash strives to destroy the fiery talismans of its foe whenever they appear, it lacks the numbers to match the zealous pace of the Flamefangs. Take the sacks of ash given to you by Narujj Boh, and smother all the beacons you find within the Zanr'ak encampment. Be prepared to defend yourself against any retaliation your efforts incur.
TEXT_BANAMA204_01235_SEQ_02: You have extinguished all the Amalj'aa beacons within the encampment. Return to the Ring of Ash and report to Narujj Boh.
TEXT_BANAMA204_01235_SEQ_03: You return to the Ring of Ash, tested but triumphant. Narujj Boh is well pleased by your deeds, but warns that the Flamefangs will respond with ever greater acts of foolish fanaticism. He vows, however, the Brotherhood of Ash will never surrender in its efforts to restore the ancient and honorable ways of the Amalj'aa.
TEXT_BANAMA205_01236_SEQ_00: Narujj Boh has a unique proposal for depriving the Flamefangs of easy targets.
TEXT_BANAMA205_01236_SEQ_01: Narujj Boh wishes to convince the U tribe rangers to quit the sands before their divided forces fall prey to Flamefang raiders. Speak with the drake whisperer in the Sagolii Desert to borrow a flame-spitting mount with which to cow the stubborn hunters.
TEXT_BANAMA205_01236_SEQ_02:
You have spoken with the drake whisperer and mounted a mighty cavalry drake. Ride it into the Sagolii Desert, and use its Fiery Breath to convince the U tribe rangers to flee the sands.

※Speak with the drake whisperer in the Sagolii Desert to mount a cavalry drake.
TEXT_BANAMA205_01236_SEQ_03: The gouts of flame spat by your mount have had the desired effect on the hunters of Forgotten Springs. Return to the Ring of Ash and report to Narujj Boh.
TEXT_BANAMA205_01236_SEQ_04: Narujj Boh praises your efforts in saving the Miqo'te rangers from their own ill-considered tactics. Though unconvinced that his plan will have any lasting effect, the stoic soldier is nevertheless content to deprive the Flamefangs of further tempered slaves for as long as possible.
TEXT_BANAMA206_01237_SEQ_00: Narujj Boh asks that you try your hand at organ harvesting.
TEXT_BANAMA206_01237_SEQ_01: After explaining the need to acquire incendiary glands from the ferocious breed of battle drakes, Narujj Boh suggests you first seek out the lizardsbane plant. Search the vicinity of the Zanr'ak altar for the elusive growth, and obtain a vial of lizardsbane oil.
TEXT_BANAMA206_01237_SEQ_02: You have successfully drawn a full vial of lizardsbane oil. Use the substance to weaken the battle drakes found in the south of the Zanr'ak encampment, and harvest incendiary glands from their corpses.
TEXT_BANAMA206_01237_SEQ_03: You have slain the battle drakes, and removed their highly developed incendiary glands. Bring the organs back to the Ring of Ash, and feed them to the Brotherhood's cavalry drakes.
TEXT_BANAMA206_01237_SEQ_04: You have fed the incendiary organs to the seemingly appreciative cavalry drakes. Report the success of your task to Narujj Boh.
TEXT_BANAMA206_01237_SEQ_05: Evidently forewarned by the drakes and their contented purring, Narujj Boh thanks you for your efforts before you have even had a chance to report your success. The Brotherhood warrior appears eager to witness the fiery results of the drakes' grisly meal.
TEXT_BANAMA207_01238_SEQ_00: Narujj Boh wishes you to deliver an insult to the Flamefangs.
TEXT_BANAMA207_01238_SEQ_01: After educating you on the Amalj'aa's distaste for water, Narujj Boh asks that you subject the Brotherhood's foes to a humiliating defeat. Subdue the Flamefang ravagers you encounter in the south of Zanr'ak, and douse them with water from the heavy glass flasks at the moment of your victory.
TEXT_BANAMA207_01238_SEQ_02: You have thoroughly soaked a number of defeated Flamefangs. Return to the Ring of Ash and report to Narujj Boh.
TEXT_BANAMA207_01238_SEQ_03: Narujj Boh appears almost jovial at the news of your success. Though unable to witness the dousing firsthand, the warriors of the Brotherhood are much heartened by reports of the Flamefangs' defeat and subsequent humiliation.
TEXT_BANAMA208_01239_SEQ_00: Narujj Boh requests your aid in preventing the creation of a new wave of tempered.
TEXT_BANAMA208_01239_SEQ_01: Appalled at the boldness of his demented kin and the success of their kidnapping efforts, Narujj Boh bids you assist the Brotherhood in preventing the ranks of the tempered from growing ever more numerous. You are to ambush Flamefang ravagers in the Zanr'ak encampment, and seize from them the cage keys they hold.
TEXT_BANAMA208_01239_SEQ_02: You have obtained the cage keys from the Flamefang ravagers. Locate the makeshift cages in the Zanr'ak encampment, and free the prisoners from their unfortunate fate.
TEXT_BANAMA208_01239_SEQ_03: You have freed the captives from the Amalj'aa cages. Return to the Ring of Ash and report to Narujj Boh.
TEXT_BANAMA208_01239_SEQ_04: Narujj Boh is impressed with the courage and ability you displayed in plucking the captives straight from the jaws of the Flamefangs. As you continue to prove your worth as an ally, the Brotherhood warrior is encouraged to look to his own training.
TEXT_BANAMA209_01240_SEQ_00: Narujj Boh wishes to take advantage of your un-Amalj'aa-like appearance.
TEXT_BANAMA209_01240_SEQ_01: Narujj Boh suspects that the boxes an Amalj'aa raider seized from an unfortunate merchant were filled with crystals. Speak with the troubled trader resting to the east of Little Ala Mhigo, and learn the contents of his stolen cargo.
TEXT_BANAMA209_01240_SEQ_02: You question the troubled trader, and discover that his cargo did, indeed, consist of a substantial number of crystals. Make haste into Zanr'ak, find the stolen boxes, and catch the thief himself before he hands over the bulk of his haul to Ifrit's eager clergy.
TEXT_BANAMA209_01240_SEQ_03: You have recovered all of the crystal-filled boxes. Make your way back to the troubled trader, and return to him his precious cargo.
TEXT_BANAMA209_01240_SEQ_04: You return with the cargo of crystals, to the merchant's overwhelming joy and relief. Return to the Ring of Ash and report to Narujj Boh.
TEXT_BANAMA209_01240_SEQ_05: You inform Narujj Boh of the successful retrieval of the trader's wares. The Brotherhood warrior thanks you for your deeds, relieved that your presence has averted a potential disaster.
TEXT_BANAMA210_01241_SEQ_00: Narujj Boh is exhausted by his stubborn kin's single-mindedness.
TEXT_BANAMA210_01241_SEQ_01: Narujj Boh tiredly explains that the Amalj'aa in Zanr'ak have constructed yet more of their ominous flame-topped towers. Find the infernal beacons and destroy them.
TEXT_BANAMA210_01241_SEQ_02: You have destroyed the infernal beacons. Return to the Ring of Ash and report to Narujj Boh.
TEXT_BANAMA210_01241_SEQ_03: Narujj Boh deduces from the stink of ruin that you were successful in your task. He exults in the defeat of his enemies' plans, and thanks you for your contributions to the Brotherhood's cause.
TEXT_BANAMA301_01242_SEQ_00: Yadovv Gah is eager to seize upon his foe's miscalculation.
TEXT_BANAMA301_01242_SEQ_01: Though he often counsels measured action, Yadovv Gah appears hungry for blood this day. It seems that certain of Zagozz Teh's elite troops have left his side, with orders to participate in upcoming raids. Take advantage of their vulnerability, and strike down the Zahar'ak lancers and archers.
TEXT_BANAMA301_01242_SEQ_02: You have slain the lancers and archers of Zahar'ak, leaving their corpses as a stark warning to Zagozz Teh and his arrogance. Return to the Ring of Ash and report to Yadovv Gah.
TEXT_BANAMA301_01242_SEQ_03: You return to Yadovv Gah with news of your unrestrained slaughter. Though cheered by the thought of such fangs pulled from his enemy's maw, the Brotherhood warrior warns that your attacks may provoke retaliation. Stand ready to offer your assistance should the need arise.
TEXT_BANAMA302_01243_SEQ_00: Yadovv Gah wishes you to make an attack of opportunity.
TEXT_BANAMA302_01243_SEQ_01: Members of Ifrit's high clergy, the thaumaturges and their pugilist bodyguards, have been spotted moving among the rank and file. Cut your way into Zahar'ak, and slay these priests of flame before their ritual magic can be brought to bear against the Brotherhood of Ash.
TEXT_BANAMA302_01243_SEQ_02: You have slain the Zahar'ak thaumaturges and pugilists. Return to the Ring of Ash and report to Yadovv Gah.
TEXT_BANAMA302_01243_SEQ_03: Yadovv Gah revels in the confusion left in the wake of your assault on the high clergy. The Brotherhood warrior notes the effect your glorious deeds have on the morale of his fellow soldiers, and praises his warleader's decision to recruit you to their cause.
TEXT_BANAMA303_01244_SEQ_00: Yadovv Gah seeks to deprive his god-coddled kin of their undeserved might.
TEXT_BANAMA303_01244_SEQ_01: Yadovv Gah fears that the Brotherhood will soon face the Ifrit-blessed spears of the enemy in the field. Steal into Zahar'ak and seize the deadly weapons before they are distributed to the frontline soldiers.
TEXT_BANAMA303_01244_SEQ_02: You have taken possession of the tempered weapons. Return to the Ring of Ash, and deliver them to Yadovv Gah.
TEXT_BANAMA303_01244_SEQ_03: You have safely delivered the inferno-imbued weapons into the waiting hands of Yadovv Gah. Derisive of his weakling kin's failure to resist the temptation of Ifrit's might, the Brotherhood warrior quickly seeks to dispose of the enchanted arms.
TEXT_BANAMA304_01245_SEQ_00: Yadovv Gah wishes to present a true challenge to your martial ability.
TEXT_BANAMA304_01245_SEQ_01: Yadovv Gah has charged you with slaying the commander of a notorious Flamefang elite unit. Participate in the FATE “Quenching the Flame” in Zahar'ak, and present proof of your deed to Yadovv Gah.
TEXT_BANAMA304_01245_SEQ_02: You have presented the Flamefang choker to Yadovv Gah. The Brotherhood warrior exults in your towering victory, and relishes the thought of his enemies' plunging morale.
TEXT_BANAMA305_01246_SEQ_00: Yadovv Gah seeks to employ your skills in demolition.
TEXT_BANAMA305_01246_SEQ_01: Yadovv Gah bids you ride a cavalry drake into Zahar'ak and incinerate the enemies' supply stores. Speak with the drake whisperer in Zanr'ak to borrow a mount.
TEXT_BANAMA305_01246_SEQ_02:
Ride the cavalry drake into Zahar'ak, and destroy the Amalj'aa supply caches using your mount's Fiery Breath.

※Speak with the drake whisperer in Zanr'ak to mount a cavalry drake.
TEXT_BANAMA305_01246_SEQ_03: You have reduced the supply stores of the Amalj'aa to smoldering ruin. Return to the Ring of Ash and report to Yadovv Gah.
TEXT_BANAMA305_01246_SEQ_04: Yadovv Gah is grimly satisfied with your demolition handiwork. He appears eager to witness the widespread effects the supplies' destruction will have on the Zahar'ak Amalj'aa, overconfident as they are in the omnipotence of their god.
TEXT_BANAMA306_01247_SEQ_00: Yadovv Gah means to use the nature of the Amalj'aa's blessings against them.
TEXT_BANAMA306_01247_SEQ_01: Yadovv Gah suspects that the voracious flames of Ifrit's blessings will feed upon each other, and has enlisted your aid to test his theory in practice. Pass through the gates of Zahar'ak, and first hunt down fortune-tellers for their wildfire idols.
TEXT_BANAMA306_01247_SEQ_02: You have slain fortune-tellers and obtained a pair of wildfire idols. Find the Inferno altar in the north of Zahar'ak, and cast the idols into its flames.
TEXT_BANAMA306_01247_SEQ_03: You consign the wildfire idols to the fires of the Inferno altar, and the resulting conflagration reduces everything in the vicinity to slag and charcoal. Return to the Ring of Ash and report to Yadovv Gah.
TEXT_BANAMA306_01247_SEQ_04: Yadovv Gah seems both elated and relieved at the success of his plan. With such tactics proven to be effective, it is only a matter of time before the fragile strength of the Zahar'ak Amalj'aa is shattered completely.
TEXT_BANAMA307_01248_SEQ_00: Yadovv Gah would burn the heart out of his enemies.
TEXT_BANAMA307_01248_SEQ_01: It is tradition for Amalj'aa to be buried with their weapons, for they are warriors in death as well as in life. Conversely, it is considered sacrilege for the weapons of the dead to be removed from their graves. Yadovv Gah has already seen to that dark deed; all that remains is for you to place the stolen weapons on display in Zahar'ak and show the Flamefangs that their fallen brothers have been disgraced.
TEXT_BANAMA307_01248_SEQ_02: As the cries of the Flamefangs echo in your ears, you realize that your monuments to their misery have achieved the desired effect. Report your success to Yadovv Gah.
TEXT_BANAMA307_01248_SEQ_03: Recognizing that others may find his methods distasteful, Yadovv Gah asserts that by breaking the spirits of his sworn enemies, he ensures that they are less like to seek vengeance. Should his strategy prove effective, the conflict between the Brotherhood and the Flamefangs may end more quickly than anticipated.
TEXT_BANAMA308_01249_SEQ_00: Yadovv Gah requires your skill at subterfuge.
TEXT_BANAMA308_01249_SEQ_01: The Flamefangs have kidnapped more men and women to offer up to the Lord of the Inferno. Believing that the captives will be tempered ere long, Yadovv Gah urges you to act with all haste. Stalk and slay the guards who hold the keys to the cages.
TEXT_BANAMA308_01249_SEQ_02: Having obtained the keys, you must now liberate the prisoners. Search for the cages which hold the captive men and women, then use the keys to set them free.
TEXT_BANAMA308_01249_SEQ_03: The Lord of the Inferno will claim no new souls this day, for the captives have all escaped. Return to the Ring of Ash and report to Yadovv Gah.
TEXT_BANAMA308_01249_SEQ_04: Yadovv Gah thanks you for sparing him and his brothers from the loathsome task of slaying more tempered slaves in battle. As he decries the cowardice of the Flamefangs, you observe that his distaste for the enemy runs deep...
TEXT_BANAMA309_01250_SEQ_00: Yadovv Gah has no use for fair-weather allies.
TEXT_BANAMA309_01250_SEQ_01: The rising reputation of the Brotherhood has instilled doubt in the hearts of young Flamefangs, some of whom have made overtures. However, Yadovv Gah believes these hatchlings to be naught more than opportunists. The warrior bids you beat the would-be turncloaks senseless and douse them with water, thus subjecting them to the ultimate insult.
TEXT_BANAMA309_01250_SEQ_02: You faithfully carry out Yadovv Gah's instructions, leaving the naive hatchlings alive but shamed. Return and report that the deed is done.
TEXT_BANAMA309_01250_SEQ_03: Upon hearing how the hatchlings cried out in horror, Yadovv Gah makes no effort to conceal his delight. Though the experience has likely scarred the young Amalj'aa for life, the old warrior believes it to be a well-deserved punishment for their vacillation.
TEXT_BANAMA310_01251_SEQ_00: Yadovv Gah demands that the fires of Ifrit's beacons be quenched.
TEXT_BANAMA310_01251_SEQ_01: The beacons of the Flamefangs are symbols of power and prestige─none more so than those which bear the Lord of the Inferno's name. Yadovv Gah would have you destroy these abominations, and in so doing irreparably damage the reputation of the zealots.
TEXT_BANAMA310_01251_SEQ_02: The Flamefangs will rue this day, and rue it hard. Return to the Ring of Ash and report to Yadovv Gah.
TEXT_BANAMA310_01251_SEQ_03: The howls of the Flamefangs heard for malms around informed Yadovv Gah of your success. He declares that the Brotherhood's sworn enemies will soon lie broken at their feet, thanks to your tireless efforts.
TEXT_BANSYL001_01252_SEQ_00: Commander Vorsaile Heuloix seeks a capable adventurer for a most daunting assignment.
TEXT_BANSYL001_01252_SEQ_01: Serpent Commander Heuloix is concerned about troubling movements among the sylph tribes, fearing that the typically benign beastmen are hatching a bodeful plot. With the scholar dispatched to investigate the matter having gone missing, the commander bids you go in search. Travel to Little Solace and speak to the sylph Olmxio.
TEXT_BANSYL001_01252_SEQ_02: Olmxio informs you that a bumbling, spineless fool of a “smart one” has been spending much time in the company of the sylph elder. This hardly matches Commander Heuloix's description of the scholar Voyce, but it should suffice as a starting point for your search. Seek out the sylph elder, Frixio, and see what light he might shed on the matter.
TEXT_BANSYL001_01252_SEQ_03: Elder Frixio─who seemingly holds Voyce in similarly low esteem─informs you that the scholar set out a few days ago for the Sylphlands. He also expresses considerable doubt as to the likelihood of the scholar returning alive. Return to Olmxio and see if there is anything you might do to rescue the man from harm.
TEXT_BANSYL001_01252_SEQ_04: Though failing to understand your preoccupation with Voyce's well-being, Olmxio does not dissuade you from your stated aim. He gives you fair warning that the Sylphlands are fraught with many dangers for walking ones such as yourself, and encourages you to prepare thoroughly for the journey ahead.
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_SEQ_00: Olmxio is perplexed by your concern for the hapless scholar.
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_SEQ_01: Though unconvinced that searching for the “bumbling one” is worth the trouble, Olmxio nevertheless offers you knowledge that should avail you in your effort. Travel to Larkscall, on the border with the Sylphlands, and survey the area from the specified location.
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_SEQ_02: Your mere presence in the area has scared the malevolent sylphs away, at least for the moment. The danger having abated, return your attention to the scholar Voyce and release him from his bonds.
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_SEQ_03: No sooner did you rescue Voyce from the clutches of his captors than did the skittish scholar flee to the safety of Little Solace. Return and speak with the man to see what he has gleaned in his research of the sylphs.
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_SEQ_04: The scholar Voyce─with some assistance from Elder Frixio─recounts the legend of the Chosen One, a legendary sylph who is reborn once a millennium and is said to possess the power to change the fate of her people. All present fear for what might befall the realm if the Chosen One were to fall into the hands of the malevolent touched sylphs. Speak with Olmxio and see if there is anything that can be done.
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_SEQ_05: Olmxio, expressing grave doubts as to Voyce's abilities, would have you lead the search for the Chosen One. Remain in Little Solace and assist the sylphs as you gather what knowledge you can to prepare for the task ahead.
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_SEQ_00: Voyce has made a monumental discovery.
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_SEQ_01: The pseudoscholar Voyce has belatedly come to the conclusion that the sylphs who had captured him are in possession of a podling containing the Chosen One. As he neither understands the full implications of this nor possesses the courage to investigate the matter himself, he bids you speak with Olmxio.
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_SEQ_02:
Aghast at hearing that the Chosen One is in the hands of the touched sylphs, Olmxio urges you to go in search of the podling at once, casting a spell of transparency upon you to aid in your quest. Infiltrate the Sylphlands and spy upon any ill-intentioned sylphs you might find, that you might ascertain the location of the Chosen One's podling.

※This task must be completed before Olmxio's enchantment expires. To extend the length of his spell, interact with the fragrant blooms you encounter on your path.
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_SEQ_03: To your fortune, the heedless sylph tasked with transporting the Chosen One's podling has misplaced his charge somewhere near the entrance to the Sylphlands. Hurry and find it before the touched ones do!
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_SEQ_04:
You have secured the podling, which is a great deal weightier than you imagined. Transport it safely back to Little Solace while the strength in your arms remains.

※To bolster your strength while carrying the podling, interact with the patches of moongrass that you find along the way.
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_SEQ_05: The Chosen One's podling now rests safely in Little Solace. Inform Voyce that you were able to succeed in the task without his help.
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_SEQ_06: While relieved that the Chosen One is safe, Elder Frixio does not believe that the touched ones will give up so easily, and warns you that retaliation may come sooner than you think.
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_SEQ_00: Olmxio has had it up to here with Voyce's utter incompetence.
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_SEQ_01: Olmxio, unable to bear Voyce's utter uselessness, sought to entrust the hapless scholar with various menial tasks, only to watch him fail in spectacular fashion. Olmxio now suspects Voyce is slacking from his latest task, that of leaf collecting. Seek out Nathaxio, who awaits the scholar's harvest.
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_SEQ_02: Nathaxio suspects that the spell of transparency he cast upon Voyce has worn off, and that the scholar is too fearful to return. Seek out the hapless man by the entrance to the Sylphlands.
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_SEQ_03: You find Voyce a bit shaken up, but otherwise no worse for the wear. Return to Olmxio and inform him that the scholar is safe.
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_SEQ_04: Olmxio is perplexed by your presence, saying that you just spoke with him a moment ago en route to check on the Chosen One's cradle. Fearing the worst, he insists that you speak with Elder Frixio immediately.
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_SEQ_05: That which was most feared has come true, as the disguised Diluxio and his lackeys have made off with the Chosen One, whose powers they intend to use to exact revenge on all perceived enemies of sylphkind. Return to Olmxio and report on the grievous state of affairs.
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_SEQ_06: Olmxio is devastated at the news, yet resolves to find a way to retrieve the Chosen One's podling from the clutches of the touched ones. Remain in Little Solace and lend the sylphs what aid you can.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_SEQ_00: Olmxio wears a look of grave concern on his face.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_SEQ_01: Olmxio bears most ominous tidings: the diabolical Diluxio and his lackeys have begun the rite of birthing, and stand poised to claim the immeasurable powers of the Chosen One for their own. Speak with Elder Frixio and form a plan to halt the ritual and bring the yet-sealed podling back to Little Solace.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_SEQ_02: The overstrung scholar Voyce has finally snapped completely, believing himself to be a heroic chocobo and insisting to accompany you on your quest to rescue the Chosen One from Diluxio's clutches. Rendezvous with the self-styled “Voco” by the entrance to the Sylphlands.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_SEQ_03: As expected, Voco will require your protection while offering little in return. Keep the crazed bird-man out of harm's way and make for the Seedbed. Should Voco wander away, return to the starting point and try anew.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_SEQ_04: You have successfully navigated your way through the Sylphlands, and the Seedbed stands before you. Speak with Voco in hopes that he will manage not to sabotage the rescue effort with his typical bumblings.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_SEQ_05: By some miracle, the scholar Voyce maintained a shred of sanity, managing to snatch up the podling while Diluxio was otherwise distracted. Fend off Diluxio's underlings and meet up with the unlikely hero east of the Seedbed.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_SEQ_06: Voyce gave all that he had, but his legs will carry him no further. To see that the ill-fated scholar's sacrifice will not be in vain, take the sylph podling into hand.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_SEQ_07:
See the podling back to Little Solace while your arms and legs can still bear the burden.

※To bolster your strength while carrying the podling, interact with the patches of moongrass that you find along the way.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_SEQ_08: The sylph podling has been returned to Little Solace, where the Chosen One will be free from the influence of the hateful Diluxio. Share the good tidings with Olmxio and prepare for the birthing rite.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_SEQ_09: The Chosen One has emerged from her podling to recognize Elder Frixio as her nurturing one. Raised in the peaceful surroundings of Little Solace with those who will teach her love and kindness, the Chosen One will surely lead her people into an era of peace and prosperity. In other news, it turns out that the bungling scholar Voyce still lives, much to the chagrin of all who find themselves in his company. Leave him to his bumblings and report back to Commander Heuloix in Gridania on the success of the sylphic campaign.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_SEQ_10: You report to Commander Heuloix, only to learn that the insufferable Voyce has already submitted a report and taken credit for the lion's share of your deeds. Accept your modest reward, and take heart in knowing that your deeds will live on in the hearts of the sylphs of Little Solace, who will forever recognize you as a true friend to the forest.
TEXT_BANSYL101_01257_SEQ_00: Tonaxia would repay a debt of kindness.
TEXT_BANSYL101_01257_SEQ_01: The sylphs of Little Solace are fond of Rolfe Hawthorne, who has been a friend to their people. Tonaxia would repay the man's kindness with an offering of wild vegetables from this year's bountiful harvest. Take them and decorate the Hawthorne Hut as directed by Tonaxia.
TEXT_BANSYL101_01257_SEQ_02: You have decked the hut with wild vegetables as Tonaxia requested. Speak with Rolfe Hawthorne, who is sure to be overjoyed at the surprise gift.
TEXT_BANSYL101_01257_SEQ_03: Despite being less than pleased with the gift and the means of delivery, Rolfe nevertheless appreciates the kindness of his forest friends. Inform Tonaxia that the deed is done.
TEXT_BANSYL101_01257_SEQ_04: Tonaxia is delighted to hear of Rolfe's joy and frustration both. It would seem the troublesome nature of the “gift” was exactly as the mischievous sylph intended.
TEXT_BANSYL102_01258_SEQ_00: Tonaxia is beside herself in giggling glee.
TEXT_BANSYL102_01258_SEQ_01: Despite her attempts to play innocent, it is evident that Tonaxia is in need of ingredients for her latest prank. Strike out for Larkscall; slay a morbol, an old-growth treant, and two molted ziz; and harvest the malodorous items she seeks─a phial of morbol bile, a rotting acorn, and two phials of ziz venom, respectively.
TEXT_BANSYL102_01258_SEQ_02: The unpleasant creatures are no more, and their unpleasant remains are yours. Deliver the aforementioned goods to Tonaxia.
TEXT_BANSYL102_01258_SEQ_03: Tonaxia is pleased to receive the items she requested, and promises that you will not be the victim of her foul-smelling plot─provided, of course, you continue to do her bidding.
TEXT_BANSYL103_01259_SEQ_01: Tonaxia has entrusted you with recovering several sacks of devil gourds─an invaluable source of dye for the sylphs' weaving─that she dropped when spooked by a pack of touched sylphs. Travel to Larkscall and search for the missing goods before the touched ones carry them away.
TEXT_BANSYL103_01259_SEQ_02: You have successfully recovered the missing gourds. Deliver them to Tonaxia, who is sure to be pleased at this development.
TEXT_BANSYL103_01259_SEQ_03: Tonaxia is overjoyed at the return of her gourds, and promises to return the favor at some unspecified time in the future. Temper your expectations, and continue to go about your business.
TEXT_BANSYL104_01260_SEQ_00: Tonaxia fears for the fate of her fellow sylphs.
TEXT_BANSYL104_01260_SEQ_01: Touched sylphs have played a terrible trick on Tonaxia's friends, who now struggle, trapped in the bellies of the fearsome leaf-eating gapemaw plants. To rescue them from a sticky fate, first make for Larkscall and collect sap from deepwood saplings.
TEXT_BANSYL104_01260_SEQ_02: You have secured three phials of sap, the sweet scent of which will cause the gapemaws' mouths to open. Rescue the trapped sylphs before the digestive process proceeds any further.
TEXT_BANSYL104_01260_SEQ_03: You have successfully freed the sylphs, who were drenched in a sticky secretion but fortunately undigested as yet. Inform Tonaxia that her friends are safe.
TEXT_BANSYL104_01260_SEQ_04: Tonaxia is beside herself in gratitude at your deed. It would seem that the sylphs are beginning to recognize you as a true friend to their kind.
TEXT_BANSYL105_01261_SEQ_00: Tonaxia would introduce you to one of her best friends.
TEXT_BANSYL105_01261_SEQ_01: Tonaxia extols the virtues of the goobbue, and encourages to you befriend one of the creatures. Travel to Larkscall and speak with the cheerful sylph who tends to the “mossy ones.”
TEXT_BANSYL105_01261_SEQ_02:
The goobbue-herding sylph is distressed by the arrival of two touched ones with a mind for mischief. Kill two wingrats with one stone by riding the goobbue and sneezing the troublemakers into oblivion.

※You may mount the goobbue by speaking to the cheerful sylph.
TEXT_BANSYL105_01261_SEQ_03: The goobbue and you proved a formidable team, and the spittle-showered touched ones have fled in fear and disgust. Return and relate the happenings to Tonaxia.
TEXT_BANSYL105_01261_SEQ_04: Tonaxia is most pleased to hear that you befriended a goobbue and performed another good deed for Little Solace, nearly going so far as to declare you an honorary sylph.
TEXT_BANSYL106_01262_SEQ_00: Tonaxia suspects that the touched ones are once again up to no good.
TEXT_BANSYL106_01262_SEQ_01: Tonaxia has spotted sylphs performing a sinister ritual, and fears for the consequences if they are allowed to continue. Seek out the mysterious sylph in Larkscall and learn how you might put a stop to their foul sorcery.
TEXT_BANSYL106_01262_SEQ_02:
The mysterious sylph works her magic to render you transparent. Seek out the area where the ritual is being performed and steal the evil sylphs' artifacts.

※You must complete the task before the enchantment expires. The fragrant blooms you encounter on your path will extend the duration of the spell.
TEXT_BANSYL106_01262_SEQ_03: You have successfully stolen away with the touched sylphs' artifacts, preventing them from continuing with their foul hexcraft. Deliver the baubles to Tonaxia and inform her that the deed is done.
TEXT_BANSYL106_01262_SEQ_04: Upon receiving the ritual artifacts, Tonaxia expresses her relief that the touched ones' rituals will continue no more. Your efforts on behalf of Little Solace continue to earn you the trust of its denizens.
TEXT_BANSYL107_01263_SEQ_00: Unwelcome visitors to the forest have Tonaxia ill at ease.
TEXT_BANSYL107_01263_SEQ_01: Frightening “steel ones”─imperial soldiers─are roving the forest, and Tonaxia fears for her people's safety. Furnishing you with makeshift projectile weapons capable of unleashing an obscenely foul odor, she bids you chase off the intruders.
TEXT_BANSYL107_01263_SEQ_02: You have seen to the Garlean menace. Assure Tonaxia that the steel ones will bother her people no more.
TEXT_BANSYL107_01263_SEQ_03: Tonaxia is profoundly impressed by your strength and selflessness. Shedding a tear for the friends she has already lost to the Garleans and their fearsome weaponry, she is nonetheless heartened to hear that the danger has been quelled for the moment.
TEXT_BANSYL108_01264_SEQ_00: Tonaxia is in dire need of an adventurer's aid.
TEXT_BANSYL108_01264_SEQ_01: The continued presence of the Garlean Empire in the forest has Tonaxia and her fellow sylphs fearing for their lives. Participate in the FATE “A Wrench in the Works” in east Larkscall, then deliver proof of your triumph to Tonaxia to put the poor sylph's heart at ease.
TEXT_BANSYL108_01264_SEQ_02: Tonaxia is profoundly impressed by your triumph over imperial technology, and appears eager to share tidings of your triumph with all in Little Solace. The sylphs cannot rest easy yet, however, and would be greatly heartened were you to sojourn among them a while longer.
TEXT_BANSYL109_01265_SEQ_01: As Tonaxia tells it, the touched sylphs have mastered an incantation that allows them to conceal their identity, and have been putting it to liberal use to conduct surprise attacks on the sylphs of Little Solace. Employ the truesight scalebombs that she has furnished you with to put an end to their malicious ruse.
TEXT_BANSYL109_01265_SEQ_02: The shifty sylpheeds are no more. Inform Tonaxia that the deed is done.
TEXT_BANSYL109_01265_SEQ_03: Pleased that the malicious masquerade has come to an end, Tonaxia thanks you for your efforts. Fearing that it is only a matter of time before the touched sylphs devise a new ruse, she begs you not to venture far from Little Solace.
TEXT_BANSYL110_01266_SEQ_00: Tonaxia's nose smells something rotten in Larkscall.
TEXT_BANSYL110_01266_SEQ_01: In a deeply misguided effort to protect their forest home from outsiders, malevolent sylphs have released a horde of poisonous banestools in Larkscall. At Tonaxia's request, put down the fungal menace before the contamination can spread.
TEXT_BANSYL110_01266_SEQ_02: The banestools are no more, and the air of the forest is pristine once again. Report your success to Tonaxia.
TEXT_BANSYL110_01266_SEQ_03: Tonaxia breathes deeply of the crisp forest air and thanks you for your deeds. The sensitive sylph expresses sympathy for her misguided kinsmen who have allowed their distrust of outsiders to cloud their love for their own home.
TEXT_BANSYL201_01267_SEQ_00: Ponnixia is concerned about a new threat to her people's safety.
TEXT_BANSYL201_01267_SEQ_01: The touched sylphs are causing trouble again, this time training the local fauna to harass and injure their peace-loving kinsmen. Venture to the Sylphlands, slay the two condors, and see to the sylphs responsible for training the birds to be vicious killers.
TEXT_BANSYL201_01267_SEQ_02: You have succeeded in putting down the avian threat. Report your deeds to Ponnixia.
TEXT_BANSYL201_01267_SEQ_03: Ponnixia is grateful for your efforts in quieting the latest threat to the forest, and expresses her hope that one day the birds can be trained to be less antagonistic.
TEXT_BANSYL202_01268_SEQ_00: Ponnixia just wants to take her mind off her troubles.
TEXT_BANSYL202_01268_SEQ_01: Ponnixia is finding fun to be elusive in recent days, and seeks to acquire dreamslime to enhance the potency of her beloved milkroot. Unfortunately, the much sought-after substance is being monopolized by selfish touched ones. Acquire four phials of dreamtoad ooze, either straight from the source or from the inebriated sylphs who are already partaking in its pleasures.
TEXT_BANSYL202_01268_SEQ_02: You have obtained four phials of the unsightly yet highly treasured ooze. Deliver the goods to Ponnixia.
TEXT_BANSYL202_01268_SEQ_03: Ponnixia's eyes light up at the sight of the ooze. While the potent milkroot concoction will not resolve the many troubles that her people face, it will at least serve to return smiles to their faces.
TEXT_BANSYL203_01269_SEQ_00: Something in the air has Ponnixia distressed.
TEXT_BANSYL203_01269_SEQ_01: Malevolent sylphs have been working their mischief on the forest's mushrooms, lacing them with a poisonous powder that coaxes them to emit toxic fumes. Wash them with spring water to spare the sylphs of Little Solace from a coughing epidemic.
TEXT_BANSYL203_01269_SEQ_02: You have doused the mushrooms, removing their poisonous properties. Inform Ponnixia she may breathe easy again.
TEXT_BANSYL203_01269_SEQ_03: Ponnixia takes a deep breath, savoring the clean, crisp forest air. Once again, you have proven yourself a true friend to Little Solace and its inhabitants.
TEXT_BANSYL204_01270_SEQ_00: Some of Ponnixia's friends have been enjoying more than their fair share of milkroot.
TEXT_BANSYL204_01270_SEQ_01: A pack of sylphs under the influence of particularly potent milkroot is wreaking havoc in Little Solace. Deliver them a solid beating on Ponnixia's behalf, topped off with a splash of spring water to rouse them from their drunken stupor.
TEXT_BANSYL204_01270_SEQ_02: The tipsy sylphs have been dealt with, returning peace to Little Solace. Inform Ponnixia that the deed is done.
TEXT_BANSYL204_01270_SEQ_03: Ponnixia expresses her thanks for your efforts, along with a hope that her people will learn that milkroot is best enjoyed in moderation.
TEXT_BANSYL205_01271_SEQ_00: Ponnixia fears for the safety of the forest.
TEXT_BANSYL205_01271_SEQ_01: Explosives strewn about Larkscall by the malevolent sylphs of the Sylphlands threaten the safety of all who call the forest home, and only the formidable team of adventurer and goobbue can set things right. Speak to the amiable sylph in Larkscall and mount the great beast.
TEXT_BANSYL205_01271_SEQ_02: Few experiences are as exhilarating as a romp through the forest on goobbueback. But this is no time for idle recreation─employ the goobbue's sneeze to fling the sylphmade bombs into oblivion.
TEXT_BANSYL205_01271_SEQ_03: Thanks to the efforts of you and your oversized friend, Larkscall is safe once more. Inform Ponnixia that all is well.
TEXT_BANSYL205_01271_SEQ_04: Ponnixia is deeply grateful for your efforts on behalf of her people. She also envies your goobbue ride, expressing a desire to visit Larkscall in the near future so she might enjoy the same.
TEXT_BANSYL206_01272_SEQ_00: Ponnixia wears a disgusted expression on her face.
TEXT_BANSYL206_01272_SEQ_01: Ponnixia relates how the giant sporeshooter in the Sylphlands, crafted long ago to purify the forest air, has been modified by the touched sylphs to expel poisonous fumes, and bids you to restore the device to its original benign state. First, use the scalebombs she has provided you to destroy the lightning rods that are generating the sporeshooter's power.
TEXT_BANSYL206_01272_SEQ_02: You have succeeded in destroying the lightning rods that were powering the sporeshooter. Use the spring water to purify the crystal housed within.
TEXT_BANSYL206_01272_SEQ_03: Thanks to your efforts, the air of the Sylphlands has been restored to its original pristine state. Share tidings of your triumph with Ponnixia.
TEXT_BANSYL206_01272_SEQ_04: Ponnixia takes in the fresh air and thanks you profusely for your efforts. The sylphs of Little Solace clearly consider you a valuable ally, and will continue to rely on your protection.
TEXT_BANSYL207_01273_SEQ_00: Ponnixia seeks aid in tending to the fungi of the forest.
TEXT_BANSYL207_01273_SEQ_01: Ponnixia would have you provide water for the moonspore, a giant mushroom that shines bright in the shadowy Sylphlands. Ponnixia encourages you to seek the assistance of the spell-crafting mysterious sylph before embarking, to ensure that your presence goes undetected by the darkness-favoring touched sylphs who dwell within.
TEXT_BANSYL207_01273_SEQ_02:
The mysterious sylph works her magic to render you transparent. Steal three phials of deepspring water from the hostile sylphs.

※You must complete the task before the enchantment expires. The fragrant blooms you encounter on your path will extend the duration of the spell.
TEXT_BANSYL207_01273_SEQ_03: You have surreptitiously obtained three phials of deepspring water from the unsuspecting sylphs. Provide the thirsting moonspore with the sustenance it requires.
TEXT_BANSYL207_01273_SEQ_04: Rejuvenated by the pristine waters, the moonspore shimmers and glows ever brighter. Inform Ponnixia that the deed is done.
TEXT_BANSYL207_01273_SEQ_05: Heartened to hear that the moonspore will continue to shine strong in the darkness, Ponnixia thanks you for your efforts. Once again, you have proven yourself a beacon of hope to Little Solace.
TEXT_BANSYL208_01274_SEQ_00: Ponnixia is not impressed with the sneaky ones' latest scheme.
TEXT_BANSYL208_01274_SEQ_01: As Ponnixia tells it, malevolent sylphs are employing a skin-changing spell to disguise themselves as treasure caskets, leading many an inexperienced adventurer to his doom. Use the clearsight scalebombs she has furnished you with to put an end to their ruse.
TEXT_BANSYL208_01274_SEQ_02: Fearing further retribution, the malevolent sylphs have abandoned their charade. Inform Ponnixia that they will trouble your fellow walking ones no more.
TEXT_BANSYL208_01274_SEQ_03: Ponnixia is delighted to hear that you have foiled the sneaky ones' ruse. It would seem that your friendship has fostered in the sylphs a measure of affection for others of your kind.
TEXT_BANSYL209_01275_SEQ_00: Ponnixia appears quite pleased with herself.
TEXT_BANSYL209_01275_SEQ_01: Ponnixia has devised an ingenious way to get revenge on the greedy sylphs who have been stealing precious pumpkins from Little Solace. Make for the entrance to the Sylphlands and take Ponnixia's handcrafted pumpkin bombs in hand.
TEXT_BANSYL209_01275_SEQ_02:
While the strength in your arms remains, deliver the explosive pumpkins to a location deep in the Sylphlands where they are likely to be seen by the thieving sylphs.

※Should your strength begin to wane, you may find respite at the patches of luminous moongrass along the way.
TEXT_BANSYL209_01275_SEQ_03: You have successfully delivered the pumpkin bombs to their destination. Report your success to Ponnixia.
TEXT_BANSYL209_01275_SEQ_04: Ponnixia is beside herself with glee knowing that the thieving sylphs will finally have their deeds repaid in kind. In demonstrating your strength as well as an appreciation for the finer points of sylph humor, you have further endeared yourself to Ponnixia and her kind.
TEXT_BANSYL210_01276_SEQ_00: Ponnixia has a dirty job, but some one has to do it.
TEXT_BANSYL210_01276_SEQ_01: Malicious sylphs are polluting the Sylphlands with a particularly unpleasant strain of the banestool, bringing considerable harm to the local flora and fauna. Slay two of the foul fungi to stave off further contamination of the forest.
TEXT_BANSYL210_01276_SEQ_02: The greater banestools will stink up the Sylphlands no more. Ponnixia will be pleased to hear of your success.
TEXT_BANSYL210_01276_SEQ_03: Ponnixia appreciates your efforts in making the forest a more desirable place for her and her people to reside. She thanks you for your services and urges you to stay close by should she again require your aid.
TEXT_BANSYL301_01277_SEQ_00: Moxia believes milkroot is best used in moderation.
TEXT_BANSYL301_01277_SEQ_01: Moxia fears that excessive consumption of milkroot by the sylphs of the Sylphlands is contributing to their descent into madness. Get at the root of the problem by chopping down milkroot clusters or milkroot saplings, and harvest six bundles of fresh milkroot to prevent the substance from falling into the hands of those who would misuse it.
TEXT_BANSYL301_01277_SEQ_02: You have harvested six bundles of fresh milkroot, decimating the naughty ones' supply in the process. Deliver your haul to Moxia.
TEXT_BANSYL301_01277_SEQ_03: Moxia thanks you profusely for the milkroot, praising its exceptional freshness while giving nary a mention of her original aim in sending you to harvest it. For all her talk of moderation, it is evident that Moxia rather enjoys the root herself. Though it may not be the adventurer's place to begrudge the beleaguered sylph the occasional moment of levity, one can only hope that she knows when to say when.
TEXT_BANSYL302_01278_SEQ_00: The sylphs find themselves in a sticky wicket once more, and Moxia would have you provide a solution.
TEXT_BANSYL302_01278_SEQ_01: The dark sylphs that inhabit the Sylphlands are at their nastiness again, this time feeding three of Moxia's friends to the sylph-eating gapemaw plants, and sealing their fearsome maws shut to prevent any attempts at escape. The perpetrators of the mischief─violet screeches, sighs, and snarls south of the Hanging Barbs─keep close guard over a lubric substance that might serve to foil their deed. Slay them and acquire the liquid to save the unfortunate sylphs from their fate.
TEXT_BANSYL302_01278_SEQ_02: You have slain the malevolent sylphs and obtained three phials of the lubric solution. Hurry and find the glue-enhanced gapemaws before Moxia's compatriots are digested.
TEXT_BANSYL302_01278_SEQ_03: The frightful fronds will not dine on sylph this day, for Moxia's friends have been freed by your hand. Return to Little Solace to relay the good news.
TEXT_BANSYL302_01278_SEQ_04: Moxia rejoices at the safe return of her friends, while musing about how satisfying it would be if she could feast upon the predatory plants herself. While mildly gruesome, she feels such an act would be only fitting after the anguish they have inflicted upon her people.
TEXT_BANSYL303_01279_SEQ_00: Moxia gazes wistfully in your direction.
TEXT_BANSYL303_01279_SEQ_01: Moxia relates to you the tragic tale of the ancient ones, guardians of the forest whose once-kindly hearts have been poisoned by the rampant contamination of the Sylphlands. Fighting back tears, she bids you slay the great trees and obtain three acorns.
TEXT_BANSYL303_01279_SEQ_02: You have put the sentinels out of their suffering, and obtained three acorns in the process. Next, obtain three phials of water from the springs in the vicinity of the Seedbed and the Hanging Barbs.
TEXT_BANSYL303_01279_SEQ_03: Water and acorns in hand, return to Little Solace and hand the items over to Moxia.
TEXT_BANSYL303_01279_SEQ_04: Though saddened at the sentinels' fate, Moxia is resolved to honor their memory by planting a new generation of gentle guardians. You have again proven yourself a friend to Little Solace, and this is surely not the last time the sylphs will beseech your aid.
TEXT_BANSYL304_01280_SEQ_00: Moxia's wings are aflutter with unease.
TEXT_BANSYL304_01280_SEQ_01: The ever-scheming sylphs of the Sylphlands are using their transformation magic to disguise themselves as influential Gridanians, with the intent of spreading malicious rumors about Little Solace and its inhabitants. See to it that the falsehoods die before they reach the ears of the populace.
TEXT_BANSYL304_01280_SEQ_02: The impostors have been revealed for what they are and dealt with accordingly. Assure Moxia that no ill rumors regarding her kind will be spread in Gridania.
TEXT_BANSYL304_01280_SEQ_03: Though appreciative of your efforts, Moxia fears that the schemes of her malicious kinsmen will only grow more treacherous in the future. The sylphs of Little Solace continue to depend on your bravery and kindness.
TEXT_BANSYL305_01281_SEQ_00: Moxia wears an oddly coy expression on her face.
TEXT_BANSYL305_01281_SEQ_01: The touched sylphs of the Sylphlands have fashioned devices to inundate the forest air with a constant stream of milkroot mist, imparting an altered state of mind on all sylphs who draw near─the uncharacteristically amorous Moxia included. Moxia entrusts to you two phials of morbol gall, an acidic substance derived from morbol bile, and urges you to speak with the mysterious sylph at the entrance to the Sylphlands before embarking on your mission.
TEXT_BANSYL305_01281_SEQ_02:
The mysterious sylph works her magic to render you transparent. Seek out the milkmist makers and destroy them using Moxia's morbol gall.

※You must complete the task before the enchantment expires. The fragrant blooms you encounter on your path will extend the duration of the spell.
TEXT_BANSYL305_01281_SEQ_03: With the milkmist makers dissolved by the power of morbol bile, the forest air begins to clear. Report your success to Moxia.
TEXT_BANSYL305_01281_SEQ_04: Moxia thanks you for your efforts, making sure to reiterate that her odd behavior before was solely due to milkmist exposure. That said, she will doubtless have occasion to call upon your aid again.
TEXT_BANSYL306_01282_SEQ_00: Moxia laments what has become of the once-pristine forest.
TEXT_BANSYL306_01282_SEQ_01: Driven mad by their fear of outsiders, the touched sylphs fail to realize that their misguided efforts to protect the forest are instead slowly destroying it. Moxia sends you to the heart of the Sylphlands to plant moongrass, that its ethereal aroma might serve to purify the tainted forest air. First, see to any hostile sylphs in the vicinity so that your planting efforts will not be interrupted.
TEXT_BANSYL306_01282_SEQ_02: You have slain a pair of touched sylphs that sought to thwart your efforts. Now plant the moongrass in a location where the forest breezes will carry its fragrant aroma throughout the Sylphlands.
TEXT_BANSYL306_01282_SEQ_03: Though the moongrass has only just been planted, you can already feel the air around you begin to clear. Return to Little Solace and inform Moxia that the forest breathes easier now.
TEXT_BANSYL306_01282_SEQ_04: Moxia extols your bravery, and expresses hope that one day her misguided kin will see the light. You have proven yourself a staunch ally to Little Solace once more.
TEXT_BANSYL307_01283_SEQ_00: Moxia fears for the safety of the little ones.
TEXT_BANSYL307_01283_SEQ_01: Moxia explains to you how newborn sylphs sprout forth from “podlings,” which are bulb-like objects that must be incubated deep in the heart of the Sylphlands. With touched sylphs ever looking to steal away podlings to add to their numbers, Moxia would ask your aid in delivering a ready-to-sprout podling back to the safety of Little Solace. Travel to the Seedbed and take the podling in hand.
TEXT_BANSYL307_01283_SEQ_02:
You have successfully retrieved the podling. Deliver it to the specified location, where two sylphs of Little Solace await.

※To bolster your strength while carrying the podling, interact with the patches of moongrass that you find along the way.
TEXT_BANSYL307_01283_SEQ_03: You have safely navigated the most dangerous depths of the Sylphlands and delivered the podling to the waiting hands of the sylphs. Inform Moxia that the little one is safe.
TEXT_BANSYL307_01283_SEQ_04: Moxia joyously informs you that a healthy little one has sprouted forth from the podling you helped deliver to safety, leading to much rejoicing among the sylphs of Little Solace. She fears, however, that the touched sylphs will not cease their attempt to rob the Seedbed, and asks that you lend your aid again.
TEXT_BANSYL308_01284_SEQ_00: Moxia looks at you pleadingly, a tear welling in her eye.
TEXT_BANSYL308_01284_SEQ_01: A great boar by the name of Kafre, once a beloved pet of the sylphs, has gone mad and now runs wild in the Sylphlands, goring all in sight with its fearsome tusks. Distraught at what has become of her erstwhile friend, Moxia makes the difficult but necessary decision of asking you to put the beast down. Participate in the FATE “What a Boar” in the western reaches of the Sylphlands and return to Moxia with proof that the deed is done.
TEXT_BANSYL308_01284_SEQ_02: Moxia is greatly heartened to see the tusk and learn that Kafre was not slain, but merely driven away. Moved at your kindness and courage, she offers her profuse gratitude, while hoping against hope that the great boar might return to Little Solace one day a gentler beast.
TEXT_BANSYL309_01285_SEQ_00: Moxia wears a self-satisfied grin on her face.
TEXT_BANSYL309_01285_SEQ_01: The ever-enterprising Moxia has devised what she believes to be the key to a nonviolent resolution with her touched kin. Take the so-called “fuddle-bombs” to the Hanging Barbs and souse the touched sylphs into forgetting any hurtful schemes they might be plotting.
TEXT_BANSYL309_01285_SEQ_02: The touched sylphs emerged from the clouds of milkroot in a considerably more amiable mood than before. Return to Moxia and inform her that her invention has lived entirely up to expectations.
TEXT_BANSYL309_01285_SEQ_03: Moxia is exceedingly pleased─both with herself for the ingenuity of her invention and with you for assisting in the deed. Once again, you have proven yourself a true friend to the sylphs of Little Solace.
TEXT_BANSYL310_01286_SEQ_00: Moxia would have you see to some foul inhabitants of the forest.
TEXT_BANSYL310_01286_SEQ_01: The malicious sylphs have been planting banestools in the vicinity of the Hanging Barbs, threatening the well-being of all who reside in the surrounding environs. Slay two of the formidable fungi.
TEXT_BANSYL310_01286_SEQ_02: The banestools have been dealt with. Inform Moxia that she has two less fungi to fear.
TEXT_BANSYL310_01286_SEQ_03: While grateful for your efforts, Moxia still continues to lament the plight of her people. It is a sad reality that the touched sylphs' mad desire for power has blinded them to the fact that they are slowly destroying their own home.
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_SEQ_00: Trachraet seeks an adventurer with superior sleuthing skills.
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_SEQ_01: Lieutenant Trachraet reveals to you a troubling development: a Maelstrom convoy was recently intercepted, the unidentified perpetrators absconding with a vital shipment of saltpeter. He beseeches your aid, asking you to travel to Swiftperch in western La Noscea to assist Lieutenant Skaetswys, the officer tasked with leading the investigation.
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_SEQ_02: Lieutenant Skaetswys is grateful for your assistance, as her subordinates have thus far not demonstrated much in the way of investigative skills. Search Swiftperch for the evidence which has thus far eluded her grasp.
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_SEQ_03: A thorough scouring of Swiftperch has turned up a misshapen pickaxe of curious make. Could this be a tool left behind by the saltpeter thieves? Present it to Lieutenant Skaetswys in hopes that it sheds light on her inquiry.
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_SEQ_04: Upon a close examination of the pick, Skaetswys is now convinced that the ambush of the convoy was carried out by a band of kobolds. Accompany Skaetswys to Camp Overlook and seek out Commander Bloeidin, whose vast knowledge of the tunnel-dwelling beastmen will prove vital in determining a proper course of action.
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_SEQ_05: Upon your arrival at Camp Overlook, a captive kobold under interrogation by Commander Bloeidin is quick to confess that a notorious order of his kin, the 789th, were the masterminds behind the saltpeter theft. Exercising due caution, infiltrate their den of villainy and rendezvous once more with Skaetswys.
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_SEQ_06: No sooner do you arrive at the dig and locate the stolen supplies than does the 789th Order sniff out your presence, quickly surrounding you. The mystery then deepens, however, when the vicious kobolds surrender the stolen goods with nary a fight. Speak with Skaetswys again, that the two of you might puzzle out exactly what has transpired.
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_SEQ_07: Thoroughly confused by the kobolds' behavior, Skaetswys nonetheless elects to put off any further pondering until the supplies are safely conveyed to their original destination. Before setting off for Camp Overlook, she encourages you to explore the dig and seek out the leader of the 789th, that you might glean some knowledge of the surprisingly nonconfrontational kobolds.
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_SEQ_08: The foreman of the 789th, an uninspiring kobold by the name of Gi Gu, sheepishly expresses his remorse for his order's actions, while insisting that they only stooped to common thievery due to extenuating circumstances. It would seem there is more to these kobolds' plight than meets the eye...
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_SEQ_00: 789th Order Pickman Gi Gu looks your way with pleading eyes.
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_SEQ_01: Gi Gu shares with you the sad tale of the 789th Order─unable to meet the demanding quotas imposed upon them by their betters, they have been exiled from the tunnels and forced to eke out a meager existence on the fringes of kobold society. While the only route to redemption is to improve their mining output, this is easier said than done, for the ore veins in their new home are as good as barren. Answer Gi Gu's sad plea by traveling to the Kobold Dig and retrieving the dregs cast aside by his more accomplished peers, that the 789th might salvage even a scrap of dignity.
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_SEQ_02: You retrieved a few misshapen chunks of low-grade ore─not much to look at, but still a fair sight more than Gi Gu and his men have been able to muster for quite some time. Deliver your haul to Gi Gu, that he might have some chance of appeasing his superiors at his forthcoming evaluation.
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_SEQ_03: Gi Gu welcomes your contributions, and begs you to keep him company until the conclusion of his evaluation that he might be spared the wrath of Zo Ga─a particularly intimidating superior who has little patience for the underperforming 789th. Stand off and observe the inner workings of kobold society from the shadows.
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_SEQ_04: 13th Order Fugleman Zo Ga haughtily dismisses not merely the mining efforts of the 789th Order, but their very right to exist. It would seem that Zo Ga's ideal vision of kobold society takes the concept of survival of the fittest to rather unforgiving extremes. Speak with the visibly shaken Gi Gu and offer what comfort you can.
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_SEQ_05: Your heart-to-heart with Gi Gu was interrupted by Lieutenant Skaetswys, herself having just returned from Camp Overlook. Appalled at the pickman's utter lack of pride and dignity, she has sworn to lend her strength to the 789th, that they might stand up to their oppressors. Speak once more with Gi Gu and see how he feels about the offer.
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_SEQ_06: Equally as afraid of Skaetswys as he is of Zo Ga, the faltering Gi Gu would ask you to remain close by and lend your services to the 789th Order. The pickman, for his part, seems quite content to shrink in the shadows while others do the dirty work, but mayhap your efforts on the dig's behalf will embolden him yet...
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_SEQ_00: 789th Order Pickman Gi Gu is not through imposing on your generosity.
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_SEQ_01: Your efforts on behalf of the hapless 789th Order have endeared you to its leader, Gi Gu, who would repay this kindness the only way he knows how─by delegating additional tasks to you. His latest imposition, however, is interrupted by Skaetswys, who urgently requests your support in driving off a particularly vicious horde of kobolds that have set upon Camp Overlook with a particularly potent new weapon at their disposal.
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_SEQ_02: You arrive at Camp Overlook to find the kobold attack has been repelled, but at great cost. Unless the kobolds' new weapon is dealt with, the brave men and women of the Maelstrom have slim hope of surviving the next attack. At Skaetswys's behest, return to the 789th Order and inquire with Gi Gu as to the best course of action.
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_SEQ_03: The unreliable Gi Gu suspects that the kobolds who attacked Camp Overlook were none other than the 13th Order, and their fearsome firepower is the product of Zo Ga's dastardly new weapon. Ever quick to delegate responsibility, he sends you in search of an acolyte of the 789th Order, one Ba Go.
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_SEQ_04: The eccentric Ba Go, a former associate of Zo Ga's who was relieved of his position, is eager─perhaps a bit too eager─to create mass mayhem by blowing the top off the 13th Order's new furnace. Locate the entrance to their workshop in northern Iron Lake, and seek passage from the alchemist Ga Zi.
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_SEQ_05: With the help of a reluctant Ga Zi, you have successfully infiltrated the alchemical workshop of the 13th Order. Rendezvous with Ba Go before the prototype furnace.
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_SEQ_06: Ba Go requires additional time to prepare for the sabotage of the furnace, but fears being caught in the act by Zo Ga's lackeys. Stand watch by the entrance and see to any foes who would interrupt the sabotage operation.
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_SEQ_07: You have dispatched the ill-fated kobolds who wandered into the workshop. Return to Ba Go and assure him that there is no fear of being interrupted.
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_SEQ_08: Ba Go entrusts to you some of his so-called beauties, seemingly intelligent bombs designed for the express purpose of rendering a furnace unusable. Pop the top and toss them in, then stand back and enjoy the fireworks.
