TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_SEQ_09: The sparks and smoke exuded by the furnace suggest that it is no longer functioning in any real capacity. It would appear that your work here is done. Make for the exit and speak once more with the gleeful Ba Go.
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_SEQ_10: Eager to return to his research, Ba Go dashes hastily back to the 789th Order Dig. Follow suit and deliver word of your success to Gi Gu.
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_SEQ_11: No sooner did you share the news of your triumph than did a comely young kobold by the name of Bi Bi arrive to express her displeasure at Gi Gu's actions, fearing for his safety. Eager to defer to the wishes of his apparent love, yet fearing Skaetswys's wrath if he backs down, Gi Gu succeeds only in underwhelming all present with his utter lack of anything resembling decisive leadership. It would appear the pusillanimous pickman will be dependent on your aid for the foreseeable future...
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_SEQ_00: Recent reports from Camp Overlook have Skaetswys ill at ease.
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_SEQ_01: As Skaetswys tells it, officers at Camp Overlook are gravely concerned about the recent movements of Zo Ga and his followers in light of your recent sabotage efforts. Fearing the wrath of her superior, she asks you to report to Commander Bloeidin in her stead.
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_SEQ_02: Commander Bloeidin chews out you and Skaetswys for fanning the flames in U'Ghamaro, demanding that the two of you take responsibility for the resulting chaos. Return to the 789th Order Dig and consult with Skaetswys as to the best course of action.
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_SEQ_03: Your conversation with Skaetswys is interrupted by a frantic Gi Gu, who is concerned about the fate of his beloved Bi Bi, yet─as expected─far too cowardly to take any action of his own. Make for the Kobold Dig before any dire fate befalls her.
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_SEQ_04: You spot Bi Bi in the clutches of a particularly nasty group of kobolds. Dispatch her tormentors and free the poor kobold lass from her bonds.
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_SEQ_05: Though grateful to be rescued, the loss of something she was carrying has Bi Bi in a fluster. Search the Kobold Dig for her missing plans.
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_SEQ_06: You have managed to find what appear to be plans for a new prototype furnace. Deliver the plans to Bi Bi and see if this is indeed her missing property.
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_SEQ_07: A tearful Bi Bi explains that the plans you found were drafted by her at Zo Ga's behest, under threat of exile if she did not comply with his wishes. Furthermore, she makes a shocking confession that she shares Gi Gu's affections, and wishes only to see him show signs of courage before making her feelings known. She bids you deliver a letter that she hopes will stir Gi Gu to action.
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_SEQ_08: Bi Bi's missive explains in detail Zo Ga's plan to employ a new furnace to wreak havoc upon all who oppose him, as well as the punishment that awaits the kobold lass should she refuse to lend the fugleman her aid. His beloved's life in danger, Gi Gu is spurred to uncommon action─which involves walking a few yalms to where Ba Go stands and asking the acolyte to take care of the rest. Meanwhile, Skaetswys fears that Zo Ga's cravings for death and destruction might mean trouble for more than just the 789th Order. She vows to join the hapless kobolds in their fight, and hopes that you will do the same.
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_SEQ_09: Ever unimpressed by the hapless Gi Gu, Skaetswys nevertheless is convinced that it is in everyone's best interests that Zo Ga be stopped once and for all. Continue to lend your strength to the 789th Order, that the brutal bully might be cut down to size.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_SEQ_00: As is his wont, 789th Order Pickman Gi Gu is fretting and fidgeting.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_SEQ_01: A visibly harried Gi Gu stammers to you some incoherent babbling about his beloved Bi Bi urging him to flee the dig. Pressed for a reason, Gi Gu confesses that he was too frightened to ask. Seek out Bi Bi for yourself and see what is amiss.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_SEQ_02: Bi Bi had only begun to reveal the latest plan of the scheming Zo Ga when the ever-intimidating 13th Order Fugleman came storming to the scene. Enraged at all those plotting against him, he accosted Bi Bi, demanding that she lend her alchemical prowess to his odious plot. Speak with Gi Gu─who is unlikely to offer any constructive advice─and decide on a course of action.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_SEQ_03: A rousing rally from Lieutenant Skaetswys has seemingly instilled Gi Gu with the courage to strike back at Zo Ga's oppression. The operation will require a healthy quantity of explosives, which you have agreed to procure from the alchemist Ba Go in the labor-shy Gi Gu's stead.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_SEQ_04: The eccentric Ba Go, concerned about little more than seeing things go boom, has entrusted to you a veritable arsenal of bombs for the assault on U'Ghamaro. Infiltrate the mines and set limpet bombs at suitable locations.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_SEQ_05: The first set of bombs has been successfully placed. Report to Lieutenant Skaetswys for further instructions.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_SEQ_06: Your task continues. Head deeper into the mines and place three more limpet bombs while Skaetswys stands on the lookout for Zo Ga's men.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_SEQ_07: You have succeeded in placing the remaining bombs. Inform Skaetswys that the deed is done.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_SEQ_08: With the groundwork for the operation successfully laid, Skaetswys suggests that you pay a visit to the 13th Order workshop to ensure that Gi Gu holds up his end of the agreement. Speak again with the lieutenant, who stands before the workshop's front door.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_SEQ_09: You have successfully infiltrated the workshop, yet it appears Gi Gu is taking his precious time with his duties. Seek him out and give him a word or two of encouragement.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_SEQ_10: For the first time since you met him─if not in his entire life─789th Order Pickman Gi Gu has followed through on his word. With the final bomb set directly on Zo Ga's prized furnace, you and your comrades can take your leave. Speak with Lieutenant Skaetswys by the workshop exit.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_SEQ_11: When your escape from the workshop was intercepted, the heretofore-hapless 789th Order Pickman Gi Gu summoned a measure of courage from gods-know-where, defeating the formidable 13th Order Fugleman Zo Ga and sending all present into a state of utter disbelief in the process. Return to the 789th Order Dig and congratulate the unlikely hero on his startling victory.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_SEQ_12: Instilled with courage from his victory over his longtime oppressor, 789th Order Pickman Gi Gu has vowed to channel his newfound strength into leading his kobolds into a new age of prosperity─after he indulges in a well-deserved rest, of course. Despite lingering doubts, Lieutenant Skaetswys expresses her relief at this turn of events, and encourages you to deliver news of your success to Lieutenant Trachraet in Limsa.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_SEQ_13: Lieutenant Trachraet applauds your efforts in the Kobold Dig on behalf of Maelstrom. With Zo Ga removed from power and the 789th poised to rise to a position of influence, the day that Lominsans and kobolds live in peace may not be as far off as once thought.
TEXT_BANKOB101_01325_SEQ_00: 789th Order Dustman Bo Zu is half-starved and can't be arsed to do much about it.
TEXT_BANKOB101_01325_SEQ_01: After much racking of his hunger-addled brain, Bo Zu has hit upon a plan to procure sustenance with minimal-to-no effort on his own part. To wit: you will bring ore to Camp Overlook under the pretense that you confiscated it from the kobolds' stock, requesting spare rations as reward for your efforts. As the dustman himself has no intention of parting with his own meager mining haul, travel to Iron Lake and acquire the necessary ore in his stead.
TEXT_BANKOB101_01325_SEQ_02: You have managed to acquire only a few chunks of the shabbiest-looking ore you have ever seen. Bring them to Camp Overlook, hoping that the quartermaster will pity you enough to offer some scant reward.
TEXT_BANKOB101_01325_SEQ_03: Rightfully unimpressed with your donation, the quartermaster tosses some leftovers from last night's supper your way with a strongly worded suggestion that you bother her no further. Take your sorry haul back to Bo Zu at the 789th Order Dig.
TEXT_BANKOB101_01325_SEQ_04: Bo Zu is overjoyed at your efforts─the unappetizing nature of the meal outweighed by the fact that it was acquired without him lifting so much as a single paw. You cannot shake the feeling that the work-shy kobold will not hesitate to employ similar tactics in the near future...
TEXT_BANKOB102_01326_SEQ_00: 789th Order Dustman Bo Zu wants his dinner, but he'll be damned if he's going to work for it.
TEXT_BANKOB102_01326_SEQ_01: The labor-averse Bo Zu has caught word of generous meals being distributed by Zo Ga to those industrious kobolds who have earned the fugleman's favor, and has concluded that the 789th is equally deserving of gustatory gratification despite their decided lack of productivity. Head to Iron Lake and appropriate three lavish lunchpots so that Bo Zu and his friends can feast like their hard-working peers for a day.
TEXT_BANKOB102_01326_SEQ_02: You have managed to secure three piping hot lunchpots. Deliver the feast to the 789th Order Dig in hopes that it will sate the stomach of the slavering Bo Zu.
TEXT_BANKOB102_01326_SEQ_03: Bo Zu revels in the fruits of your success, though any hopes that the dustman has learned a lesson about the value of hard work are promptly dashed when he shamelessly expresses his eagerness to impose upon you similarly again. You can only hope that the idle-handed kobold's stomach remains sated for the foreseeable future.
TEXT_BANKOB103_01327_SEQ_00: 789th Order Dustman Bo Zu's all-too-healthy appetite has gotten him into hot water.
TEXT_BANKOB103_01327_SEQ_01: Bo Zu fears that he will incur the ire of the 789th's hot-tempered acolyte, Ba Go, for munching on─of all things─the appendages of the latter's precious bombs. Travel to Iron Lake and pluck three digits from the hands of the grenades hovering about the area, that you might make amends for the gluttonous dustman's misdeeds.
TEXT_BANKOB103_01327_SEQ_02: Three grenade digits are yours. Deliver them to Ba Go at the 789th Order Dig before he visits flaming destruction upon the rueful Bo Zu.
TEXT_BANKOB103_01327_SEQ_03: Ba Go was already wise to Bo Zu's misdeeds, having suffered similar antics before. He accepts the digits you have procured for him, but has little intention of forgiving his friend. Fortunately for Bo Zu, the acolyte is more concerned with mending his beauties than seeking revenge.
TEXT_BANKOB103_01327_SEQ_04: Sufficiently shaken by Ba Go's threats, Bo Zu will endeavor not to feast on the acolyte's beauties in the future. With the vain hope that the dustman's brain is stronger than his belly, you take your leave...
TEXT_BANKOB104_01328_SEQ_00: 789th Order Dustman Bo Zu is mad as hells, and you're not going to take it anymore.
TEXT_BANKOB104_01328_SEQ_01: Bo Zu is boiling with anger at the kobolds of the 639th Order, who take perverse pride and pleasure in browbeating the 789th despite their similar position at the arse end of the kobold hierarchy. To serve them their just deserts, venture to Iron Lake and deliver a good thrashing to two of their rank and file to attract the attention of their overseer, upon whom you may then visit a similar fate.
TEXT_BANKOB104_01328_SEQ_02: The overseer has been taught the true meaning of pain, giving the 639th a valuable lesson about getting too big for one's breeches. Return to the 789th Order Dig and assure Bo Zu that the bullies have paid the price for their false pride.
TEXT_BANKOB104_01328_SEQ_03: His oppressors having been given their just dues, Bo Zu breathes a sigh of relief and extols your virtues as a capable adventurer. For better or for worse, the dustman will not hesitate to seek your aid the next time he suffers at the hands of his betters...
TEXT_BANKOB105_01329_SEQ_00: 789th Order Dustman Bo Zu is looking for an adventurer to defuse a problem of burgeoning proportions.
TEXT_BANKOB105_01329_SEQ_01: Angered by the attention Ba Go lavishes upon his younger, prettier creations, a trio of breeding bombs has broken free from the acolyte's workshop and are wreaking havoc around Iron Lake. Quell their rage with a good beating and return their cores to Bo Zu.
TEXT_BANKOB105_01329_SEQ_02: You have defused the threat and acquired the three cores. Return to the 789th Order Dig and hand the fruits of your labor to Bo Zu.
TEXT_BANKOB105_01329_SEQ_03: Bo Zu expresses his gratitude for your efforts. Though it was originally his intention to return the cores to Ba Go, the dustman has reconsidered, fearing that this would further fan the flames of jealousy harbored by the acolyte's volatile beauties...
TEXT_BANKOB106_01330_SEQ_00: 789th Order Dustman Bo Zu is appalled─outraged, shocked, appalled─by a shameless display of industriousness and ambition.
TEXT_BANKOB106_01330_SEQ_01: With a disapproving scowl, Bo Zu relates the recent exploits of the 596th Order, a once-hapless band of kobolds who are recently climbing the ranks with a most contemptible work ethic. Seek the assistance of 789th Order Acolyte Ba Go, that you might deprive the self-righteous lot of the fruits of their labor and teach them the important lesson that hard work never pays.
TEXT_BANKOB106_01330_SEQ_02: The eccentric Ba Go, always eager to be a part of any plot that involves large-scale death and destruction, furnishes you with a few of his hot-tempered beauties and some coal to direct them to their targets. In return for his aid, he also demands that you recover at least one of the bomb cores from the resulting rubble after the act of sabotage is done. Head to the 596th's new dig northeast of Camp Overlook and place the coal per the acolyte's instructions.
TEXT_BANKOB106_01330_SEQ_03: You have successfully placed the coal on three small piles of supplies. Leave a wide enough berth, then release Ba Go's beauties to finish the job.
TEXT_BANKOB106_01330_SEQ_04: Ba Go's beauties have performed their task admirably, resulting in a firestorm of destruction of which the mad acolyte would be proud. Search the rubble for one of the bomb cores left over from the explosions.
TEXT_BANKOB106_01330_SEQ_05: You have successfully recovered the bomb core. Return to the 789th Order Dig and deliver it to Ba Go.
TEXT_BANKOB106_01330_SEQ_06: Ba Go is pleased, both with the success of his lovingly crafted creations and your ability to recover the core he sought. Eager to return to his work, the acolyte dismisses you abruptly, asking you to report to Bo Zu.
TEXT_BANKOB106_01330_SEQ_07: Sloth and sluggardy have won the day, and there is much rejoicing from Bo Zu. The 789th must remain wary, however, as one never knows when another rogue kobold order might fall prey to the siren call of gainful effort and exertion. Should such a dark day descend, the dustman would call upon your aid anew...
TEXT_BANKOB107_01331_SEQ_00: 789th Order Dustman Bo Zu will not stand for enterprise or ingenuity─no, no, he will not.
TEXT_BANKOB107_01331_SEQ_01: Much to Bo Zu's chagrin, the 639th─a heretofore-hapless order which inhabits the neighboring tunnels─has invented a new digger with the potential to open prodigiously profitable veins of ore for the mining. In this kobold-eat-kobold world, fortune for the 639th would entrench the 789th even deeper into their current rut. At Bo Zu's urgent behest, speak with the acolyte Ba Go and acquire the means to dash the 639th's dreams of a better life.
TEXT_BANKOB107_01331_SEQ_02: Eager as always to send waves of chaos and destruction through the tunnels, Ba Go furnishes you with supplies that should be sufficient to end the 639th's hopes of productivity and promotions. Set glowing coals about the prototype digger and prepare to stand back.
TEXT_BANKOB107_01331_SEQ_03: The coals having been set, walk a safe distance away, then release the smart bombs at the ill-fated apparatus and enjoy the sparks.
TEXT_BANKOB107_01331_SEQ_04: Their digger no more, the 639th is destined for a return to humiliation and ignominy, a development which will certainly please Bo Zu. Return to the 789th Order Dig and relay the good tidings.
TEXT_BANKOB107_01331_SEQ_05: Bo Zu praises your efforts, pleased to hear that he and his compatriots will no longer be alone at the arse end of kobold society. You have little doubt that he will seek your aid the next time an overly ambitious order employs ingenuity and inventiveness to get ahead in this subterranean rat race.
TEXT_BANKOB108_01332_SEQ_00: 789th Order Dustman Bo Zu has an uncharacteristically eager glint in his eyes.
TEXT_BANKOB108_01332_SEQ_01: In one of the more shocking developments of the Seventh Astral Era, legendary laggard Bo Zu states a desire to turn over a new leaf and do some work for a change, though he would ask your aid in summoning the necessary resolve. To that end, travel to the Kobold Dig and fetch a handful of electrum from the 639th Order, that the dustman might witness firsthand the fruit of honest labor with his own eyes.
TEXT_BANKOB108_01332_SEQ_02: You have succeeded in “borrowing” a quantity of pristine electrum from the 639th's stock. Deliver it to Bo Zu, that it might serve to boost the dustman's morale.
TEXT_BANKOB108_01332_SEQ_03: To the surprise of absolutely no one, Bo Zu decides to appropriate the borrowed electrum in the 789th's name. Though the dustman's methods are questionable, no doubt it is the abuse and oppression he and his peers suffer at the hands of Zo Ga that has driven them to such desperate measures...
TEXT_BANKOB109_01333_SEQ_00: 789th Order Dustman Bo Zu has a friend in need of a helping hand─preferably not Bo Zu's.
TEXT_BANKOB109_01333_SEQ_01: Bo Zu considers the 789th Order's acolyte, the eccentric Ba Go, one of his closest friends at the dig─a feeling which does not appear to be in any way mutual. With Ba Go in trouble and seeking the assistance of anyone not named Bo Zu, go and offer what help you may.
TEXT_BANKOB109_01333_SEQ_02: From what sense you can make of Ba Go's ramblings, a few of his so-called beauties─unhappy with their creator's treatment of them─have flown the coop and now wreak havoc in the vicinity of Iron Lake. At Ba Go's behest, seek them out and /soothe their anger, that they might return home and trouble innocent bystanders no more.
TEXT_BANKOB109_01333_SEQ_03: Their volatile hearts calmed, the pygmy bombs have returned to the loving care of their creator. Return to Ba Go in triumph.
TEXT_BANKOB109_01333_SEQ_04: Eager to make amends, Ba Go is far too preoccupied doting on his beauties to express any sort of gratitude for your part in securing their safe return. Return to Bo Zu and inform him that the deed is done.
TEXT_BANKOB109_01333_SEQ_05: Bo Zu is deeply appreciative of your efforts on behalf of his friend Ba Go, who he still considers a friend despite the latter's utter disregard for the hapless dustman. Having demonstrated both generosity and competence, you can expect Bo Zu to call upon you again next time he or one of his peers is in need...
TEXT_BANKOB110_01334_SEQ_00: 789th Order Dustman Bo Zu fears that not all of his peers share an appreciation for slopwork and subterfuge.
TEXT_BANKOB110_01334_SEQ_01: Showing once again that he will spare no effort in shirking honest work, 789th Order Dustman Bo Zu has padded his sack with rubbish and refuse to meet his daily mining quota. None the wiser, the 411th Order plans to smelt the 789th's yield in their furnace, and Bo Zu fears that his ingenuity will not be well received. At Bo Zu's request, consult with the acolyte Ba Go, that you might lay waste to the furnace before the dustman's duplicity comes to light.
TEXT_BANKOB110_01334_SEQ_02:
Ever eager to see destruction and disorder arise around him, Ba Go furnishes you with a bomb of considerable explosive power, along with instructions to carry it to your target─the 411th Order's furnace in the vicinity of Iron Lake─with all haste.

※Fail to complete your objective in the allotted span of time, and the limpet bomb will detonate, causing damage to you in the process.
TEXT_BANKOB110_01334_SEQ_03: The 411th's furnace is no more, and Bo Zu's secret remains safe for another day. Search the embers that you might return the bomb core to its creator, though you have a suspicion the spirited fireball will not come quietly...
TEXT_BANKOB110_01334_SEQ_04: You have successfully quelled the limpet bomb's temper and extracted its core. Return it to Ba Go at the 789th Order Dig, with the futile hope that his future creations will not prove so hot to handle.
TEXT_BANKOB110_01334_SEQ_05: Delighted to hear that his prized creation was every ilm as destructive as he had foreseen, Ba Go resolves to redouble his efforts in building bombs of even greater destructive power. For better or for worse, share the news of your success with Bo Zu.
TEXT_BANKOB110_01334_SEQ_06: Bo Zu breathes a sigh of relief, your efforts having ensured that his chicanery will go undetected and unpunished. Convinced that any effort to extol the virtues of honest labor would fall upon deaf ears, you take your leave, hoping against hope that the dawdling dustman's next imposition on your services will be a more constructive one...
TEXT_BANKOB201_01335_SEQ_00: Nothing ever goes smoothly at the 789th Order Dig, and Craftsman Bo Gu knows exactly whom you have to kill to keep it that way.
TEXT_BANKOB201_01335_SEQ_01: Watchmen of the 271st Order are due at the 789th Order Dig for an inspection, a mission Bo Gu feels is fundamentally incompatible with the dig's dedication to sloth and slapdashery. Derail the inspection using a bang toss at three locations at Iron Lake, then dispatch the watchmen so that they never inspect so much as a nailhead again.
TEXT_BANKOB201_01335_SEQ_02: You have relieved a sufficient number of watchmen from their duties and successfully prevented significant improvements to the dig's productivity and safety. Report the happy news to 789th Order Craftsman Bo Gu.
TEXT_BANKOB201_01335_SEQ_03: The shiftless craftsman is delighted by the outcome, and plans to resort to murder for the next inspection as well. Accept it as high praise of your effectiveness, and know that you have served a client well today.
TEXT_BANKOB202_01336_SEQ_00: Just because 789th Order Craftsman Bo Gu can't be bothered to mine a vein does not mean someone else can, no, no!
TEXT_BANKOB202_01336_SEQ_01: There is a pickman of rare talent in the 59th Order Dig, and 789th Order Craftsman Bo Gu would like him dead for the sin of success─his own as well as that of his associate, 13th Order Fugleman Zo Ga. Oblige him by completing the FATE “The Miner in the Mirror” and presenting the resulting proof of your deed to Bo Gu.
TEXT_BANKOB202_01336_SEQ_02: You deliver the Titan mythrilshield to Bo Gu, though in truth, the craftsman need not have suspected you of reticence. The now-dead pickman was hardly the maestro of the mines that Bo Gu made him out to be, and was a nasty piece of work you were happy to put six fulms under.
TEXT_BANKOB203_01337_SEQ_00: In a different life, Bo Gu may well have made a mediocre manager rather than a terrible craftsman. This day, the kobold is looking for a subcontractor for some dismemberment work.
TEXT_BANKOB203_01337_SEQ_01: Bo Gu has promises to keep, but a gouty knee─or two─keeps him from them. Surely an aching joint can be salved with a little joint venture, if you would care to speak to 789th Order Acolyte Ba Go.
TEXT_BANKOB203_01337_SEQ_02: You have spoken with the acolyte, and heard slightly more than you could bear. But an adventurer must go where there is a need, and the mad bombcrafter needs you to take the coal to the brazier at Iron Lake. The bonfire will draw warm grenades, then light their slaughter. When the hot grenade appears, slay it and lop off its arm.
TEXT_BANKOB203_01337_SEQ_03: You have acquired the arm of a hot grenade. By the lurid light of the fire are many strange deeds done. Take the unpleasant package to Ba Go at the 789th Order Dig.
TEXT_BANKOB203_01337_SEQ_04: Ba Go is much pleased, and so are you, for you successfully avoided any talk of what he plans to do with the arm. As difficult as it is not to imagine what the mention of “limb that goes boom” might presage, put a spring in your step and report to Bo Gu.
TEXT_BANKOB203_01337_SEQ_05: After enjoying a brief holiday as an upset stomach, Bo Gu's gout returns with a vengeance. The shellfish-y story notwithstanding, the kobold is proving to be a reliable customer.
TEXT_BANKOB204_01338_SEQ_00: They say there is as much destroying as creating in a craftsman's life, and Bo Gu is certainly diligent about one of those duties.
TEXT_BANKOB204_01338_SEQ_01: 13th Order Fugleman Zo Ga continues to rile Bo Gu with his foresight and acumen, and the craftsman instructs you to destroy Zo Ga's bomb incubators. The fugleman's sagacity bothers you far less than his penchant for brutally oppressing every living creature under him, but why quibble? Wreck two incubators and be done with it.
TEXT_BANKOB204_01338_SEQ_02: The bomb incubators are good and dead, thanks to you. Report the destruction to Bo Gu at the 789th Order Dig.
TEXT_BANKOB204_01338_SEQ_03: Bo Gu is delighted to hear that your mission has succeeded, though you are slightly unsettled by his cheery musings about Zo Ga's preferred fate for you should you ever be captured. Know, adventurer, that this too is the price of the life you have chosen.
TEXT_BANKOB205_01339_SEQ_00: The enemy of one's enemy is one's friend, and by that definition, Craftsman Bo Gu is definitely the kobold to know. Why not visit him for heated words and cold gil?
TEXT_BANKOB205_01339_SEQ_01: Bo Gu would like to bring the 13th Order down a peg by sabotaging their workshop. Diligent only in his discontent, the craftsman has a keen sense of who his likely allies are. The alchemist Ga Zi might well prove receptive to your approach.
TEXT_BANKOB205_01339_SEQ_02: Ga Zi is not what the 13th Order would call a team player, and is all too happy to tell you how to wreck the prototype furnace in the workshop. Ga Zi will act as the guide, and your job is to open the pressure valve once inside the workshop.
TEXT_BANKOB205_01339_SEQ_03: You have released the valve. Now, throw the rejected bomb arm inside and see how the prototype furnace deals with this particular stress test.
TEXT_BANKOB205_01339_SEQ_04: The prototype is deplorably unprepared for the rigors of consumer use. Take a moment to admire the flames, then search the embers vomited out by the dying furnace and slay any shrapnels that appear.
TEXT_BANKOB205_01339_SEQ_05: The shrapnels, bewildered as they are by the sudden dislocation from the cradling furnace, are no match for you. Check the embers again for a big shrapnel, and rip out its core.
TEXT_BANKOB205_01339_SEQ_06: The shrapnel's core is yours. Where the need is greater, the core must serve. And since the need for volatile voidsent bits is the greatest with 789th Order Acolyte Ba Go, to him must you deliver this glowing core.
TEXT_BANKOB205_01339_SEQ_07: Ba Go receives the big shrapnel core with clutching delight, and absently notes that Ga Zi has just bought himself out of a fiery demise. Report the happy ending to Bo Gu.
TEXT_BANKOB205_01339_SEQ_08: Bo Gu is over the moon, having witnessed the hated 13th Order Fugleman Zo Ga frustrated, furious and without a furnace. How Bo Gu has grown! He has come far indeed, from crude assassinations to collaborative sabotage.
TEXT_BANKOB206_01340_SEQ_00: There is a peevish avidity about Bo Gu that you recognize too well─a purpose most petty is yours to serve.
TEXT_BANKOB206_01340_SEQ_01: Cobalt golems stand between Bo Gu and what he feels is his rightful salvage. The insane kobold logic notwithstanding, go speak with alchemist Ga Zi of the 13th, who has ever been an accessory in crimes and misdemeanors against his own order.
TEXT_BANKOB206_01340_SEQ_02: The blunt-spoken alchemist finds a flaw in Bo Gu's plan, and instructs you in the finer points of destroying the golem-controlling swaystone. By dispatching four golems in the workshop near the swaystone, you can weaken it to a sufficient level.
TEXT_BANKOB206_01340_SEQ_03: Ga Zi's analogy of a clenched fist was apt; with the fall of each golem, the force binding together the swaystone weakens. A fist half-clenched only harms the hand. Use the small waymaker bomb and destroy the stone.
TEXT_BANKOB206_01340_SEQ_04: The swaystone is no more, and the golems it controlled have lost their lease on an existence never-ending─so perhaps you did them a favor as well. But of course, nobody will be as pleased by the outcome as Bo Gu, to whom you owe a courtesy report.
TEXT_BANKOB206_01340_SEQ_05: The craftsman is indeed pleased, and salivates over the coming pillage. A seasoned adventurer once told you that in this life, you would serve the mediocre more than you would the great, but that with luck, some of the mediocre would prove diverting. How lucky you are to be at the behest of Bo Gu and the 789th.
TEXT_BANKOB207_01341_SEQ_00: The world may know 789th Order Craftsman Bo Gu as a lazy bag of bones, but you know the truth: few are as industrious when it comes to foiling a hated rival's plans.
TEXT_BANKOB207_01341_SEQ_01: Intent on frustrating the ambitious Zo Ga, 789th Order Craftsman Bo Gu has concocted a plot to halt the planned upgrades to the 13th Order's prototype furnace. Since the plot is of a flammable nature─as is Bo Gu's wont─you will need to consult the bombsmith Ba Go on the best way to incinerate Zo Ga's wain full of upgrade parts.
TEXT_BANKOB207_01341_SEQ_02: Ba Go is as helpful as he is raving mad─that is to say, exceedingly so. The first thing is to mark the wain with bright coal. The alchemist Ga Zi will serve as your guide into the 13th Order workshop.
TEXT_BANKOB207_01341_SEQ_03: The alchemy wain looks quite festive with the bright coal, though not quite the fair figure of Ba Go's fevered imaginings. Release the advanced smart bombs from a safe location nearby, and let the fireworks begin.
TEXT_BANKOB207_01341_SEQ_04: The wain and its contents are thoroughly crisped; whatever Ba Go lacks in sanity, he makes up for in his knowledge of explosives. If you do not wish to share the wain's fate, obey the Acolyte's wishes and find the bomb core among the embers, subduing the still-active bomb.
TEXT_BANKOB207_01341_SEQ_05: The advanced smart bomb is no more. You are the proud guardian of a smart bomb core, and it is a beauty. You are beginning to understand something of what Ba Go sees in these things. Suppress a momentary pang and hand over the core to Ba Go.
TEXT_BANKOB207_01341_SEQ_06: In Ba Go's twitchy-yet-capable hands, the core will be reborn as a brand-new bomb. Your part in this glorious cycle of life complete, return to the 789th Order Dig and make your report to Bo Gu.
TEXT_BANKOB207_01341_SEQ_07: With the wain full of parts up in smoke, Zo Ga will not be upgrading his furnace for some time. Bo Gu is overjoyed at the success of the plot, and looks at you with new respect─or something that passes for it among his ilk.
TEXT_BANKOB208_01342_SEQ_00: Greed and envy go together like canker and mange, and Bo Gu has a mind to scratch both itches with a little help from his friends.
TEXT_BANKOB208_01342_SEQ_01: Zo Ga's trusted watchmen have hidden beguiling objects in the 13th Order workshop, and Bo Gu feels his quarters are much the better place for the mystery treasure. Let Ga Zi guide you to the workshop so that you may seize the contents of the fugleman's silverpots.
TEXT_BANKOB208_01342_SEQ_02: The silverpots prove to contain an enigma wrapped in a riddle. Whatever it is you found inside, you cannot dally, for surely the 13th Order is home to kobolds who do not share Ga Zi's inclination to bugger up the place. Deliver the contents of the silverpots to Bo Gu.
TEXT_BANKOB208_01342_SEQ_03: Bo Gu receives the contents of the silverpots with much interest and very little comprehension. He is well pleased however, for envy is his great work and greed a mere diversion. If the stolen items bring him no profit, he is still a happy kobold for having deprived Zo Ga of what he values.
TEXT_BANKOB209_01343_SEQ_00: 789th Order Craftsman Bo Gu isn't the sharpest tool in the shed, a situation he hopes to rectify.
TEXT_BANKOB209_01343_SEQ_01: Intimidated by the assemblage of alchemical geniuses working for Zo Ga at the 13th Order workshop, Bo Gu would level the intellectual playing field the only way one of his limited mental faculties can fathom─by sending an adventurer like yourself to infiltrate the workshop and bash their brains in. Seek entrance to the workshop from the ever-sympathetic Ga Zi, and hurl assorted epithets at the learned kobolds to spur them to attack and thus justify the subsequent slaughter.
TEXT_BANKOB209_01343_SEQ_02: Some of the greatest geniuses in kobold history are no more. Console yourself with the thought that they were probably up to no good anyway, and return to the 789th Order Dig to deliver news of your triumph to Bo Gu.
TEXT_BANKOB209_01343_SEQ_03: Feeling a good deal more intelligent than he did a short while ago, Bo Gu applauds your efforts to dumb down the 13th. Judging from the self-satisfied grin on his face, you have little doubt that he will be calling upon you again to carry out his next brilliant idea...
TEXT_BANKOB210_01344_SEQ_00: 789th Order Craftsman Bo Gu is not enamored with the marvels of metalworking being performed by his peers.
TEXT_BANKOB210_01344_SEQ_01: The 88th─one of many alchemically adept orders under Zo Ga's thumb─is producing cobalt in copious quantities to assist in the construction of a new furnace for the power-crazed fugleman. Bo Gu, ever looking to accomplish the most with the least effort, proposes a sabotage operation that would see the furnace destroyed and the 88th take responsibility for the mess. Inquire as to the feasibility of this plan with the dig's explosives expert, the acolyte Ba Go.
TEXT_BANKOB210_01344_SEQ_02: Ba Go is more than happy to assist the sabotage effort, which will also serve as a test run for one of his most explosive─and most unstable─creations yet. Carry the augmented limpet bomb to its target before a change of heart results in you bearing the brunt of the blast.
TEXT_BANKOB210_01344_SEQ_03: The 88th's furnace is no more, ensuring that their alchemical accomplishments will no longer benefit the tyrannical Zo Ga─or anyone else, for that matter─and that they will bear the brunt of the fugleman's fury, to boot.
TEXT_BANKOB210_01344_SEQ_04: 789th Order Craftsman Bo Gu gushes admiration for your efforts and Ba Go's alchemy, though expressing a degree of trepidation as to what might befall the 789th if he or his digmates were to incur the acolyte's ire. Your keen adventurer's senses tell you that such a day shall come soon enough, and that it will see your services needed once more...
TEXT_BANKOB301_01364_SEQ_00: 789th Order Dustman Bo Bu would see the tunnels freed from the terror of a heinous holy man and his horrific experiments.
TEXT_BANKOB301_01364_SEQ_01: Allying himself with the hated Zo Ga, a depraved bedesman has given life to a horde of alchemically augmented coblyns with a proclivity for feeding upon work-shy kobolds. Rightfully fearing for the safety of his dig, Bo Bu would see the holy man and his frightful creations sent home. Oblige this request by participating in the FATE “Full Metal Alchemist” in U'Ghamaro and bringing back proof of your triumph.
TEXT_BANKOB301_01364_SEQ_02: Bo Bu rejoices upon seeing the Titan steelshield─recompense from Zo Ga for the bedesman's foul work─knowing that he and his digmates will not be devoured by the ravenous creatures. Eager to do his part to lead his order to a new era of respectability, the dustman will no doubt have need of your services again...
TEXT_BANKOB302_01365_SEQ_00: The tunnels are teeming with a few too many of Zo Ga's followers and flunkies for 789th Order Dustman Bo Bu's liking.
TEXT_BANKOB302_01365_SEQ_01: In Bo Bu's estimation, the blustering Zo Ga has assumed his lofty position not by his own merits, but by the nigh-fanatical support of a host of formidable followers. Make for U'Ghamaro and dispatch at least five of Zo Ga's elite─roundsmen, quarrymen, priests, or bedesmen─that the fugleman's iron grip on the tunnels might be weakened.
TEXT_BANKOB302_01365_SEQ_02: Five of Zo Ga's minions have fallen by your hand, realizing too late the fate of those that cast their lot with would-be tyrants. Return to the 789th Order Dig and share news of your triumph with Bo Bu.
TEXT_BANKOB302_01365_SEQ_03: Bo Bu rejoices to hear that Zo Ga's followers have been served due justice for their misdeeds. Your efforts having instilled the dustman with a measure of courage, perhaps the day when the 789th rises against their oppressors is not so far in the future...
TEXT_BANKOB303_01366_SEQ_00: 789th Order Dustman Bo Bu is not enamored with the eating habits of his digmate.
TEXT_BANKOB303_01366_SEQ_01: Bo Bu's dream of serving a feast atop his treasured doblyn-shell plate has been dashed by his fellow dustman Bo Zu, who─his already-lacking wits further addled by hunger─has greedily gorged himself upon the selfsame plate. While Bo Bu looks into his digmate's well-being, head to U'Ghamaro, scare doblyns from their shadows with the boom tosses furnished to you by Bo Bu, and retrieve their shells, that the dustman may restore his tableware.
TEXT_BANKOB303_01366_SEQ_02: You have swiftly and efficiently relieved three doblyns of their carapaces. Return to the 789th Order Dig and deliver the fruits of your labor to Bo Bu.
TEXT_BANKOB303_01366_SEQ_03: Heartened by your return and the knowledge that his fellow dustman is paying the price for his gluttony, Bo Bu takes the doblyn shells into hand. Will the day soon come when the 789th Order feasts in triumph?
TEXT_BANKOB304_01367_SEQ_00: 789th Order Dustman Bo Bu is a believer in equal opportunities.
TEXT_BANKOB304_01367_SEQ_01: Bo Bu, proving to be among the more spirited kobolds at the dig, dismisses the vaunted abilities of Zo Ga and his followers, asserting that their strength is merely the product of superior resources paid for with ill-gotten wealth. To test his theory, he would “borrow” some crystalline saltpeter from the 13th Order's stores in U'Ghamaro, and deliver it to the 789th's own Ba Go, to see what destructive wonders the acolyte might fashion from such prime material. Or rather, he would have you do this─there is a limit to the dustman's courage, after all.
TEXT_BANKOB304_01367_SEQ_02: With any luck, Zo Ga will not notice the modest quantity of saltpeter you have lifted from his order's workshop. Deliver it to Ba Go at the 789th Order Dig and prepare for the inevitable applause and accolades.
TEXT_BANKOB304_01367_SEQ_03: Neither applause nor accolades were to be had, but rather expletives and epithets, as Ba Go took considerable umbrage at the mere implication─voiced by no one in particular─that the work of Zo Ga's alchemists was somehow superior to his own. Break the news to Bo Bu, and try to be gentle about it.
TEXT_BANKOB304_01367_SEQ_04: 789th Order Dustman Bo Bu, showing admirable pluck, is not shaken by Ba Go's disapproval─perhaps because he did not hear it─even resolving to someday apprentice himself to the eccentric genius and hone his own bombcrafting skills. Who are you to dash the young lad's dreams?
TEXT_BANKOB305_01368_SEQ_00: The rapidly burgeoning bomb population has 789th Order Dustman Bo Bu concerned for the safety of the tunnels.
TEXT_BANKOB305_01368_SEQ_01: A foul mess of machinery assembled by alchemists under Zo Ga's influence is belching out boorishly tempered bombs at an alarming rate. Bo Bu, ever eager to please, exhorts you to consult with Ba Go to come up with a means for destroying this hatchery of havoc.
TEXT_BANKOB305_01368_SEQ_02: Ba Go, welcoming the explosive demise of any bombs other than the beauties fashioned by his own hand, informs you that the bomb incubator is quite easily destroyed and sends you on your way. He does so not without assigning you a task, however: the recovery of a dazzling bomb's glowing arm that he would use to further his research. As said research demands the acolyte's full attention, you are to deliver your findings to Bo Bu.
TEXT_BANKOB305_01368_SEQ_03: The incubator falls quickly to your hand, spitting sparks and flames every which way. Search the embers and slay any hostile bombs that have survived the destruction.
TEXT_BANKOB305_01368_SEQ_04: The bombs too have fallen, reducing your immediate surroundings to a blazing inferno that would rival the seventh hell, yet your task is not yet done. Search the embers for the most dazzling bomb of all, slaying it and lopping off its still-glowing arm for the good of science.
TEXT_BANKOB305_01368_SEQ_05: The dazzling bomb's arm is yours, and what an arm it is! Return to the 789th Order Dig with a skip in your step, and entrust it to Dustman Bo Bu, reminding him that Ba Go will come seeking it at a later juncture.
TEXT_BANKOB305_01368_SEQ_06: Bo Bu rejoices at the bomb incubator's destruction, while relishing the opportunity to deliver a gift in person to the esteemed Ba Go. The acolyte is a stern taskmaster, but mayhap the young dustman's zeal will earn his respect yet. In the meantime, you can take pride in knowing that your efforts have earned the dig a brief respite from Zo Ga's fiery wrath...
TEXT_BANKOB306_01369_SEQ_00: 789th Order Dustman Bo Bu would have a taste of luxury, if only for a day.
TEXT_BANKOB306_01369_SEQ_01: The indomitable Bo Bu expresses his envy for the 13th Order─not for their wealth or prestige so much as for the sumptuous feasts afforded them by their fugleman Zo Ga. Bo Bu has no intention of betraying his friends at the dig, but he would slake his curiosity regarding the delicacies in which his more accomplished peers delight. Pay a visit to the most approachable member of Zo Ga's order─the alchemist Ga Zi─to see what might be done.
TEXT_BANKOB306_01369_SEQ_02: Harboring no great affection for Zo Ga's overbearing ways, Ga Zi willingly reveals the location of the food stores, as well as the means by which to acquire one of the necessary keys. As a growing young kobold's stomach hangs in the balance, delve into U'Ghamaro and locate one of the keyholder pots, slaying any patrolman fool enough to interfere.
TEXT_BANKOB306_01369_SEQ_03: The expired patrolman probably wishes he had stayed in bed this morning. Pay his sacrifice little heed and pop the top off the nondescript pot to retrieve a key.
TEXT_BANKOB306_01369_SEQ_04: With a goldpot key in your possession, you─and Bo Bu─are now one step closer to epicurean ecstasy. Make for any of the 13th Order's goldpots and examine it, dispatching its would-be guardian that you might safely extract the contents.
TEXT_BANKOB306_01369_SEQ_05: The guardian defeated, nothing stands between you and the 13th Order's greatest culinary creations. Unlock one of the pots and see what all the fuss is about.
TEXT_BANKOB306_01369_SEQ_06: Upon opening the goldpot, you find a similarly colored wriggling worm. Though it appears distinctly unappetizing to you, you recall the old Lominsan saying, “There's no accounting for the taste of half-wits.” Bring the unfortunate writhing creature back to Bo Bu.
TEXT_BANKOB306_01369_SEQ_07: Bo Bu devours the writhing mass with delight, savoring every squirm and wiggle─a sight that you very much wish you could unsee. As Bo Bu swears revenge against Zo Ga for abusing the food supply, go on your way with the hope that the young dustman's stomach will remain sated for the foreseeable future.
TEXT_BANKOB307_01370_SEQ_00: 789th Order Dustman Bo Bu would take issue with Zo Ga's wealth distribution, or lack thereof.
TEXT_BANKOB307_01370_SEQ_01: Bo Bu is incensed at Zo Ga's mining methods, which involve the fugleman employing his considerable resources and influence to open new veins of ore and bleed them dry before handing them over to lesser orders. In the latest effort to that end, he has employed diggers fashioned for him under duress by the accomplished metalworkers of the 86th Order. At the dustman's request, consult with Ba Go and find a way to thwart Zo Ga's efforts and narrow the gap between the haves and have-nots.
TEXT_BANKOB307_01370_SEQ_02: Caring little for Zo Ga's aspirations but much for making things go boom, Ba Go gleefully furnishes you with some of his beauties, as well as pieces of flickering coal that will serve to guide the bombs to their target. Seek out the Model 86 digger in U'Ghamaro and lay the coals beside it.
TEXT_BANKOB307_01370_SEQ_03: With the coals in place, Ba Go's beauties will surely not mistake their target. Back away to a safe location, let them fly, and enjoy the fireworks to follow.
TEXT_BANKOB307_01370_SEQ_04: You have generated an explosion that would have made Ba Go proud. Make your way back to the 789th Order Dig and report the deed to Bo Bu.
TEXT_BANKOB307_01370_SEQ_05: Bo Bu is overjoyed to hear of your success, relishing the knowledge that the 789th will be competing on even terms with Zo Ga's favored ones, at least for the day. Though the young dustman at times suffers from overzealousness, you would not be averse to seeing his ambition rub off on his peers...
TEXT_BANKOB308_01371_SEQ_00: 789th Order Dustman Bo Bu would come to the aid of his order's resident genius.
TEXT_BANKOB308_01371_SEQ_01: Bo Bu, convinced that he is Ba Go's favorite apprentice despite the latter's unwillingness to speak so much as a word to him, would come to his self-proclaimed master's aid─or have you do so in his stead. Speak with the acolyte and see what manner of task he would see done.
TEXT_BANKOB308_01371_SEQ_02: 789th Order Acolyte Ba Go seeks a pair of rare ingredients for prototype bombs he would fashion─namely, a golem soulstone and a hard doblyn shell. No ordinary stone or shell will do, however. Dispatch two ordinary U'Ghamaro golems and two synthetic doblyns to lure their masters out of hiding, then slay these formidable foes to acquire the materials that Ba Go seeks.
TEXT_BANKOB308_01371_SEQ_03: Your opponents having fallen, you have the rare soulstone and doblyn shell sought by Ba Go in hand. Deliver them to Bo Bu, whose ability to identify the materials will be the test that determines whether he can truly serve as Ba Go's trusted assistant, or simply as the target of the acolyte's next detonation test.
TEXT_BANKOB308_01371_SEQ_04: Bo Bu gleefully takes the bombcrafting materials in hand despite giving no indication that he has the slightest idea regarding their nature. The young dustman's ambition is admirable, however, and one can only hope that his master will be gentle...
TEXT_BANKOB309_01372_SEQ_00: 789th Order Dustman Bo Bu is looking to win friends and influence kobolds.
TEXT_BANKOB309_01372_SEQ_01: The ever-ambitious Bo Bu would take a page from the book of Zo Ga and use wealth to amass an army of followers, yet finds himself a bit short on coin. Rectify this by delivering a punishing to one of the fugleman's loyal minions─a savage roundsman of the 59th Order─and relieving him of the recompense afforded him by his master.
TEXT_BANKOB309_01372_SEQ_02: You deliver the Titan electrumshield to Bo Bu, doubtless increasing his wealth by several thousandfold in the process. Though it will take time for the young dustman to accumulate the fortune he seeks, you and he can nevertheless take heart that the 789th has triumphed over their nemesis today...
TEXT_BANKOB310_01373_SEQ_00: 789th Order Dustman Bo Bu would soothe the flames of a certain acolyte's ire.
TEXT_BANKOB310_01373_SEQ_01: 789th Order Acolyte Ba Go is fuming about something, and Bo Bu values the fur on his back and the whiskers on his face too dearly to inquire as to why. Speak to the eccentric alchemist in the young dustman's stead, to see what might be done to calm the flames of his fury.
TEXT_BANKOB310_01373_SEQ_02: A brief conversation reveals the reason for Ba Go's anger. It appears the crooked Zo Ga has confiscated the most potent of the acolyte's creations, which he now employs to do his own dirty work. This affront to science will not be tolerated─Ba Go will have his beauties back, and his revenge as well. Delve into U'Ghamaro Mines and retrieve the Mark II limpet bombs from Zo Ga's prototype bomb incubator, bearing in mind that they have a job to do before they return home.
TEXT_BANKOB310_01373_SEQ_03:
You have freed the first of Ba Go's beauties from its fiery prison. Take it on a tour of the facilities, dropping it off at one of the 13th Order's finest furnaces, which is about to be put out of commission.

※Fail to complete your objective in the allotted span of time, and the limpet bomb will detonate, causing damage to you in the process.
TEXT_BANKOB310_01373_SEQ_04: Ba Go's beauty made short work of the furnace, but its revenge has only just begun. Search the embers, quiet the bomb's rage and secure its core.
TEXT_BANKOB310_01373_SEQ_05: With core in hand, return to the incubator and claim the second of Ba Go's bombs, that you might reduce Zo Ga's vaunted workshop to even greater depths of chaos and confusion.
TEXT_BANKOB310_01373_SEQ_06:
With the second bomb now in hand, it is time to blast another furnace into the seventh hell. Hurry to your destination before the feisty beauty takes out its anger on its carrier.

※Fail to complete your objective in the allotted span of time, and the limpet bomb will detonate, causing damage to you in the process.
TEXT_BANKOB310_01373_SEQ_07: With a boom and blast, another furnace has been rendered unfit for use. Search the embers and quell the bomb's rage, that you might retrieve its core and bring it quietly back to its creator.
TEXT_BANKOB310_01373_SEQ_08: You have collected the second core of Ba Go's two beauties, and your task is─at long last─done. Return to the 789th Order Dig and inform the acolyte that revenge has been served.
TEXT_BANKOB310_01373_SEQ_09: Ba Go quickly dismisses your accomplishments and hurries back to his research, a sure sign that his mood has returned to normal─or whatever passes for such as far as a mad genius is concerned. Report back to 789th Order Dustman Bo Bu and assure him that the acolyte's fury has been duly doused.
TEXT_BANKOB310_01373_SEQ_10: Though Bo Bu is relieved at the turn of events, the flames of the dustman's own anger have been fanned, and he swears revenge on Zo Ga for angering Ba Go and putting the lives of all in the 789th Order Dig in peril in the process. You take your leave, while wondering deep down if the greatest peril to the 789th Order's safety lies in the billowing bomb within...
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_SEQ_00: R'ashaht Rhiki has an urgent duty to press upon a conveniently available adventurer.
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_SEQ_01: Commander Rhiki relays to you the disturbing details of a civilian ship sunk in the Strait of Merlthor. Suspecting Sahagin involvement, she asks that you report to the Maelstrom soldier in charge of the rescue operation. Make your way to Bloodshore in eastern La Noscea, and speak with Private Wilfalk.
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_SEQ_02: You report to Private Wilfalk, who wastes no time in assigning you the duty of tending to the wounded and exhausted survivors washed up on the sand. Use the Maelstrom field potions supplied to you by Wilfalk if the victims of the attack appear injured.
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_SEQ_03: You have tended to the traumatized victims. Report back to Private Wilfalk.
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_SEQ_04: No sooner have you returned to the private than a band of Sahagin appears before you. Rather than inflict any further grief, it seems the beastmen are singularly intent on seeing a young boy to safety. Speak with Robyn, and seek to understand this perplexing turn of events.
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_SEQ_05: According to Robyn, the Sahagin who saved him were not the same “scary fishmen” that attacked the ship. The boy also appears to have found a necklace belonging to one of his saviors, and asks that you return it to its beastman owner. Find Novv's Nursery in western La Noscea, and show the trinket to the settlement's wary young guard.
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_SEQ_06: The young Sahagin acknowledges your honorable intentions, and invites you to enter the nursery. Find and speak with the settlement's chief, Clutchfather Novv.
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_SEQ_07: Delighted by the return of his cherished necklace, Clutchfather Novv welcomes you to his home. It appears that you have stumbled upon a rare clutch of Sahagin─a group that isn't immediately interested in spilling your lifeblood on the ground. Speak with Novv to learn what you may about this unusually hospitable beastman settlement.
TEXT_BANSAH002_01375_SEQ_00: Clutchfather Novv needs your help to rein in one of his spawnlings.
TEXT_BANSAH002_01375_SEQ_01: Novv is concerned that his foolish son, Pyuu, has set off to reason with the notoriously violent Coral Tridents. With his claws full minding the rest of the clutch, the clutchfather asks that you save his offspring in his stead. Speak with Seww, another of Novv's spawnlings, and learn where you must go to rescue the reckless Pyuu.
TEXT_BANSAH002_01375_SEQ_02: Seww fears that his younger clutchmate, Pyuu, heads to almost certain death at the spears of the Coral Tridents. Make your way towards the Sahagin Landbase found near Halfstone in western La Noscea, and find the wayward spawnling.
TEXT_BANSAH002_01375_SEQ_03: Just as his clutchmate had feared, Pyuu's clumsy attempt to parley with the Coral Tridents has erupted into violence. Defeat the Trident warriors, and extricate the young Sahagin from his unpleasant predicament.
TEXT_BANSAH002_01375_SEQ_04: You have rescued Pyuu from his savage kin. According to the contrite spawnling, he merely wished to practice the teachings of his clutchfather, and did not expect such a brutally dismissive reception. Return to Novv's Nursery and report your success to Novv himself.
TEXT_BANSAH002_01375_SEQ_05: After thanking you for your kindness, Novv explains the dilemma that threatens the future of his race. The clutchfather is adamant that conflict with the “shorewalkers” will only hinder his people's efforts to secure a safe spawning ground in which to raise the next generation of Sahagin. Help bring about a more peaceful future for beastmen and shorewalkers alike by aiding Novv and his clutch in their struggles to contain the Coral Trident fanatics.
TEXT_BANSAH003_01376_SEQ_00: Novv needs a rock to sink the bloodthirsty ambitions of the Coral Tridents.
TEXT_BANSAH003_01376_SEQ_01: Novv has received the alarming news that the Coral Tridents are swarming another merchant vessel. Concerned that this incident will be the catalyst that triggers a full military campaign against the Sahagin, the clutchfather urges you to make haste to the deck of the Swallow to save its crew. Speak with Pahh, the seabeast tamer, and borrow an elbst to carry you across the waves.
TEXT_BANSAH003_01376_SEQ_02: After a swift, albeit somewhat wet, journey on the back of the elbst, you pull yourself over the rails of the beleaguered Swallow. Speak with the captain of the craft and learn how you might best assist the crew.
TEXT_BANSAH003_01376_SEQ_03: The captain of the Swallow bids you take the fight to the Sahagin while his men finish launching the lifeboats. Slay five of the enemies on board and give the captain and his crew the time they need to escape.
TEXT_BANSAH003_01376_SEQ_04: You have slain a fistful of the Coral Trident raiders. Return to the captain and check on the crew's progress.
TEXT_BANSAH003_01376_SEQ_05: Thanks to your valiant efforts, the entire crew of the Swallow has managed to flee to Aleport in relatively good health. Find the captain in the port town's tavern and learn how he fares.
TEXT_BANSAH003_01376_SEQ_06:
While recounting the first moments of the attack on his ship, the captain makes mention of the Tridents' supposed leader─a “red-hued sea devil.” Upon overhearing the story, a Maelstrom officer by the name of Ururu Kogururu urges the unhappy trader to recall the specific color. The Lalafellin lieutenant is visibly taken aback at the answer. Ururu goes on to explain that the Scarlet Sea Devil was a particularly savage Sahagin pirate that terrorized the seas of western La Noscea more than fifteen years ago. At the culmination of his chilling tale, the lieutenant departs to report the disturbing revelation to his superior.

Lamenting the loss of his vessel and livelihood, but thankful for his life, the captain of the Swallow gifts you with a sack of oranges he managed to salvage from the hold. Return to Novv's Nursery and share your reward with Novv and the spawnlings.
TEXT_BANSAH003_01376_SEQ_07: After Novv praises you for your actions in saving the crew, you relinquish the sack of oranges to the clutchfather and his curious offspring. The elder Sahagin muses on the differences between your peoples, and provides some insight into the Coral Tridents' rise to prominence. Continue to offer your aid to Novv's Clutch and deepen your understanding of the Sahagin tribe.
TEXT_BANSAH004_01377_SEQ_00: Novv is in need of someone to watch his clutch while he attends to an important task.
TEXT_BANSAH004_01377_SEQ_01: In an unmistakable sign of his growing trust in you, Novv has asked that you watch over his spawnlings while he attends to a task outside of the nursery. While he has faith that Seww, Houu, and Fyuu can shoulder the duties of feeding and disciplining their clutchmates, the clutchfather is concerned that the Coral Tridents may attempt some manner of retaliation in his absence. Seww, however, seems distressed at Novv's departure. Speak with the young Sahagin, and learn what troubles him.
TEXT_BANSAH004_01377_SEQ_02: Seww confides in you that the clutchfather has always been reticent about his past, and the spawnling wonders if this mysterious task has any connection to Novv's unspoken history. He asks that you track down the elder Sahagin who once fought with Novv, and learn what secrets they might unwittingly reveal. Take the clutchmark given to you by Seww, and visit the veteran beastmen found near the Reef of Sending, in Reaver Hide, and on Moonshade Isle.
TEXT_BANSAH004_01377_SEQ_03: Though initially reluctant to speak with you, the curiosity of the elder Sahagin warriors is piqued once you show them the clutchmark you carry. Among other information of note, you learn that the reason for Novv's absence is to attend a parley with Zugg, the leader of the Coral Tridents. Return to Novv's Nursery and report your findings to Seww.
TEXT_BANSAH004_01377_SEQ_04: Upon hearing of the impending meeting, Seww seems convinced that his clutchfather is walking into an ambush. The young Sahagin insists that he and his spawnbrothers can defend the nursery, and begs that you make haste to the site of the parley. Make your way to the Serpent's Tongue in western La Noscea, and witness the meeting unfold.
TEXT_BANSAH004_01377_SEQ_05: Before the parley is revealed for the ambush it always was, you learn the secret of Novv's hidden past: the clutchfather was once the Scarlet Sea Devil, the savage Sahagin pirate that terrorized the seas off western La Noscea. His intimidating aura undiminished, Novv breaks the spirit of his would-be attackers without a single word and dismisses Zugg with barely concealed contempt. Follow Novv's advice, and rendezvous with the clutchfather back at Novv's Nursery.
TEXT_BANSAH004_01377_SEQ_06: Summoning his son Seww to his side, Novv proceeds to regale you with the tale of his violent past. He describes the terrible deeds he committed, and tells of the bloody vengeance visited upon his ill-fated offspring. The sorrowful story, however, concludes on a hopeful note: with your help, the clutchfather means to break the cycle of rage and retaliation, and build the foundation for a lasting peace between your peoples.
TEXT_BANSAH005_01378_SEQ_00: Novv is clearly agitated by a recent development concerning the Coral Tridents.
TEXT_BANSAH005_01378_SEQ_01: Novv informs you that Zugg and his Coral Trident fanatics have abducted a high-ranking Lominsan official from the deck of a navy vessel. Visibly distressed by the implications, the clutchfather asks that you speak with a Maelstrom officer to learn if there is any chance to avert the seemingly inevitable plunge into full-scale war. Make your way to Camp Skull Valley and attempt a parley with Commander Falkbryda.
TEXT_BANSAH005_01378_SEQ_02: You attempt to dissuade Falkbryda from her course, but it appears the actions of the Coral Tridents have finally pushed the Maelstrom too far. It is only a matter of time before the cannon-laden warships of the Lominsan navy set sail for Sahagin territory on the orders of the Admiral herself. Return to Novv's Nursery and report the distressing news to Novv.
TEXT_BANSAH005_01378_SEQ_03: In a desperate effort to defuse the volatile situation, the clutchfather suggests that you and he attempt to rescue the abducted councillor yourselves. Your first task will be to uncover exactly where the Coral Tridents are keeping their prisoner. Infiltrate the Serpent's Tongue in western La Noscea, and search the pirates' abode for any written records that appear to document the ambitious plan.
TEXT_BANSAH005_01378_SEQ_04: You have found an ale-stained parchment that illustrates what you believe to be the raid on the councillor's ship. Return to Novv's Nursery and have Novv peruse the crumpled document.
TEXT_BANSAH005_01378_SEQ_05: After poring over the soiled parchment you retrieved from the Serpent's Tongue, Novv believes he has identified the location of the pirate vessel where the Lominsan official is being held. Speak with Pahh, the seabeast tamer, and borrow an elbst to carry you to the Lost Duchess.
TEXT_BANSAH005_01378_SEQ_06: You have successfully slipped aboard the Lost Duchess and located Councillor Turstin. Though shackled─and somewhat shocked at Novv's unexpected appearance─the official appears mercifully unharmed. The clutchfather offers to protect Turstin while you search for a means to free him from his bonds. Defeat the enemies aboard the ship until you find the key to the manacles.
TEXT_BANSAH005_01378_SEQ_07: You have liberated the manacle key from the body of a slain Sahagin. Return to Councillor Turstin and unlock his shackles.
TEXT_BANSAH005_01378_SEQ_08: After a tense and emotional confrontation, Novv at last convinces Zugg─the leader of the Coral Tridents and Novv's wayward son─of the futility of his warmongering. At Zugg's command, the Lost Duchess sets sail for the nearest shorewalker settlement, and lowers a lifeboat for you and the councillor to row into the western La Noscean port. Speak with Turstin in Aleport, and learn what he intends to do next.
TEXT_BANSAH005_01378_SEQ_09: Councillor Turstin expresses his gratitude towards you and Novv for his timely rescue. It appears that the recent experience has changed his perception of the Sahagin as simple, bloodthirsty brutes, and he sympathizes with the clutchfather's trials as a parent. After promising to convince the Admiral to stand down the troops, the Lominsan official hands you a gull feather trinket that is said to represent home and happiness. Deliver the feather to Novv at Novv's Nursery.
TEXT_BANSAH005_01378_SEQ_10: You hand the gull feather trinket to Novv, compliments of Councillor Turstin. The clutchfather thanks you for your role in averting war with Limsa Lominsa, and once more speaks fervently of his desire to see a cessation of hostilities between the two long-standing enemies. Though his son Zugg has apparently left on a journey for distant waters, Novv hopes that both he─and you─will someday return to visit the nursery. Return to Maelstrom Command in Limsa Lominsa and make your final report to Commander R'ashaht Rhiki.
TEXT_BANSAH005_01378_SEQ_11: Relieved that the need for large-scale conflict has been avoided, R'ashaht Rhiki commends you for your efforts in rescuing the councillor and addressing the Sahagin threat. The commander seems cautiously optimistic about the possibility of brokering a peace with the scaled beastmen, but warns that the looming specter of Leviathan requires the Maelstrom to remain in a constant state of vigilance. You are dismissed for now, but the call to duty may sound at a moment's notice...
TEXT_BANSAH101_01379_SEQ_00: Fyuu wishes to make some lethal adjustments to the battle plans of the Coral Tridents.
TEXT_BANSAH101_01379_SEQ_01: Fyuu has learned that Voll the Sharkskinned, a proven tactical genius, has been recruited to the Coral Trident cause. Surmising that the Tridents plan to launch a major assault on their finless enemies, the young Sahagin requests that you disrupt their schemes by slaying their new strategist. Participate in the FATE “Sharknado” in Halfstone, and present proof of your deed to Fyuu.
TEXT_BANSAH101_01379_SEQ_02: You deliver the coral armband to Fyuu. Satisfied that Voll the Sharkskinned is no more, the spawnling praises the courage you have shown in sabotaging the plans of the Tridents.
TEXT_BANSAH102_01380_SEQ_00: Fyuu wishes to counteract the aggressive actions of the Coral Tridents.
TEXT_BANSAH102_01380_SEQ_01: Fyuu is concerned that the battle standards erected by the Coral Tridents will unduly provoke the soldiers manning the tidegates. Take the flint stones given to you by the spawnling to the Sahagin Landbase, and burn these symbols of war and violence.
TEXT_BANSAH102_01380_SEQ_02: You have set the Coral Tridents' battle standards aflame. Return to Fyuu at Novv's Nursery and report your success.
TEXT_BANSAH102_01380_SEQ_03: Fyuu is certain that your small act of vandalism has struck a subtle blow for Novv's campaign for peace. Though his clutch prefers to take the diplomatic route whenever possible, the young Sahagin believes a more direct approach is the only option for dealing with his fanatical kin.
TEXT_BANSAH103_01381_SEQ_00: Fyuu wishes to recruit you for a spot of sabotage.
TEXT_BANSAH103_01381_SEQ_01: It appears the Coral Tridents have developed a new form of siege weaponry through the sorcerous transformation of giant, lightning-spitting shellfish. Infiltrate the Sahagin Landbase, and destroy these organic ballistas before they can be used to bring down the tidegates.
TEXT_BANSAH103_01381_SEQ_02: You have destroyed the whelk ballistas. Return to Fyuu at Novv's Nursery and report your success.
TEXT_BANSAH103_01381_SEQ_03: Fyuu is relieved to hear that the siege weapons of the Coral Tridents have been neutralized. The young Sahagin laments the shortsightedness of his violent kin, claiming that the existence of the tidegates allows them to continue peaceful cultivation of the spawning grounds by preventing full-scale engagements with their enemies.
TEXT_BANSAH104_01382_SEQ_00: Fyuu has a mind to deprive the Coral Tridents of their dinner.
TEXT_BANSAH104_01382_SEQ_01: According to Fyuu, the Coral Tridents have been laying in provisions for their upcoming war with the finless ones. Locate the giant clams in the enemy camp, and steal the megalodon paste.
TEXT_BANSAH104_01382_SEQ_02: You have acquired the Coral Tridents' stores of finely chopped sharkflesh. Return to Fyuu at Novv's Nursery, and deliver to him the stolen megalodon paste.
TEXT_BANSAH104_01382_SEQ_03: You have delivered the megalodon paste to an appreciative Fyuu. The young Sahagin eagerly accepts the sharkflesh, and tells you of his plans to share it amongst his clutchmates. It seems that the Sahagin spawnlings─much like all growing youngsters─consume a prodigious amount of food...
TEXT_BANSAH105_01383_SEQ_00: Fyuu has news of an incident that could escalate the ongoing conflict with the Maelstrom.
TEXT_BANSAH105_01383_SEQ_01: According to one of Fyuu's skulking spawnbrothers, the Coral Tridents have captured a number of Maelstrom soldiers. With naught but death or “drowning” awaiting such prisoners, the young Sahagin expects the soldiers' comrades to mount a retaliatory expedition. In order to prevent a violent disruption to the spawning grounds, Fyuu asks that you free the captured troops yourself. Approach the Sahagin sentries guarding the area, and obtain their keys─by peaceful means if possible, forceful means if necessary.
TEXT_BANSAH105_01383_SEQ_02: You have obtained the manacle keys from the Sahagin sentries. Locate the captive soldiers in the west of the Sahagin Landbase, and set them free of their shackles.
TEXT_BANSAH105_01383_SEQ_03: You have freed the captive storm recruits. Return to Novv's Nursery and report to Fyuu.
TEXT_BANSAH105_01383_SEQ_04: Though certain that the Coral Tridents curse the lone shorewalker who freed their captives, Fyuu is relieved that your actions have forestalled any retaliation by the Maelstrom. The young Sahagin, echoing the teachings of his clutchfather, appears determined to end the pointless cycle where vengeance begets only further vengeance.
TEXT_BANSAH106_01384_SEQ_00: Fyuu wishes you to demonstrate your goodwill towards the clutch.
TEXT_BANSAH106_01384_SEQ_01: After explaining that one of his duties as an elder spawnbrother is to teach the hatchlings the skill of spearfishing, Fyuu requests that you gather the snipper shells he needs to fashion their hunting tools. Borrow an elbst from Pahh to travel to Moonshade Isle, and prepare to lure the snippers from their burrows by slaying pugils for their flesh.
TEXT_BANSAH106_01384_SEQ_02: You have carved some generous slabs of flesh from a pair of freshly slain pugils. Place the pugil flesh by the crab burrows, and defeat the snippers that emerge for their shells.
TEXT_BANSAH106_01384_SEQ_03: You have successfully dispatched the hungry snippers. Deliver their rigid shells to Fyuu at Novv's Nursery.
TEXT_BANSAH106_01384_SEQ_04: You have supplied Fyuu with the materials he needs to craft sharp and durable spearheads. Though thankful for the contribution you have made to the education of the hatchlings, he seems none too eager to place such lethal tools in the hands of his younger siblings...
TEXT_BANSAH107_01385_SEQ_00: Fyuu seeks your aid in broadening the culinary horizons of his spawnbrothers.
TEXT_BANSAH107_01385_SEQ_01: Concerned that his younger siblings' diet has been restricted to what can be caught in the waters near the nursery, Fyuu requests that you procure some ocean delicacies from somewhat further afield. Borrow an elbst from Pahh to cross the waves, and collect the whitecap clams found on the beach of Moonshade Isle.
TEXT_BANSAH107_01385_SEQ_02: You have gathered an armful of whitecap clams. Return to Novv's Nursery and deliver your haul to Fyuu.
TEXT_BANSAH107_01385_SEQ_03: Fyuu's eyes appear to bulge even further from his head when he beholds the bounty with which you have returned. Judging by his joyful reaction, it may not be long before you find yourself back on an elbst, headed for the sands of Moonshade Isle once more...
TEXT_BANSAH108_01386_SEQ_00: Fyuu needs you to teach humility to the Coral Tridents.
TEXT_BANSAH108_01386_SEQ_01: Fyuu has news that the Coral Tridents and their Serpent Reaver lackeys have taken control of a trading vessel. Worried that their prideful boasting will encourage others to attempt to emulate their victory, the young Sahagin asks that you slip aboard the merchantman and take the wind out of their sails. Ride an elbst to the trading vessel, and defeat the enemies on deck until the leader is provoked into engaging you himself.
TEXT_BANSAH108_01386_SEQ_02: You have humbled the Coral Tridents aboard the captured merchantman. Return to Novv's Nursery and report to Fyuu.
TEXT_BANSAH108_01386_SEQ_03: You inform Fyuu of your success aboard the trading vessel. After hearing of your exploits, Novv's spawnling is reminded of an experience involving a gluttonous feast and a dreadful stomachache... Reassuring you that he is not, in fact, comparing you to a poisonous bottom-feeder, Fyuu thanks you for your continued efforts towards the clutch's cause.
TEXT_BANSAH109_01387_SEQ_00: Fyuu wishes you to raid the raiders.
TEXT_BANSAH109_01387_SEQ_01: Word has reached Fyuu that another trading vessel has fallen prey to the Coral Tridents. Though the crew managed to flee unscathed using a landing skiff, their valuable cargo yet remains on the captured ship. Novv's spawnling asks that you attempt to liberate this cargo from the claws of his zealous kin. Borrow an elbst from Pahh, and locate the crates on the deck of the merchantman.
TEXT_BANSAH109_01387_SEQ_02: You have relieved the Coral Tridents on the trading vessel of their ill-gotten cargo. Return to Novv's Nursery and deliver the crates to Fyuu.
TEXT_BANSAH109_01387_SEQ_03: You have deposited the captured vessel's cargo at the feet of the young beastman. Fyuu hopes that by returning the crates in person, the shorewalkers will come to realize that not all Sahagin are creatures of violence and villainy.
TEXT_BANSAH110_01388_SEQ_00: Fyuu has learned of an ill-considered Coral Trident scheme.
TEXT_BANSAH110_01388_SEQ_01: Fyuu informs you that several Sahagin warriors have slipped past the tidegates and now lurk in the shadows of the shorewalker encampments. Conduct a search of the area around Camp Skull Valley, and neutralize the infiltrators before they can endanger Novv's cause with their impatiently planned assault.
TEXT_BANSAH110_01388_SEQ_02: After a series of spectacularly unsuccessful negotiations, you have removed the threat of the Sahagin infiltrators by force. Return to Novv's Nursery and report to Fyuu.
TEXT_BANSAH110_01388_SEQ_03: Fyuu appears saddened but unsurprised by the bloody conclusion to your encounter beyond the tidegates. Though the thick-scaled Tridents seem immune to the barbs of reason, the young Sahagin hopes that the continued failure of their operations will one day help them to see the futility of their course.
TEXT_BANSAH201_01390_SEQ_00: Houu has had troubling news of late, and desires a shorewalker's help in calming the waters.
TEXT_BANSAH201_01390_SEQ_01: Warlike ways call for healing hands, and the Coral Tridents have added more sorcerers to their ranks. Houu asks you to remove at least three of them from their ranks, and thus put a damper on the Tridents' bellicose plans.
TEXT_BANSAH201_01390_SEQ_02: Leaving the practice of medicine is a painful experience, and you are glad that the healers are not alive to dwell on it. The peaceable Houu will no doubt share your relief when you return to Novv's Nursery and report all.
TEXT_BANSAH201_01390_SEQ_03: Houu seems glad to hear of the three sorcerers' departure, though it is never easy to tell with a Sahagin. Without healers to tend to their wounded, the Coral Tridents will surely be less likely to attack in the near future─another reprieve for Novv's people.
TEXT_BANSAH202_01391_SEQ_00: It seems the Sapsa Spawning Grounds are producing more than baby Sahagin, and Houu requests a little groundskeeping.
TEXT_BANSAH202_01391_SEQ_01: The Coral Tridents have established a breeding program for elbst, but there is only one stud animal. Instinct being what it is, anyone slaying a couple of young Sapsa elbst should find  in the company of the irate sire. With this knowledge in the back of your mind, proceed into Trident territory and start dispatching elbst. When the sire arrives, use the milky vitriol given to you against the steely skinned creature and lay it low.
TEXT_BANSAH202_01391_SEQ_02: You have made a burial ground of Sapsa today, with both the sire and the young dead by your hands. Console yourself that the sea and the shore are safer for it, and report your success to Houu.
TEXT_BANSAH202_01391_SEQ_03: Houu has no doubt that your actions have saved lives─certainly in Novv's Nursery, and perhaps among the Tridents as well, though they seem to offer their lives willingly in the cause of ultimate ascendancy. Things are definitely not better under this sea, and there may be calls on your service again.
TEXT_BANSAH203_01392_SEQ_00: Houu may prefer not to deal with finless ones, but he has wisdom enough to see the merits of employing one shorewalker to kill another.
TEXT_BANSAH203_01392_SEQ_01: Serpent Reavers have been guiding the Coral Tridents to trading vessels, and Houu does not like what easy prey these ships have become. An ambush point has been staked out at the approach to the Sapsa Spawning Grounds, where these seamen are due to appear. Slay three drowned seamen.
TEXT_BANSAH203_01392_SEQ_02: You have dealt with the drowned seamen accordingly. Return to Houu in Novv's Nursery and inform him that the trading vessels should sail in more safety for the time being.
TEXT_BANSAH203_01392_SEQ_03: Houu receives the news of the Reavers' deaths with a gladness most lugubrious. You may be a shorewalker, but as long as you are available to dispatch the more belligerent members of your species, you will be welcome at Novv's Nursery.
TEXT_BANSAH204_01393_SEQ_00: The gears of war turn inexorably in the Sapsa Spawning Grounds, but Houu hopes that an opportune act of sabotage may gum up the works.
TEXT_BANSAH204_01393_SEQ_01: New siege engines stand under guard at the Sapsa Spawning Grounds, bound for the front and destined to claim scores of lives. Houu has chosen you among all others to destroy at least two of these fresh whelk ballistas, no matter the cost.
TEXT_BANSAH204_01393_SEQ_02: You have obliterated two of the ballistas, though you cannot help but worry that more will soon take their place. Return at once to Houu to hear his opinion on the matter.
TEXT_BANSAH204_01393_SEQ_03: Though Houu is well pleased at the success of your mission, he is less enthused when he learns that the Tridents have gathered a larger force in the area than first thought. He hopes that your deeds will give the Tridents pause, but you get the distinct impression that there will be much more to do to maintain the peace...
TEXT_BANSAH205_01394_SEQ_00: The path to war is littered with brute and ugly things, and it seems Houu has stumbled over yet more of those.
TEXT_BANSAH205_01394_SEQ_01: Four crates of stolen armaments have been deposited in the Sapsa Spawning Grounds by the Serpent Reavers, and they await collection by the Coral Tridents. The armaments need but a spark to go up in flames, and Houu has given you several flint stones to accomplish this purpose. Should guards of the shelftooth, shelfclaw, or shelfspine persuasion attempt to interfere, lay them low.
TEXT_BANSAH205_01394_SEQ_02: All four crates of weapons and armor have been reduced to ashes, with much the same to be said of the guards unwise enough to attack you. At your earliest convenience, return to Houu in Novv's Nursery and report on your successful pyromania.
TEXT_BANSAH205_01394_SEQ_03: Pleased with your performance, Houu is nevertheless harsh in his condemnation of shorewalker ways, the very notion of crafting being repugnant to the Sahagin. There does seem, however, to be some strange sympathy for the devil in that slow-beating heart...
TEXT_BANSAH206_01395_SEQ_00: Houu is much troubled by the state of the spawning grounds, and seeks a handy shorewalker for some light poison control.
TEXT_BANSAH206_01395_SEQ_01: Any egg laid at the Sapsa Spawning Grounds faces the prospect of noxious neighbors, and that is something that Houu would rather avoid. Moon jellyfish are pliant and uncomplaining, and would surely not mind being used to stuff the gas-spraying orifices of noxious barnacles. Stopper five barnacles, and should the territorial Sapsa pugil appear, stop it with something a mite harder.
