TEXT_BANSAH206_01395_SEQ_02: You have crammed the jellyfish into the barnacles and taken out the pugil who was ill pleased at your molestations. You have done fine work this day. Before you get too wrapped up in your own self-satisfaction, however, it might be best to head back to Novv's Nursery to tell Houu what has transpired.
TEXT_BANSAH206_01395_SEQ_03: Your barnacle-stuffing having been reported, the talk turns to the future of the Sahagin. Houu has real fear that neglect of the spawning grounds due to war will spell the end of his kind. Should the Sahagin live only for the spawning, as Houu says? Should you? One thing you both can agree on is that war is not the way.
TEXT_BANSAH207_01396_SEQ_00: Houu is expert at weighing lesser evils against greater goods, and would see where you fit into the equation.
TEXT_BANSAH207_01396_SEQ_01: Houu asks you to defeat Worr the Whalefin, a strategos in thrall to the Coral Tridents. Achieve victory in the FATE “Tail of a Whale” in the Sapsa Spawning Grounds to acquire Worr's coral band, and then present it as proof of your deed to Houu.
TEXT_BANSAH207_01396_SEQ_02: Houu receives the coral band and is greatly impressed by your martial skills. You have apparently made an equally strong impression on other Sahagin. Let us hope they will no longer be so quick to follow the Tridents' incitement to take on shorewalkers in open warfare...
TEXT_BANSAH208_01397_SEQ_00: Houu has a nose for noxious happenings in the spawning grounds─especially where the Coral Tridents are involved.
TEXT_BANSAH208_01397_SEQ_01: Maelstrom recruits have been captured by the Coral Tridents, and rendered helpless by noxious gas from paralysis pots. Houu has given you stoppers to use on the pots.
TEXT_BANSAH208_01397_SEQ_02: The stoppers proved to be a perfect fit, and the reeling recruits are back on their feet and out of the Sapsa Spawning Grounds. Report the successful mission to Houu.
TEXT_BANSAH208_01397_SEQ_03: A Sahagin of peace, Houu reveals that he is caught between two faiths. He would not deny Leviathan his rightful oblations, but would not have a war fought over the “drowning” of shorewalkers, either. It is unfortunate that your two peoples will yet be caught up in this struggle for the foreseeable future...
TEXT_BANSAH209_01398_SEQ_00: The tales from the sea are ever writ in salt and blood, and on a sleepy little island in Galadion Bay, the plot grows suddenly thicker.
TEXT_BANSAH209_01398_SEQ_01: According to Houu, Serpent Reavers have laid claim to Moonshade Isle, and harass Novv's Clutch at the Coral Tridents' behest. It falls to you to hunt down four Moonshade deckhands and steersmen, but first, you must get to the island. The seabeast tamer Pahh has the best elbst in town─or in Novv's Nursery, at least.
TEXT_BANSAH209_01398_SEQ_02: Dead pirates lay no claims, and the four Serpent Reavers are thoroughly deceased. You never did much like snakes. Return to the nursery and inform Houu of the outcome of your little jaunt.
TEXT_BANSAH209_01398_SEQ_03: Houu is contemplative as he receives word of the island's liberation. Was this bloodshed strictly necessary? Or was it something to swim away from? You always have a choice, and Sahagin or shorewalker, what you choose is who you are.
TEXT_BANSAH210_01399_SEQ_00: Houu has received word of a merchantman in trouble, and would send you to the rescue.
TEXT_BANSAH210_01399_SEQ_01: The Coral Tridents have seized a merchant vessel, bent on mastering the dubious art of sending shorewalker ships to their watery doom. Your task is to board the merchantman and dispatch four surfspine Sahagin. The open water being a cruel mistress to tender-skinned shorewalkers such as yourself, ask Pahh the seabeast tamer to provide you with an elbst for the journey.
TEXT_BANSAH210_01399_SEQ_02: The surfspine saboteurs are dead, their careers in maritime demolition over ere they began. You are unmoved, having chosen your own job far more wisely than these Sahagin did. An adventurer goes everywhere, meets everyone, does anything─then returns to clients to report the job's success.
TEXT_BANSAH210_01399_SEQ_03: Houu minces no words in denouncing the dead surfspine Sahagin as blackguards, and wonders why anyone would devote their strengths to death and blight. Listening to Houu, you are uneasily reminded that the first casualties of any revolution are the mild of heart.
TEXT_BANSAH301_01400_SEQ_00: Seww needs your help to curtail a Sahagin strike force.
TEXT_BANSAH301_01400_SEQ_01: Seww has caught word of a Coral Trident strike force assembling for a concerted attack on the Maelstrom's defenses. He reasons that eliminating the leaders of the operation will steal the momentum from the assault. Defeat members of the Sapsa shelfscale, shelfclaw, and shelftooth clans, then slay the clan chiefs when they come forth to avenge their fallen kin.
TEXT_BANSAH301_01400_SEQ_02: You have eliminated the clan chiefs. Return to Novv's Nursery and report to Seww.
TEXT_BANSAH301_01400_SEQ_03: You report your success to Seww, and the young Sahagin is relieved to hear of his violent kin's demise. Though the Sahagin have once again narrowly avoided the threat of full-scale war, Novv's spawnling cautions that the next crop of leaders may very well take up where their shortsighted predecessors left off.
TEXT_BANSAH302_01401_SEQ_00: Seww would have you delve deep into the spawning grounds.
TEXT_BANSAH302_01401_SEQ_01: According to Seww, the Coral Tridents have been hard at work perfecting an even more powerful version of their shellfish siege weaponry. He requests that you act immediately to protect the tidegates from the devastating force of these unnatural creations. Delve deep into the spawning grounds, and destroy the reinforced whelk ballistas before they are transported to the front lines.
TEXT_BANSAH302_01401_SEQ_02: You have successfully destroyed the latest and most powerful versions of the whelk ballistas. Return to Novv's Nursery and report to Seww.
TEXT_BANSAH302_01401_SEQ_03: After hearing your report, a relieved Seww reiterates the importance of the tidegates' function in keeping the warring peoples separate. But though the Coral Tridents have once more been thwarted by your actions, it seems they are intent on strangling themselves with Seww's graphically described chain of retaliation.
TEXT_BANSAH303_01402_SEQ_00: Seww needs your help to prevent more needless conflict.
TEXT_BANSAH303_01402_SEQ_01: Seww has informed you that the Serpent Reavers have been seen moving prisoners deeper into the Sapsa Spawning Grounds. Certain that the captive soldiers will be─or possibly already have been─subjected to “drowning,” Novv's spawnling is concerned that the incident will trigger an aggressive Maelstrom response. Head to the spawning grounds and free as many imprisoned soldiers as possible, and, failing that, defeat any drowned thralls.
TEXT_BANSAH303_01402_SEQ_02: You have freed all of the imprisoned soldiers─in one way or another. Return to Novv's Nursery and report to Seww.
TEXT_BANSAH303_01402_SEQ_03: Upon hearing your report, Seww muses on the origins of the Sahagin's Serpent Reaver allies. Though the tattooed pirates are willing followers of Leviathan, the young beastman warrior has witnessed the destructive consequences of their efforts to force others into their faith. Continue to aid Seww when he calls upon you, and do what can be done to limit the damage caused by these kidnapping raids.
TEXT_BANSAH304_01403_SEQ_00: Seww needs a shorewalker who isn't afraid to play with fire.
TEXT_BANSAH304_01403_SEQ_01: After describing the stolen goods to be found stacked on the docks of Reaver Hide, Seww hands you a hefty chunk of flint stone and bids that you burn them all. Head deep into the spawning grounds, and set ablaze any materials that might be used in the Tridents' war efforts.
TEXT_BANSAH304_01403_SEQ_02: You have incinerated the pillaged cargo and dispatched the wrathful guards. Return to Novv's Nursery and report to Seww.
TEXT_BANSAH304_01403_SEQ_03: The smell of smoke on your garments alerts Seww to the success of your task. Though appreciative of your efforts, Novv's spawnling fears that the Tridents have developed a taste for pillage. It seems likely that the docks of Reaver Hide have not seen the last of these stolen shipments...
TEXT_BANSAH305_01404_SEQ_00: Seww would have you curtail the savagery of the Serpent Reavers.
TEXT_BANSAH305_01404_SEQ_01: Sickened by the brutality of recent Serpent Reaver activity and concerned about its contribution to the escalating conflict, Seww asks that you lure out and eliminate the savage group's leaders. Head into the Serpent's Tongue and defeat shelfscale, shelfeye, and shelfclaw Reavers, then slay their respective officers when they appear.
TEXT_BANSAH305_01404_SEQ_02: You have lopped off the head of the Reaver forces in the Serpent's Tongue. Return to Novv's Nursery and report to Seww.
TEXT_BANSAH305_01404_SEQ_03: Seww thanks you for your necessarily violent actions. Though you have crippled the leadership of the Serpent Reavers, the young Sahagin cautions that the wriggling body of the vicious pirate gang will not remain headless for long.
TEXT_BANSAH306_01405_SEQ_00: Seww has a culinary favor to ask of you.
TEXT_BANSAH306_01405_SEQ_01: Though Seww and his spawnbrothers can subsist on a diet of fish, he longs for the days when they could feast on amphibian flesh. Search the Sapsa Spawning Grounds for the Tridents' private herd of axolotls, and slay one for its tail meat.
TEXT_BANSAH306_01405_SEQ_02: Now that you have obtained the rubbery flesh of an axolotl, you can follow the remainder of Seww's instructions. Find a cooking trough in which to stew the tail meat, and defend yourself from Trident warriors who wander in to partake of the boiling fish broth.
TEXT_BANSAH306_01405_SEQ_03: You have fended off the attacks of several ravenous Sahagin soldiers. Stew the axolotl meat in the cooking trough, and then retrieve it before the flesh dissolves into the boiling broth.
TEXT_BANSAH306_01405_SEQ_04: You have successfully retrieved the slab of now-tender tail meat. Return to Novv's Nursery and deliver the steaming flesh to Seww.
TEXT_BANSAH306_01405_SEQ_05: You deliver the tender tail meat to an appreciative Seww. The spawnling's unusually effusive compliments suggest that any future contributions of axolotl flesh will be accepted with equal enthusiasm.
TEXT_BANSAH307_01406_SEQ_00: Seww would have you turn the tables on the Serpent Reavers.
TEXT_BANSAH307_01406_SEQ_01: In a bid to weaken the forces of the Coral Tridents, Seww asks that you launch a surprise attack on a vessel of their allies, the Serpent Reavers. Take one of Pahh's elbst to the disguised merchantman, and defeat drowned raiders until their leader comes forth to challenge you himself.
TEXT_BANSAH307_01406_SEQ_02: You have slain the drowned seaman and demoralized the crew of the repurposed trading vessel. Return to Novv's Nursery and report to Seww.
TEXT_BANSAH307_01406_SEQ_03: Seww is pleased to hear of the Serpent Reaver officer's demise, and judges that the surviving pirates will need time to regroup from their sudden losses. The spawnling muses over the unenviable position of the tattooed thugs─despised by their own kin, and treated as lowly servants by the Sahagin─and expects that their thirst for violence will never truly be quenched.
TEXT_BANSAH308_01407_SEQ_00: Seww would have you get your feet wet for a good cause.
TEXT_BANSAH308_01407_SEQ_01: According to Seww's spawnbrothers, a pillaged merchantman under the command of the Reavers has seen battle with a Maelstrom warship. Though the Lominsan troops were forced to retreat from the deck of the trading vessel, it seems that several of their soldiers were captured by the pirates as they attempted to withdraw. Seww wishes you to board the Reavers' ship and help the captive soldiers escape before the Maelstrom decides to return with a larger force. Speak with Pahh, and borrow an elbst to carry you to the rail of the merchantman.
TEXT_BANSAH308_01407_SEQ_02: You have freed the captive soldiers. Return to Novv's Nursery and report to Seww.
TEXT_BANSAH308_01407_SEQ_03: Seww is greatly relieved to hear that you were able to free the Maelstrom soldiers from their Reaver captors, and thereby avert the need for further intervention by the Lominsan military. The spawnling compares the Maelstrom to his own clutch, saying that the shorewalker troops share a bond as strong as any blood-related family and will go to extraordinary lengths to save one of their own.
TEXT_BANSAH309_01408_SEQ_00: Seww would ask you to swim softly and carry a big stone.
TEXT_BANSAH309_01408_SEQ_01: Seww has word that the ill-gotten cargo of the Serpent Reavers is now vulnerable on the deck of their pirate vessel. In order to prevent the pillaged goods from supplying the bloody schemes of the Coral Tridents, the spawnling asks that you set fire to the pitch-caulked chests of the tattooed thugs. Borrow an elbst from his clutchmate Pahh, and use the small flint stone to strike sparks aboard the Reavers' ship.
TEXT_BANSAH309_01408_SEQ_02: You have ignited the plundered cargo of the Serpent Reavers. Return to Novv's Nursery and report to Seww.
TEXT_BANSAH309_01408_SEQ_03: Seww seems overjoyed at the thought of the Serpent Reavers' anguish, and commends you on your efforts to cut the Coral Tridents' supply lines. He is adamant that a continued campaign of such sabotage will do much to impede the warmongering Sahagin and their antagonistic actions.
TEXT_BANSAH310_01409_SEQ_00: Seww would have you remove a dangerous threat to the peace of the spawning grounds.
TEXT_BANSAH310_01409_SEQ_01: According to Seww, a notorious Serpent Reaver captain by the name of Aermswys the Stained has been plotting alongside the leaders of the Coral Tridents. The young Sahagin fears that to stand idle while they set their nefarious plans in motion would be to invite disaster for his people. Participate in the FATE “Watch Your Tongue” in the Serpent's Tongue, and present proof of your deed to Seww.
TEXT_BANSAH310_01409_SEQ_02: You have vanquished the dreadful captain and delivered her coral necklace to Seww. Novv's spawnling confirms the authenticity of the trinket, and praises the enormity of your deed. But though you have foiled whatever schemes the Coral Tridents were hatching, it will not prevent them from enlisting the vile services of the next captain who arises from the ranks of the Serpent Reavers...
TEXT_BANALL010_01465_SEQ_00: Scarlet would commend you for your work among the disparate societies of Eorzea, and entreat your further aid.
TEXT_BANALL010_01465_SEQ_01: Lieutenant Scarlet expresses her gratitude for your accomplishments, which have laid the groundwork upon which enduring peace with the beast tribes of Eorzea may one day be achieved. Valuing your diplomatic skills highly, she would seek your aid with an important task. Inquire with Lieutenant Gavin as to the details.
TEXT_BANALL010_01465_SEQ_02: Lieutenant Gavin is heartened by your presence, having heard of your peace-building exploits with the beast tribes. To learn more of the task the Twin Adder would entrust to you, speak with the lieutenant anew.
TEXT_BANALL011_01466_SEQ_00: Trachraet would commend you for your work among the disparate societies of Eorzea, and entreat your further aid.
TEXT_BANALL011_01466_SEQ_01: Lieutenant Trachraet expresses his gratitude for your accomplishments, which have laid the groundwork upon which enduring peace with the beast tribes of Eorzea may one day be achieved. Valuing your diplomatic skills highly, he would seek your aid with an important task. Inquire with Lieutenant Gavin of Gridania's Order of the Twin Adder as to the details.
TEXT_BANALL011_01466_SEQ_02: Lieutenant Gavin is heartened by your presence, having heard much of your peace-building exploits with the beast tribes. To learn more of the task the Twin Adder would entrust to you, speak with the lieutenant anew.
TEXT_BANALL012_01467_SEQ_00: Mimio would commend you for your work among the disparate societies of Eorzea, and entreat your further aid.
TEXT_BANALL012_01467_SEQ_01: Lieutenant Mimio Mio expresses her gratitude for your accomplishments, which have laid the groundwork upon which enduring peace with the beast tribes of Eorzea may one day be achieved. Valuing your diplomatic skills highly, she would seek your aid with an important task. Inquire with Lieutenant Gavin of Gridania's Order of the Twin Adder as to the details.
TEXT_BANALL012_01467_SEQ_02: Lieutenant Gavin is heartened by your presence, having heard of your peace-building exploits with the beast tribes. To learn more of the task the Twin Adder would entrust to you, speak with the lieutenant anew.
TEXT_BANALL020_01468_SEQ_00: Gavin would enlist the services of a willing-and-able adventurer─to wit, you.
TEXT_BANALL020_01468_SEQ_01: As Lieutenant Gavin tells it, the Order of the Twin Adder received a panicked missive from Voyce, the naturalist who has taken up residence in Little Solace. Travel to the sylph settlement and see what has the hapless scholar in such distress.
TEXT_BANALL020_01468_SEQ_02: Voyce and Elder Frixio relate to you the plight faced by the sylphs─a mass kidnapping of podlings that had been resting safely in Little Solace. Convinced that the touched sylphs that inhabit the Sylphlands are responsible for the deed, Voyce begs you to travel to the entrance to their lair in the East Shroud, and stand lookout in hopes of catching the abductor in the act.
TEXT_BANALL020_01468_SEQ_03: Your search turned up not the culprits you sought, but rather a mysterious young girl who ominously suggests that the truth behind the disappearance of the podlings is far more fearsome than you suspected, before hastening off to destinations unknown. Return to Voyce and inform him that you will have to look elsewhere for the kidnapper.
TEXT_BANALL020_01468_SEQ_04: In hearing that the touched sylphs are not behind the kidnapping, Voyce is visibly perplexed. Who could have perpetrated this terrible crime, and to what end? This mystery warrants further investigation.
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_SEQ_00: Voyce has been thinking about the disappearance of the sylph podlings.
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_SEQ_01: Following a sequence of questionable deductions, Voyce concludes that the podlings were spirited away by a rogue band of pirates, and suggests that you pick up the trail in La Noscea. Make for the Drowning Wench in Limsa Lominsa and deliver the scholar's missive to his colleague, a marine researcher by the name of Guston who should be able to aid you in your search.
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_SEQ_02: Utterly unable to decipher Voyce's chocobo scratches, Guston is nonetheless able to provide you with some intriguing information regarding a suspicious personage sighted at the docks not long ago. Seek out more information from the researcher's son Robyn in Fisherman's Bottom.
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_SEQ_03: Robyn quickly recognizes you as the adventurer who assisted him in delivering a necklace to the kind fishmen who rescued him. The reunion serving to jog his memory, he suspects that the unsavory man is targeting his scaled friends. Return to Novv's Nursery to see that the peaceful Sahagin come to no harm, and bring along Robyn's gift─a sack of juicy oranges favored by the fishmen─for good measure.
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_SEQ_04: Novv's rejoicing at the sight of the juicy citruses is interrupted by the ever-excitable Seww, who is distraught at the apparent kidnapping of his young spawnbrother Bouu. Could the culprit be the same man responsible for the disappearance of the podlings from Little Solace? Make way to the scene of the crime─Moonshade Isle─by elbst, and fend off adversaries as necessary to secure a vantage point from which you may scan the waters for the kidnapper's escape vessel.
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_SEQ_05: You manage to locate the kidnapper's vessel, which is swiftly making its way out to sea. As you and Seww curse your luck, Novv is quick to take action. In the blink of an eye, the clutchfather emerges from the sea to stand before his son's abductor─a menacing Miqo'te wearing a mask of metal. When an ill-timed collision with a protruding rock causes Bouu to lose his balance, the feline felon is quick to take advantage of the situation. As Novv moves to shield his spawnling, three daggers strike the Sahagin clear in the back. Seww dives swiftly into the waters to save his clutchfather, urging you to return to the nursery to prepare to tend to Novv's wounds.
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_SEQ_06: Perhaps it is paternal instinct and a desire to see his son returned to safety that gives Novv his strength, for the clutchfather is not much worse for the wear despite the wounds he suffered at the hands of the kidnapper. Novv fumes at the indignity his clutch has suffered. Who is this Miqo'te marauder, and what does he hope to accomplish from robbing the cradles of the beast tribes? The plot ever thickens...
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SEQ_00: Novv would make a request of you, clutchfather to .
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SEQ_01: Considering you one of his own, the wounded clutchfather Novv entrusts you with the rescue of the kidnapped Bouu. He explains to you that after falling to the masked Miqo'te, he managed to punch a hole in the culprit's skiff with his spear. Thus surmising that the vessel has been taken to Aleport for repairs, he bids you go in pursuit.
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SEQ_02: No sooner do you locate the kidnapper's vessel than the enigmatic Sylvie appears, informing you that your quarry has once again eluded your─and her─grasp. She further reveals that the one you seek is a shadowy figure known as the Ebon Claw, and suggests that Baderon at the Drowning Wench may be able to tell you more about your man.
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SEQ_03: As Baderon tells it, the Ebon Claw is the epithet of Nhaza'a Jaab─an erstwhile adventurer and incomparable swordsman who now makes his trade as a hired blade to the most unscrupulous individuals in the realm. He warns you that it is in your best interests to steer well clear of the man, then recalls that Lieutenant Trachraet of the Maelstrom was asking around for you not long ago.
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SEQ_04: Trachraet explains that he was searching for you on behalf of his fellow storm lieutenant Skaetswys, who it would seem has another kobold crisis on her hands. Reunite with her at the 789th Order Dig and see what the trouble is this time.
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SEQ_05: Speaking with Skaetswys reveals an unsurprising turn of events─the kidnapper has struck again, this time ambushing a group of kobolds of the 175th Order in the heart of the Kobold Dig. Travel to the scene of the crime and question the victims in the hopes of tracking your quarry.
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SEQ_06: In shock and in shambles, the kobolds of the 175th Order explain that their alchemist, the beloved Bi Bi, was captured by a fearsome swordsman. As they tell it, he fled to the south, pursued by a mysterious green-haired girl. There may yet be time to catch your quarry.
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SEQ_07: You find Sylvie collapsed on the ground, clinging tenuously to consciousness. With labored breaths, she explains in frustration that she tracked Nhaza'a Jaab here, but was powerless to stop him. Return to the 789th Order Dig and report this distressing news to Skaetswys.
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SEQ_08: You return to the 789th Order Dig to find Sylvie lying on the ground, her condition grave. She implores you to put a stop to the Ebon Claw's madness, while implying that there is yet another mastermind behind the scenes...before falling unconscious from her wounds. With Gi Gu proving ever incompetent, Skaetswys takes it upon herself to carry the girl to Camp Overlook to recuperate. Upon her return, she asks you to share any knowledge you have about your quarry, in hopes of plotting your next course of action.
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_SEQ_00: Skaetswys has been thinking about the kidnapper and his escape.
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_SEQ_01: Skaetswys has deduced that the kidnapper fled with the abducted Bi Bi by means of an airship. She suggests that you inquire with Commander Bloeidin at Camp Overlook regarding any suspicious vessels seen in the sky.
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_SEQ_02: Commander Bloeidin informs you that, indeed, one of his sentries spotted an unfamiliar vessel heading east across the Strait of Merlthor in the direction of Aldenard. He also mentions that the wounded Sylvie rests in one of his tents, but has been refusing all visitors. Pay her a visit and inquire as to her well-being.
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_SEQ_03: From within the tent in which she rests, Sylvie earnestly implores you to track down the villainous Ebon Claw in her stead. Surmising that his next target will be the Ixal, she urges you to hurry to Ehcatl and offer your aid to Chief Sezul Totoloc.
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_SEQ_04: Your reunion with Chief Totoloc and the young engineer Tataramu is interrupted by a dropper from the Ehcatl Nine, who speaks in panicked tones of a sudden attack on the Ehcatl logging grounds perpetrated by a rogue airship. Though the Ixal succeeded in driving off the enemy, it would appear some foul deed or another has already been done. Upon hearing your explanation, all present are in consensus that the beastman abductor you pursue is responsible. Tataramu bids you to travel to the scene of the attack near Hyrstmill and search for any remnants of the damaged vessel.
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_SEQ_05: You succeed in finding a damaged fragment of the rogue airship in the vicinity of Hyrstmill. Deliver it to Tataramu's hands, that he might be able to identify the vessel and deduce something of its most likely destination.
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_SEQ_06: Taking the hull fragment into hand, Tataramu uses his encyclopedic knowledge of airship minutiae to identify its markings as belonging to a rare Garlond Ironworks Model 1569-II. As precious few of these ships were manufactured, he is certain that an inquiry with Highwind Skyways will swiftly turn up the rogue vessel's current owner. At long last, will the mastermind behind the beastman abductions be revealed...?
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_SEQ_00: Tataramu would aid you in tracking your quarry.
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_SEQ_01: Tataramu offers to use his connections at Highwind Skyways to assist in tracking down the elusive abductor of beastmen. Make your way to the airship landing in Ul'dah, where Advisor Colson will be awaiting your arrival.
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_SEQ_02: Advisor Colson has identified the airship piloted by the kidnapper as the property of the Laughing Alchemists, a disreputable trading company operating out of Ul'dah. As you converse, you overhear three Brass Blades discuss their attempt to capture a fugitive beastman wreaking havoc in the streets. Could this be related to the kidnappings you are investigating? Seek out the beastman in question and find out.
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_SEQ_03: The fugitive beastman was revealed to be your erstwhile comrade, Yadovv Gah of the Brotherhood of Ash. He swears that the rumors of violent attacks against innocent Ul'dahns are lies, and that he came to the city in pursuit of a man who abducted his brothers. Sylvie appears, offering to lead the troubled Amalj'aa safely out of the city walls. Before departing, Yadovv Gah informs you that he and his warleader will await you at the Ring of Ash.
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_SEQ_04: Though Hamujj Gah welcomes your return to the Ring of Ash, he seethes with anger at the abduction of his fellow Amalj'aa by the hand of the ubiquitous kidnapper. The warleader's honor will not allow him to sit idly by. Realizing that the two of you share a common foe, he enlists your aid in seeing that the perpetrator answers for his treacherous acts.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SEQ_00: Hamujj Gah would make a plea to a fellow seeker of absolute martial perfection.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SEQ_01: Hamujj Gah would see his hatchlings returned safely to the Ring of Ash. Consult with Yadovv Gah and formulate a plan of attack.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SEQ_02: Though Yadovv Gah has no insight as to the whereabouts of the kidnapper and the abducted hatchlings, he suspects that the enigmatic Sylvie might, as she has requested your presence in Ul'dah. Overhearing your conversation, Loonh Gah offers to accompany you to the sultanate in place of Yadovv Gah, who would likely face another rude welcome were he to join you. Travel back to the city-state and meet Sylvie by the Gate of Nald.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SEQ_03: Sylvie welcomes you back to Ul'dah and tells you that there is someone she would have you meet. Rendezvous with her by the Gate of Thal.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SEQ_04: Sylvie introduces you to Shanga Meshanga, chairman of the Ashcrown Consortium, a benevolent organization dedicated to improving the lives of beastmen through the trading of crystals and other mutually beneficial commodities. Deeply disturbed by the recent abductions, Master Shanga offers to lend his aid to your investigation. In the meantime, Sylvie informs you that Momodi is looking for you at the Quicksand.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SEQ_05: At the Quicksand, you reunite with Tataramu, Voyce, and Skaetswys, who have also come to Ul'dah to assist in tracking down the abducted beastmen. Your friends agree to split up and gather─in their respective areas of expertise─whatever information might be had on the perpetrators of the crime. Speak with Tataramu at the Ul'dah airship landing, Voyce at the Alchemists' Guild, Skaetswys at the Hall of Flames, and Loonh Gah at the Platinum Mirage, and see what clues they have managed to dig up.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SEQ_06: You have spoken with all your comrades and compiled the clues that they were able to gather. Return to the Ashcrown Consortium headquarters and share the knowledge with Sylvie.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SEQ_07: The truth behind the beastmen abductions is frightful indeed. Memeriga, an unscrupulous merchant known as the Deathmonger, intends to raise an army of undead beastmen. With time running short, seek out his hired blade, Nhaza'a Jaab, at his lodgings at the Platinum Mirage, that you might extract from him the whereabouts of his master. As you will require all the reinforcements you can muster, take the elegant dress furnished to you by Sylvie to Loonh Gah, that she might accompany you into the exclusive establishment.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SEQ_08: Upon entering Nhaza'a Jaab's quarters, a brief scuffle ensues, and the fearsome sellsword easily brushes off Loonh Gah's attack. Despite having no real incentive to do so, Nhaza'a Jaab reveals that Memeriga may be found at the Invisible City, seemingly intrigued by the prospect of facing you and your comrades in a battle to the death. Meanwhile, Sylvie reveals herself as a sylph by the name of Silbexio, and you finally understand why the young girl was so passionate about seeking revenge for the lost beastmen. Silbexio offers to accompany you to the site of the final confrontation. Travel there and rendezvous with your sylph friend.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SEQ_09: You arrive at the Invisible City, where Memeriga's dark plots are about to take shape. You and Silbexio charge the camp, where your path is blocked by the Deathmonger's contingent of bodyguards. Fortunately, your beastman allies arrive on the scene with impeccable timing, providing a much-welcome opening for you and Silbexio. While your comrades square off with Nhaza'a Jaab, fight your way through Memeriga's defenses and blast his cauldron to pieces using the smoldering scalebomb entrusted to you.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SEQ_10: The smoldering scalebomb makes short work of the cauldron, foiling Memeriga's dread plot once and for all. In the meantime, your beastman allies are not faring as well in their battle against the Ebon Claw. Clutchfather Novv's attack is disarmed with ease, and it appears hope is lost. However, the true strength of the Beastman Alliance only truly emerges when they fight as one. Protected by Elder Frixio's magical shield, Hamujj Gah penetrates the Miqo'te sellsword's defenses and stuns him with a crushing blow. In the next instant, Sezul Totoloc tosses his weapon to Clutchfather Novv, who leaps to the sky. Given extra momentum by a bomb booster pack triggered by Gi Gu, he flies at Nhaza'a Jaab, striking a mighty blow. In utter disbelief at his own defeat, the battered sellsword stumbles over the walls to what seems like his demise...until the Miqo'te safely lands on Memeriga's airship, which he had commandeered as his personal escape vessel. Swearing revenge, he attempts to flee to safety, but is quickly brought down almost by accident when Gi Gu detonates a set of bombs that had found their way on board. Meanwhile, a contingent of Brass Blades has come at the behest of the Ashcrown Consortium to arrest Memeriga for his crimes. The battle is finally won. Take a deep breath, then speak with Silbexio and share in the joy of victory.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SEQ_11: Silbexio reunites with Elder Frixio, who expresses his profound gratitude for your efforts. Thanking you for all that you have done to bring the beast tribes of Eorzea together, he takes his leave and departs for Little Solace. Silbexio─or Sylvie─would return to the Ashcrown Consortium and speak with you there. Return to Ul'dah and seek out your friend.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SEQ_12: Having assumed once more the identity of Sylvie, your friend offers her gratitude for all that you have done. Despite the many tragedies and hardships she has suffered, she has emerged stronger than ever, with an unshakable belief that anything is possible when two parties put aside their differences for the greater good. Confident that the friendships that you helped form in your adventures with the beast tribes will show the way to a better tomorrow, she thanks you, and takes her leave.
TEXT_BANIXA001_01486_SEQ_00: Lieutenant Scarlet's feathers seem ruffled by some grave news out of the Twelveswood.
TEXT_BANIXA001_01486_SEQ_01: After relaying to you the news of an attack by an Ixali war balloon, Lieutenant Scarlet requests that you lend your strength to the soldiers at E-Tatt's Spire. Head into the North Shroud and report to Captain Guithrit.
TEXT_BANIXA001_01486_SEQ_02: You speak with Captain Guithrit and learn that a well-placed arrow has sent an Ixali war balloon crashing down into the trees. Search for the wreckage in Peacegarden, and confirm that the beastmen's vessel is truly grounded.
TEXT_BANIXA001_01486_SEQ_03: After investigating the area of the crash, you discover what might possibly be an important war balloon component. Return to E-Tatt's Spire, and show the part to Captain Guithrit.
TEXT_BANIXA001_01486_SEQ_04: Captain Guithrit examines the balloon component, but cannot say for certain what function the part may have had. Unsatisfied by your report of the Ixali craft's demise, the wary soldier asks that you return to the crash site and look for signs that the Ixal may yet lurk nearby.
TEXT_BANIXA001_01486_SEQ_05: After discovering a pile of disassembled balloon parts not far from the crash site, you are confronted by a pair of unusual Ixal. Rather than attack you, however, the leader, one “Chief Totoloc,” instead proposes a deal so that he might procure the component you retrieved from the fallen vessel. With the potential for an actual peace in the offing, you should not let this opportunity pass you by. Head through the wooden gate nearby, and bring the part to the eager beastman.
TEXT_BANIXA001_01486_SEQ_06: Sezul welcomes you into his camp, and introduces himself and his crew as the “Ehcatl Nine.” Describing the group as outcast from their own people, Chief Totoloc purports to serve not the primal Garuda or her fanatics, but the dream of flying free like the wind...
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Sezul appears eager to share more of his work with you.
※The crafting portion of this quest is recommended for Disciples of the Hand level 1 and above.
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_SEQ_01:
Sezul has marked you for a skilled artisan, and requests that you craft for him an airship hull component─a specialized item which the Ehcatl camp lacks the resources to build. Make your way to Fallgourd Float and obtain the necessary crafting materials from the Qiqirn junkmonger.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_SEQ_02: After handing you the component materials, the junkmonger advises that you make use of the crafting facility found beside the Bobbing Cork. Head over to the workshop and hand the materials over to Hildeyerd.
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_SEQ_03:
After entrusting the component materials to Hildeyerd, the supervisor begins explaining the purpose of the crafting facility. Her explanation, however, is interrupted by a young Lalafellin man, who insists on appraising the results of your apparently doomed endeavor. Use the materials returned to you by Hildeyerd to craft the interior hull component, and then show the item to the waiting Tataramu.

※In the event that the status Facility Access: Detailing wears off or the synthesis ends in failure, you may try again by speaking with Hildeyerd.
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_SEQ_04: You synthesize the hull interior component and show it to Tataramu. After recovering from his shock at the quality of your work, the young man demands to know the identity of your client. Upon realizing you were commissioned by a group of Ixal, however, Tataramu concludes that the beastmen mean to fashion a vessel of war, and rushes off to find the Ehcatl Nine's hidden camp. Return to Ehcatl and deliver the component to Sezul.
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_SEQ_05: No sooner have you placed the component into Sezul's hands than Tataramu bursts into the camp and accuses the chief of sullying the field of airship engineering. The Ehcatl Nine leader explains, however, that his purpose in breaking away from the Garuda-beholden Ixal was to begin construction on the Dezul Qualan─a hybrid vessel intended not to wage war, but to soar above the highest clouds. Quickly convinced by Sezul's obvious zeal and sincerity, Tataramu then begs for a position on the chief's ambitious project. Speak once more with Sezul, and decide what your own fate in this undertaking will be.
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_SEQ_06: You have agreed to assist Sezul in the construction of his unique airship. Lend your crafting skills to the efforts of the Ehcatl Nine, and join the chief and Tataramu in aiming for the heavens.
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Sezul appears concerned for the well-being of one of his crew.
※The crafting portion of this quest is recommended for Disciples of the Hand level 3 and above.
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_SEQ_01:
Concerned that his crew's mechanical engineer has not returned from his task of gathering engine component materials, Sezul looks to you to locate the missing Ixal. Make your way south and search Alder Springs for Bozol Eduan the Exact.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_SEQ_02: You find the missing Bozol Eduan in Alder Springs, the exhausted Ixal cradling what appears to be a broken arm. No sooner has Bozol warned you to leave, however, than his tormentors─a group of Ixal from the logging grounds─appear to further threaten and taunt him. Wary of your presence, perhaps, the fanatics withdraw after pronouncing an ominous ultimatum. Speak with Bozol, and listen to the unfortunate engineer's tale.
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_SEQ_03: After explaining that his injury has rendered him unable to complete his task, Bozol requests that you craft the engine component in his stead. Visit the crafting facility at Treespeak Stables, and present the component materials to Nellemond.
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_SEQ_04:
You have handed over the component materials to Nellemond, and gained access to the crafting facility. Synthesize a high-quality propulsion engine component, and deliver it to Sezul Totoloc at Ehcatl.

※In the event that the status Facility Access: Finishing wears off or the synthesis ends in failure, you may try again by speaking with Nellemond.
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_SEQ_05: You have delivered the propulsion engine component to Sezul. The Ehcatl Nine leader is thankful for your efforts, but laments the delay caused by his chief designer's injury. Upon hearing of this predicament, Tataramu offers to shoulder Bozol's duties, and convinces Sezul that his dedication to the project is genuine. Sezul accepts both you and Tataramu as official members of his crew, and exhorts you to continue working towards the completion of the Dezul Qualan.
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Tataramu has encountered a bump in the road towards completing the Dezul Qualan.
※The crafting portion of this quest is recommended for Disciples of the Hand level 6 and above.
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_SEQ_01:
After explaining the need for certain notoriously difficult-to-acquire materials, Tataramu reluctantly asks that you deliver a letter to an acquaintance of his. Visit the airship ticket counter in Gridania, and ask Hida where you might find a gentleman by the name of Colson.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_SEQ_02: Upon hearing of your wish to deliver a letter from “Master Tataramu,” an obviously shocked Hida demands that you make haste to the headquarters of the Gods' Quiver and submit a report. Speak with Chansteloup at his post outside of Quiver's Hold.
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_SEQ_03: Chansteloup brushes aside your attempt to speak with him, claiming to be fully occupied with solving an important missing persons case. The agitated Quiverman does, however, confirm Colson's presence within Quiver's Hold. Head inside, and deliver the letter to Tataramu's acquaintance.
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_SEQ_04: After delivering the letter to Advisor Colson, you learn that Tataramu is actually the “missing” son of Highwind Skyways chairman Tatabaru. Though vexed by the unapologetic nature of Tataramu's brief missive, Colson nevertheless agrees to cover the costs for the young Lalafell's requested materials. Take the promissory note and hand it to Hildeyerd at the Fallgourd Float crafting facility.
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_SEQ_05:
You hand the promissory note to Hildeyerd, and receive what the workshop supervisor describes as a set of lavishly expensive materials. Use the facility to craft a high-quality engine jointing component, then deliver your handiwork to Tataramu.

※In the event that the status Facility Access: Detailing wears off or the synthesis ends in failure, you may try again by speaking with Hildeyerd.
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_SEQ_06: You have delivered the engine jointing component to Tataramu. Realizing that you are now aware of his true identity, the young man explains his desire to pursue an honest career outside of the suffocating cocoon of his privileged position. Sezul assures Tataramu that crafting is its own reward, and urges the airship designer to funnel his passion into the completion of the Dezul Qualan.
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Sezul has another request that requires a featherless one's touch.
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_SEQ_01:
With the construction of a new lathe in mind, Sezul has tasked you with obtaining a high-grade gearwheel. Speak with your fellow featherless one, Tataramu, and see if he has any ideas on where to begin your search.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_SEQ_02: While discussing the subject of lathes, Tataramu recalls that just such a tool was used in his grandfather's workshop years ago. The eager designer reasons that Colson, a veteran Skyways employee, would know better than any what became of his grandsire's tools. Head to the Carline Canopy in Gridania, and track down Tataramu's aged acquaintance.
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_SEQ_03: After explaining your predicament to Colson, the old man casts his mind back to the days when he first worked with Tataramu's grandfather. Though the company founder's original workshop has long since been dismantled, Colson suggests that you approach one of the old hands at the Bobbing Cork and ask if anything remains of Tatanora's tools. Travel to Fallgourd Float, and speak with Aeluuin.
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_SEQ_04: You question Aeluuin about the lathe, but the inn worker appears unaware that such a workshop ever existed in Fallgourd. He does, however, mention a pile of old, unclaimed goods that have been gathering dust in the inn's storeroom. Search through the stack of antiques by the side of the Bobbing Cork, and check for any abandoned lathe parts.
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_SEQ_05: Tataramu appears just as you locate the lathe gearwheel, having finally remembered where his grandfather's workshop used to be. Checking over the precious part, the young man notices a dedication written by his grandfather inscribed on its surface. Return to Ehcatl and hand the gearwheel to Sezul.
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_SEQ_06: You deliver the gearwheel to Sezul, and the Ehcatl Nine chief confirms that the “Dezul Qualan” in the dedication is the same Ixal for whom he named the hybrid airship. It would appear that Sezul's mentor and Tataramu's grandsire had forged a friendship based on their mutual passion for aeronautics. Both Chief Totoloc and Tataramu cannot help but feel the guiding hand of fate in their growing partnership...
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Tataramu wishes you to assist him in procuring another part for the Dezul Qualan.
※The crafting portion of this quest is recommended for Disciples of the Hand level 15 and above.
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_SEQ_01:
Tataramu has asked you to approach Gerolt with the task of forging the Dezul Qualan's unique steering mechanism. Take the helm component materials, and speak with the master weaponsmith at Hyrstmill.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_SEQ_02: You attempt to speak with Gerolt, but the groaning artisan seems aggressively disinclined to hear your request. Present the component materials to Drake, Gerolt's sympathetic apprentice, and explain the task you have in mind.
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_SEQ_03:
After listening to your request, Drake contrives a plan to help you ensnare his suffering master's attention. Craft four high-quality helm components from the materials returned to you by the apprentice, and then shove your inspiring handiwork right under Gerolt's nose.

※In the event that the status Facility Access: Production wears off or the synthesis ends in failure, you may try again by speaking with Drake.
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_SEQ_04: You present your helm components to Gerolt. Impressed and intrigued by the quality of your work, the master weaponsmith rouses himself from his slump and promises to forge the remainder of the steering mechanism. Return to Ehcatl and report to Tataramu.
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_SEQ_05: You return to Ehcatl and report your success to Tataramu, who is overjoyed with Gerolt's involvement in the project. The young man's joy is cut short, however, when his father, the chairman of Highwind Skyways, arrives with a squad of sellswords to drag him away from the Ixali camp. Speak with Sezul and learn the Ixal's thoughts.
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_SEQ_06: Chief Totoloc is enraged at Tatabaru's treatment of his own son, and resigned to postponing the final stages of the Dezul Qualan's construction. With the loss of their talented designer, it seems the Ehcatl Nine's ambitions must remain indefinitely grounded...
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Sezul appears desperate to have Tataramu back at work on the Dezul Qualan.
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_SEQ_01:
Desperate to have Tataramu back at work on the Dezul Qualan, Sezul has asked that you approach a member of Highwind Skyways directly. Head to the airship landing in Gridania, and find a Skyways employee who might know of Tataramu's present whereabouts.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_SEQ_02: Despite being summarily dismissed by Chairman Tatabaru's private clerk, you learn that she will soon join the head of Highwind Skyways on a journey to the Observatorium. Make your own way to the Coerthas central highlands, and question the private clerk once more.
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_SEQ_03: You manage to pressure the private clerk into revealing that the chairman's son has accompanied them to Coerthas. Search the residences of the Observatorium and find Tataramu.
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_SEQ_04: Though you have found Tataramu, it appears that his movements are being monitored by the wine-swilling retainers in the next room. The young man suggests that you consult Templeton, and contrive a method by which Tataramu can escape without risking undue notice. Speak with the Skywinds employee in the Observatorium's crafting facility.
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_SEQ_05: You speak with Templeton, and the devious craftsman suggests the use of a potent sleeping potion mixed into a half-empty bottle of wine. Take the bottle and surreptitiously place it on the table in the room where the mercenary guards are drinking.
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_SEQ_06: Completely oblivious to your sleight of hand, the retainers begin quaffing the contents of the seemingly innocuous wine bottle. Enter the adjoining chamber and report the progress of the escape plan to Tataramu.
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_SEQ_07: You report the success of Templeton's plan to an astonished Tataramu. Well aware of his guards' proclivity for drinking, the airship designer deems the sellswords sufficiently insensate to risk a swift dash through the door. Head outside and rendezvous with Tataramu.
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_SEQ_08: Just as it seems that Tataramu has made good his escape, you are startled by the sudden appearance of Advisor Colson. Though the aged technician is initially disapproving of Tataramu's actions, he is eventually swayed by the young man's impassioned plea that he be allowed to follow his dreams. Return to Ehcatl and rejoin Sezul.
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_SEQ_09: Sezul is overcome with emotion at Tataramu's return. No sooner has the chief mastered his tears and ordered the designer back to work, however, than the Ixali chieftain of the nearby logging ground makes an unexpected and unwelcome visit. Cawing with triumph at his discovery of the hidden camp, the exultant chieftain promises an unpleasant fate for the Ehcatl Nine. Sezul and his crew must now race to complete the Dezul Qualan before the Natalan Ixal arrive to destroy all that they have worked to accomplish...
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Sezul has one last task he would have you perform.
※The crafting portion of this quest is recommended for Disciples of the Hand level 18 and above, and the battle portion for Disciples of War or Magic level 49 and above.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SEQ_01:
Sezul declares that the Dezul Qualan requires but a few finishing touches before it can be considered complete. Eager to conclude preparations for the test flight, the excitable Ixal has chosen you to craft the final part. Take the component materials given to you by Chief Totoloc, and present them to Hildeyerd at Fallgourd Float.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SEQ_02:
You present the materials to Hildeyerd, and the cheerful supervisor prepares her facility to accommodate your task. Craft a high-quality finishing component, and deliver it to the waiting Sezul.

※In the event that the status Facility Access: Detailing wears off or the synthesis ends in failure, you may try again by speaking with Hildeyerd.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SEQ_03: You deliver the finishing component to Sezul. Just as the Ixali chief rejoices at the prospect of a complete Dezul Qualan, however, his celebrating is cut short by sobering news: the fanatics of Natalan have begun preparations to launch their war balloons in an attack on Ehcatl. Travel to Natalan in the Coerthas central highlands, and consult with Tuzal Toltan the Unseen on how to sabotage the impending assault.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SEQ_04: After arriving in Natalan, Tuzal Toltan explains to you the elemental workings of the zealots' vortex array and the method by which it can be disabled. Take one of Tuzal's corrupted crystal shards and use it to sabotage the nearby vortex turret as suggested.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SEQ_05: You have successfully disabled the secondary vortex turret. Speak with Tuzal Toltan the Unseen for further instructions.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SEQ_06: Now that you understand the task before you, Tuzal urges you to disable the vortex array completely. Find the remaining secondary turrets and sabotage them using the corrupted crystal shards.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SEQ_07: You have found and disabled all the secondary turrets. If what Tuzal told you was correct, you should now be able to safely disable the heart of the array. Locate the primary vortex turret and shut it down using the final shard.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SEQ_08: You have disabled all the turrets in the vortex array and interrupted the flow of elemental power. With the airstones thus deprived of energy, the war balloons should now lack the propulsion needed to drive them to Ehcatl. Return to Tuzal Toltan the Unseen and report your success.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SEQ_09: Stating that he will carry word of your actions back to Chief Totoloc, Tuzal bids you keep watch on the movements of his crafty kin. Travel to the Observatorium and rendezvous with Tataramu.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SEQ_10: Upon meeting Tataramu, you learn that another vortex turret remained hidden and untouched somewhere within Natalan─providing enough energy to power the airstone of a single war balloon. The young man's despair is palpable as he spots the ominous vessel floating steadily towards Sezul's camp. His dark mood is suddenly dispelled, however, when Tatabaru's airship, the Blackjack, appears and rams the Ixali craft out of the sky. Return to Ehcatl and report events to Sezul.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SEQ_11: As Sezul is gloating over the news of his enemy's misfortune, Tatabaru and his entourage arrive in the camp. The chairman apologizes for his previous behavior, and claims an earnest desire to now see the dreams of the Ehcatl Nine come true. The final round of pre-flight inspections has begun. Speak with Tataramu, and see what aid you can provide.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SEQ_12: You approach Tataramu, and the excited airship designer reveals that he has been working on a figurehead for the Dezul Qualan. Hoping that Sezul will approve the design, Tataramu asks that you speak with the Ehcatl Nine leader before crafting the final component for the figurehead. Present the component materials to Sezul and seek the Ixal's blessing.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SEQ_13:
You hand the component materials to Sezul, and the chief immediately realizes what Tataramu has in mind. Impressed and pleased by the traditional Ixali design, Sezul bids you craft the final part with particular care. Use the materials returned to you to synthesize a high-quality figurehead component, and deliver it to the waiting Tataramu.

※In the event that the status Facility Access: Detailing wears off or the synthesis ends in failure, you may try again by speaking with Sezul.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SEQ_14: You deliver the figurehead component to Tataramu just as the pre-flight inspections are concluded. With all now in readiness, Sezul gives the order for takeoff. Tataramu takes the Dezul Qualan up into the air, but is almost immediately caught in the grip of violent turbulence. The entire camp watches anxiously as the young man manages to master the wild currents and pilot the airship out of danger. The test flight is a resounding success. Speak with Tataramu and hear his breathless account of events.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SEQ_15: Though extremely satisfied with the Dezul Qualan's inaugural performance, Tataramu has already set his sights on loftier goals. Thoughts of his future purpose, however, lead him to ask you what your own reasons were for coming to Ehcatl. Reminded of your original mission, you realize a certain officer is likely awaiting your report. Return to the Adders' Nest in Gridania, and report to Lieutenant Scarlet.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SEQ_16: Attempting to hide her own forgetfulness, Lieutenant Scarlet praises you on the success of your assigned duty─it appears that your actions have foiled whatever plans the Natalan Ixal had to assault Gridania's defenses. Unbeknownst to the Twin Adder officer, however, you have also helped to prove that friendship and understanding between the feathered beastmen and the forest people is attainable through the pursuit of common purpose. It is unfortunate, then, that not all Ixal share the dreams of the Ehcatl Nine...
TEXT_BANIXA101_01494_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Many would deign to call themselves able, but Yazel Ahuatan the Able goes so far as to claim it as his title.
※The crafting portion of this quest is recommended for Disciples of the Hand level 1 and above, and the battle portion for Disciples of War or Magic level 41 and above.
TEXT_BANIXA101_01494_SEQ_01:
Questioning your skills as an artisan, Yazel Ahuatan invites you to prove him wrong by crafting a bladder component with the materials he has provided. His challenge is further complicated by the requirement that you use special facilities in Hyrstmill to craft the component─facilities which are administered by Dametta, a woman of some repute, who may not be amenable to your request.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANIXA101_01494_SEQ_02: Dametta is willing to grant you permission to use her facilities─provided you carry out a simple task in exchange. A particularly persistent opo-opo has been raiding her stores for some time, and she would have you permanently resolve the situation. With the aid of ripe Mun-Tuy beans, lure the beastkin out from his lair near E-Tatt's Spire and end his reign of terror once and for all. Alternatively, you could converse with the woman further and attempt to persuade her...but that approach may not end well.
TEXT_BANIXA101_01494_SEQ_03: The notorious bean thief is no more, and the claw you have extricated from its carcass should serve as ample proof. Present it and the bladder component materials to Dametta in Hyrstmill.
TEXT_BANIXA101_01494_SEQ_04:
The claw serves both to horrify Dametta's sensibilities and satisfy her requirements. With the materials provided to you by Yazel Ahuatan, synthesize a bladder component, and deliver it to him at Ehcatl.

※In the event that the status Facility Access: Production wears off or the synthesis ends in failure, you may try again by speaking with Dametta.
TEXT_BANIXA101_01494_SEQ_05: The most able of Ixal accepts your work with a mighty squa-hawk, satisfied with its quality. Within you he sees a great potential─one which he likens to his own, glimpsed by Chief Totoloc long ago. Weighty words indeed, one might say─though one must always consider the source, as well.
TEXT_BANIXA102_01495_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Able though he may be, there are some situations which Yazel Ahuatan the Able cannot resolve by himself.
※The crafting portion of this quest is recommended for Disciples of the Hand level 1 and above, and the battle portion for Disciples of War or Magic level 41 and above.
TEXT_BANIXA102_01495_SEQ_01:
Yazel Ahuatan has asked you to craft a bladder lining component so that he might mollify Methuli Cattlan. He has provided the materials, but the facilities are another matter; only those in Hyrstmill, under the care of Dametta, will do. Journey to the hamlet and request her permission.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANIXA102_01495_SEQ_02: Dametta is willing to grant you permission to use her facilities─provided you carry out a simple task in exchange. She has prepared a hearty meal for Paulemont, a Wood Wailer stationed at E-Tatt's Spire. You need only deliver the meal and return with the sack which held her previous delivery. Alternatively, you could converse with the woman further and attempt to persuade her...but that approach may not end well.
TEXT_BANIXA102_01495_SEQ_03: Paulemont is relieved to receive the meal from someone other than Dametta for a change. He presses an empty sack into your hands and insists that you not forget to return it to his benefactor.
TEXT_BANIXA102_01495_SEQ_04:
The sack serves both to inflame Dametta's passions and satisfy her requirements. With the materials provided to you by Yazel Ahuatan, synthesize a bladder lining component, and deliver it to him at Ehcatl.

※In the event that the status Facility Access: Production wears off or the synthesis ends in failure, you may try again by speaking with Dametta.
TEXT_BANIXA102_01495_SEQ_05: Yazel Ahuatan accepts your work with a mighty squa-hawk, certain that it will meet with Methuli's satisfaction. The most modest of Ixal's posterior shall remain pristine...until next he incurs the wrath of the Hard.
TEXT_BANIXA103_01496_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
As ablest of Ixal, Yazel Ahuatan has a reputation to maintain.
※The crafting portion of this quest is recommended for Disciples of the Hand level 1 and above, and the battle portion for Disciples of War or Magic level 41 and above.
TEXT_BANIXA103_01496_SEQ_01:
The recent loss of starboard hull component materials has placed Yazel Ahuatan in a precarious position. So that none may have cause to doubt his ableness, recover the materials his courier abandoned when attacked by Ixal in Treespeak.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANIXA103_01496_SEQ_02: After a brief skirmish, the materials are yours. However, returning the materials will not suffice to redeem Yazel Ahuatan. Visit the crafting facility at Treespeak Stables, and present the component materials to Nellemond, so that you may use the facilities to construct the requisite components.
TEXT_BANIXA103_01496_SEQ_03:
You have handed over the component materials to Nellemond, and gained access to the crafting facility. Synthesize two starboard hull components, and deliver them to Yazel Ahuatan at Ehcatl.

※In the event that the status Facility Access: Finishing wears off or the synthesis ends in failure, you may try again by speaking with Nellemond.
TEXT_BANIXA103_01496_SEQ_04: The squa-hawk which echoes throughout Ehcatl is one of ultimate relief, as Yazel Ahuatan's comrades no longer have cause to doubt his competence. Maintaining an image as an able Ixal can be difficult at times, but the adulation of Ixali maidens more than justifies the effort─or so Yazel Ahuatan would doubtless say, if the question were put to him.
TEXT_BANIXA104_01497_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
An able Ixal keeps able allies close, and Yazel Ahuatan the Able prays you are one such .
※The crafting portion of this quest is recommended for Disciples of the Hand level 1 and above, and the battle portion for Disciples of War or Magic level 41 and above.
TEXT_BANIXA104_01497_SEQ_01:
While transporting a shipment of larboard hull component materials to Ehcatl, one of Yazel Ahuatan's carriers was waylaid by Gridanian forces. To ensure that the construction of the Dezul Qualan continues as scheduled, you have been asked to retrieve the component materials. Should the Ehcatl Nine carrier yet live, you will likely find him in hiding. If so, with the chat mode in Say, enter the password “With the Wind” to identify yourself as a friend.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANIXA104_01497_SEQ_02: You find the carrier alive and well, and retrieve from him the component materials. Alas, simply completing the delivery will not suffice, as the components themselves are urgently needed. Visit the crafting facility at Treespeak Stables, and present the component materials to Nellemond, so that you may use the facilities to construct the requisite components.
TEXT_BANIXA104_01497_SEQ_03:
You have handed over the component materials to Nellemond, and gained access to the crafting facility. Synthesize three larboard hull components, and deliver them to Yazel Ahuatan at Ehcatl.

※In the event that the status Facility Access: Finishing wears off or the synthesis ends in failure, you may try again by speaking with Nellemond.
TEXT_BANIXA104_01497_SEQ_04: Your unexpected display of initiative surprises the able Yazel Ahuatan, who expresses his delight with a requisite squa-hawk. Thanks to your efforts, he will be held in even higher esteem by his comrades, for able is the Ixal served by able subordinates.
TEXT_BANIXA401_01498_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Tazel Meyean the Lettered has need of a capable craftsman to lend form to his genius.
※The crafting portion of this quest is recommended for Disciples of the Hand level 10 and above.
TEXT_BANIXA401_01498_SEQ_01:
Tazel Meyean has asked you to craft for him four high-quality starboard wing components for the Dezul Qualan. In order to obtain the requisite materials, you must first gather fifteen pristine oak branches and five pristine oak logs in the vicinity of Proud Creek.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANIXA401_01498_SEQ_02: You have obtained the pristine oak branches and logs. Make your way to Fallgourd Float, and offer them to the Black Rabbit trader stationed there in exchange for the materials required in the synthesis.
TEXT_BANIXA401_01498_SEQ_03: You have obtained several sets of starboard wing component materials. Present them to Hildeyerd at the Bobbing Cork to gain access to the crafting facility under her care.
TEXT_BANIXA401_01498_SEQ_04:
Hildeyerd has prepared the crafting facility for your use. With the materials you have obtained, synthesize four high-quality starboard wing components, and deliver them to Tazel Meyean at Ehcatl.

※In the event that the status Facility Access: Detailing wears off or the synthesis ends in failure, you may try again by speaking with Hildeyerd.
TEXT_BANIXA401_01498_SEQ_05: You have delivered the starboard wing components to Tazel Meyean, who squawks in sheer delight. The Ixal is most impressed by your craftsmanship, and will doubtless turn to you again to lend form to his genius.
TEXT_BANIXA402_01499_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Tazel Meyean the Lettered has precision components that want for crafting.
※The crafting portion of this quest is recommended for Disciples of the Hand level 10 and above.
TEXT_BANIXA402_01499_SEQ_01:
Tazel Meyean has asked you craft for him four high-quality larboard wing components for the Dezul Qualan. In order to obtain the requisite materials, you must first gather fifteen small granite rocks and five large granite rocks in the area west of Peacegarden.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANIXA402_01499_SEQ_02: You have obtained the small and large granite rocks. Make your way to Fallgourd Float, and offer them to the independent merchant stationed there in exchange for the materials you require.
TEXT_BANIXA402_01499_SEQ_03: You have obtained several sets of larboard wing component materials. Present them to Hildeyerd at the Bobbing Cork in order to gain access to the crafting facility under her care.
TEXT_BANIXA402_01499_SEQ_04:
Hildeyerd has prepared the crafting facility for your use. With the materials you have obtained, synthesize four high-quality larboard wing components, and deliver them to Tazel Meyean at Ehcatl.

※In the event that the status Facility Access: Detailing wears off or the synthesis ends in failure, you may try again by speaking with Hildeyerd.
TEXT_BANIXA402_01499_SEQ_05: You have delivered the larboard wing components to Tazel Meyean, who squawks in sheer delight. The Ixal is most impressed by your attention to detail, and will doubtless turn to you again as he continues striving for perfection.
TEXT_BANIXA403_01500_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Tazel Meyean the Lettered has a mind to test his latest brainchild.
※The crafting portion of this quest is recommended for Disciples of the Hand level 10 and above, and the battle portion for Disciples of War or Magic level 47 and above.
TEXT_BANIXA403_01500_SEQ_01:
Tazel Meyean has asked you to craft for him a high-quality starboard wing control component, that he might test the revolutionary mechanism he has conceived. The requisite materials can be obtained from treasure pots found within the Ixali logging grounds.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANIXA403_01500_SEQ_02: You have obtained several sets of starboard wing control component materials. Present them to Hildeyerd at the Bobbing Cork in order to gain access to the crafting facility under her care.
TEXT_BANIXA403_01500_SEQ_03:
Hildeyerd has prepared the crafting facility for your use. With the materials you have obtained, synthesize a high-quality starboard wing control component, and deliver it to Tazel Meyean at Ehcatl.

※In the event that the status Facility Access: Detailing wears off or the synthesis ends in failure, you may try again by speaking with Hildeyerd.
TEXT_BANIXA403_01500_SEQ_04: You have delivered the starboard wing control component to Tazel Meyean, who squawks in sheer delight. The Ixal is most impressed by your ability to craft precisely to specification, and will doubtless request your services again as he conceives exciting new ideas.
TEXT_BANIXA404_01501_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Tazel Meyean the Lettered has a request of the crafting persuasion to make.
※The crafting portion of this quest is recommended for Disciples of the Hand level 10 and above, and the battle portion for Disciples of War or Magic level 47 and above.
TEXT_BANIXA404_01501_SEQ_01:
Tazel Meyean has asked you to craft for him three high-quality larboard wing control components to replace ones that did not function as intended. The requisite materials can be found within the Ixali logging grounds. To procure them, you will require help from the Ehcatl Nine silencer hiding near the balloon landing. With the chat mode in Say, enter the password “Wings Unbending” to get the Ixal's attention.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANIXA404_01501_SEQ_02: You have obtained the requisite larboard wing control component materials. Present them to Hildeyerd at the Bobbing Cork in order to gain access to the crafting facility under her care.
TEXT_BANIXA404_01501_SEQ_03:
Hildeyerd has prepared the crafting facility for your use. With the materials you have obtained, synthesize three high-quality larboard wing control components, and deliver them to Tazel Meyean at Ehcatl.

※In the event that the status Facility Access: Detailing wears off or the synthesis ends in failure, you may try again by speaking with Hildeyerd.
TEXT_BANIXA404_01501_SEQ_04: You have delivered the larboard wing control components to Tazel Meyean, who squawks in sheer delight. Thanks to you, the Ixal may resume his efforts to take the Ehcatl Nine high into the heavens.
TEXT_BANIXA405_01502_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Tazel Meyean the Lettered has need of a versatile adventurer to reclaim stolen materials and craft them into balloon components.
※The crafting portion of this quest is recommended for Disciples of the Hand level 10 and above, and the battle portion for Disciples of War or Magic level 47 and above.
TEXT_BANIXA405_01502_SEQ_01:
Tazel Meyean had intended to ask you to craft high-quality transmission components for the Dezul Qualan. Alas, the materials required for their synthesis have been stolen by a band of Qiqirn. Speak with Miah Molkot at Eugenia's Spire to learn where the vile vermin may have fled.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANIXA405_01502_SEQ_02: Miah Molkot informs you that the Qiqirn fled north of the spire after ransacking the Ixali caravan. Make your way to Proud Creek, and reclaim the materials from three of the pesky pests─by force if necessary.
TEXT_BANIXA405_01502_SEQ_03: You have reclaimed three sets of transmission component materials. Present them to Hildeyerd at the Bobbing Cork in order to gain access to the crafting facility under her care.
TEXT_BANIXA405_01502_SEQ_04:
Hildeyerd has prepared the crafting facility for your use. With the materials you have obtained, synthesize two high-quality transmission components, and deliver them to Tazel Meyean at Ehcatl.

※In the event that the status Facility Access: Detailing wears off or the synthesis ends in failure, you may try again by speaking with Hildeyerd.
TEXT_BANIXA405_01502_SEQ_05: You have delivered the transmission components to Tazel Meyean, who squawks in sheer delight. The Ixal expresses his gratitude and admiration for you. Amidst the centuries-old conflict between man and Ixal, your friendship with the Ehcatl Nine is a shining star of hope for peace and understanding.
TEXT_BANIXA406_01503_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Tazel Meyean the Lettered would turn to you for your crafting expertise.
※The crafting portion of this quest is recommended for Disciples of the Hand level 10 and above, and the battle portion for Disciples of War or Magic level 47 and above.
TEXT_BANIXA406_01503_SEQ_01:
Tazel Meyean the Lettered has asked you to craft four high-quality components for his revolutionary heat vent unit. Doing so requires that you have access to Gerolt's forge in Hyrstmill. By way of payment for using the facility, the Ixali inventor bids you obtain three pieces of plate worn by the dullahans that prowl Proud Creek.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.

TEXT_BANIXA501_01509_SEQ_01:
Duzal Meyean has asked you to synthesize components for the system of speaking tubes to be installed on the Dezul Qualan. Proper equipment to craft these items, however, is only found at the Diamond Forge in Revenant's Toll. Speak with forgewife Fyrbryda about receiving permission to utilize the facilities.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANIXA501_01509_SEQ_02: Fyrbryda's rules for the forge are simple: one, all materials brought inside must be inspected for contraband, and two, if anyone wishes to make use of the facilities, they must first provide a generous contribution to the Revenant's Toll chapter of the Adventurers' Guild. Currently, the guild is in short supply of tangle skippers─a rare variety of air-breathing fish from which medicine for the pox is brewed. Travel west to the Tangle and catch two skippers using moth pupae.
TEXT_BANIXA501_01509_SEQ_03: You have caught two tangle skippers. Return them to Fyrbryda before the heat sees them grow ripe. Also, do not forget to submit the speaking tube component materials to the forgewife for inspection.
TEXT_BANIXA501_01509_SEQ_04:
Fyrbryda has granted you access to the Diamond Forge's crafting facilities. Use the materials given to you by Duzal Meyean and inspected by Fyrbryda to synthesize a high-quality speaking tube component. Once completed, return to Ehcatl with the item.

※In the event that the status Facility Access: Specialization wears off or the synthesis ends in failure, you may try again by speaking with Fyrbryda.
TEXT_BANIXA501_01509_SEQ_05: You have delivered the speaking tube component to Duzal Meyean. The veteran is taken aback by the obvious effort put into crafting the complex piece and expresses his desire to work with you once again in the future.

TEXT_BANIXA301_01514_SEQ_00:

※The crafting portion of this quest is recommended for Disciples of the Hand level 6 and above.
TEXT_BANIXA301_01514_SEQ_01:
Rozol Cattlan the Prudent has asked for your assistance in the crafting of high-quality components for the Dezul Qualan's cockpit exterior. However, before you can gain access to the facilities necessary for the synthesis, you must first find a way to bribe the young Highwind Skyways representative in charge of overseeing the equipment. Rozol believes you may be able to achieve this with a saint carp─a rare type of fish living in the frigid waters of the Coerthas River to the west of the Observatorium. It is said that saint carp are best caught with moth pupae.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANIXA301_01514_SEQ_02: You have caught a saint carp. Now hurry the fish to Templeton at the Observatorium while it is still fresh, and convince the corrupt lad to grant you use of the crafting facilities. It may also be wise to allow him to inspect the materials entrusted to you by Rozol, so as not to arouse suspicion amongst his ever-watching superiors.
TEXT_BANIXA301_01514_SEQ_03:
Templeton is every bit as unscrupulous as advertised, and now you have full access to the Highwind Skyways temporary crafting facilities. Use the materials given to you by Rozol and inspected by Templeton to synthesize two high-quality cockpit exterior components, and deliver the finished products to Ehcatl.

※In the event that the status Facility Access: Production II wears off or the synthesis ends in failure, you may try again by speaking with Templeton.
TEXT_BANIXA301_01514_SEQ_04: You have delivered the cockpit exterior components to Rozol Cattlan the Prudent and, as much as it pains him to do so, he begins to see why Chief Sezul Totoloc has elected to place his trust in a “featherless neuker.” As for the crooked Skyways representative─it might be best that, for now, his supervisors remain unaware of your mutually beneficial relationship with the young man.
TEXT_BANIXA302_01515_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
