※The crafting portion of this quest is recommended for Disciples of the Hand level 6 and above.
TEXT_BANIXA302_01515_SEQ_01:
Moderately satisfied with your work on previous Dezul Qualan components, Rozol Cattlan the Prudent wishes you to focus your efforts on crafting parts for the cockpit interior. Materials for these components have already been delivered part of the way to the Observatorium, and you need only collect them from the Ehcatl Nine carrier waiting at Skyfire Locks. Prove you are a friend of the Nine by entering the password “Now Fall” with the chat mode in Say where the carrier can hear you. Also, speak with Roiteloin of the Locks and ask if he has any pine lumber scraps (with which to bribe Templeton, of course).

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANIXA302_01515_SEQ_02: Present Templeton at the Observatorium with your timely bribe and the Dezul Qualan component materials for inspection.
TEXT_BANIXA302_01515_SEQ_03:
Templeton is every bit as unprincipled as advertised, and now you have full access to the Highwind Skyways temporary crafting facilities. Use the materials given to you by the Ehcatl Nine carrier and inspected by Templeton to synthesize two high-quality cockpit interior components, and deliver the finished products to the faction.

※In the event that the status Facility Access: Production II wears off or the synthesis ends in failure, you may try again by speaking with Templeton.
TEXT_BANIXA302_01515_SEQ_04: You have delivered the cockpit interior components to Rozol Cattlan the Prudent and though he attempted to hide it, the knotcounter was visibly pleased. As construction on the Dezul Qualan continues, the Ehcatl Nine are coming to the realization that they may have never made it this far along if it were not for the industriousness of their featherless collaborators.
TEXT_BANIXA303_01516_SEQ_00:

※The crafting portion of this quest is recommended for Disciples of the Hand level 6 and above, and the battle portion for Disciples of War or Magic level 45 and above.
TEXT_BANIXA303_01516_SEQ_01:
Content with your work on previous dirigible components, Rozol Cattlan the Prudent has asked for your assistance in the crafting of a high-quality component for the Dezul Qualan's ballast. The materials for the task can be acquired from an independent sutler named Duvicauroix who is known to peddle his wares in and around the Observatorium. Also, you will need to procure a bribe for the finicky Templeton. Rozol has provided you with a shearing knife with which you are to remove the beard of one of the feral crocs lurking about Skyfire Locks.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANIXA303_01516_SEQ_02: Take the freshly sheared feral croc beard to Templeton at the Observatorium and present it and the ballast component materials for inspection.
TEXT_BANIXA303_01516_SEQ_03:
Templeton is every bit as dishonorable as advertised, and now you have full access to the Highwind Skyways temporary crafting facilities. Use the materials given to you by the Duvicauroix and inspected by Templeton to synthesize a high-quality ballast component, and deliver the finished product to the faction.

※In the event that the status Facility Access: Production II wears off or the synthesis ends in failure, you may try again by speaking with Templeton.
TEXT_BANIXA303_01516_SEQ_04: You have delivered the ballast component to Rozol Cattlan the Prudent. After this success, the Ixal seems to have given up his feeble attempts to hide his amazement at your work. As for Templeton, the lad seems overly bold in his demands, causing you to worry how much longer this mummer's farce can continue before someone of standing within the Highwind Skyways hierarchy learns of their representative's misdeeds and reassigns him to someplace darker and colder than even Coerthas.
TEXT_BANIXA304_01517_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync

※The crafting portion of this quest is recommended for Disciples of the Hand level 6 and above, and the battle portion for Disciples of War or Magic level 45 and above.
TEXT_BANIXA304_01517_SEQ_01:
The Dezul Qualan's instrument panel is a complex piece of machinery─too complex, in fact, for the clumsy claws of even the most skilled Ixali crafter. Impressed with your work on larger items, Rozol Cattlan believes it time to test your hand at tasks which require more precision. The materials he was able to provide you with; however, the bribe for young Templeton you will have to earn on your own. For whatever reason, he requires a biast claw, of all things. Fortunately, the hills to the west of the Observatorium are literally crawling with hungry biasts.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANIXA304_01517_SEQ_02: Take the bloody biast claw and the instrument panel component materials to Templeton at the Observatorium.
TEXT_BANIXA304_01517_SEQ_03:
Templeton is every bit as despicable as advertised, and now you have full access to the Highwind Skyways temporary crafting facilities. Use the materials given to you by the Rozol Cattlan and inspected by Templeton to synthesize a high-quality instrument panel component, and deliver the finished product to the faction.

※In the event that the status Facility Access: Production II wears off or the synthesis ends in failure, you may try again by speaking with Templeton.
TEXT_BANIXA304_01517_SEQ_04: You have delivered the expertly crafted instrument panel component to Rozol Cattlan the Prudent, leaving him in awe at your skill as well as your willingness to assist his faction, despite the fact you and he are so different. He makes it a point to voice his gratitude to Chief Sezul Totoloc who has made possible this once unthinkable alliance.

The knotcounter also does not believe a thing Templeton says, so he warns you to be ready to perform some random task for the unappreciative sot.

TEXT_BANIXA305_01518_SEQ_02: Too bothered to walk up a few flights of stairs, Templeton agrees to allow you access to the crafting facilities only if you will deliver a Highwind Skyways timetable to Jocea atop the astroscope tower and return with a signature proving she received the document.
TEXT_BANIXA305_01518_SEQ_03: You have upheld your end of the bargain and delivered the timetable to Jocea. Now return to Templeton with her signature─proof proper of your deed.
TEXT_BANIXA305_01518_SEQ_04:

Use the materials given to you by Rozol Cattlan and inspected by Templeton to synthesize a high-quality aerodynamo component, and deliver the finished product to the faction.

※In the event that the status Facility Access: Production II wears off or the synthesis ends in failure, you may try again by speaking with Templeton.

 Quest Sync
Duzal Meyean the Steady seeks a discerning Disciple of the Hand to assist his team of crafts...birds in fixing the flaws of vital components.
※The crafting portion of this quest is recommended for Disciples of the Hand level 15 and above, and the battle portion for Disciples of War or Magic level 48 and above.
TEXT_BANIXA506_01519_SEQ_01:
Duzal Meyean has asked you to synthesize high-quality steering mechanism components to be installed on the Dezul Qualan. Proper equipment to craft these items, however, is only found at the Diamond Forge in Revenant's Toll. Speak with forgewife Fyrbryda about receiving permission to utilize the facilities.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANIXA506_01519_SEQ_02: Fyrbryda's rules for the forge are simple: one, all materials brought inside must be inspected for contraband, and two, if anyone wishes to make use of the facilities, they must first provide a generous contribution to the Revenant's Toll chapter of the Adventurers' Guild. Currently, the guild is concerned about a group of Coerthans harassing travelers who pass near Camp Revenant's Toll. Make your way to their campsite and force them to leave, by any means necessary.
TEXT_BANIXA506_01519_SEQ_03: You have resolved the situation in the same way as countless ones before. Return to Fyrbryda and relay to her the good news. Also, do not forget to submit the steering mechanism component materials to the forgewife for inspection.
TEXT_BANIXA506_01519_SEQ_04:
Fyrbryda has granted you access to the Diamond Forge's crafting facilities. Use the materials given to you by Duzal Meyean and inspected by Fyrbryda to synthesize high-quality steering mechanism components. Once completed, return to Ehcatl with the items.

※In the event that the status Facility Access: Specialization wears off or the synthesis ends in failure, you may try again by speaking with Fyrbryda.
TEXT_BANIXA506_01519_SEQ_05: You have delivered the steering mechanism components to Duzal Meyean. One look at your exquisite craftsmanship has made plain the error in his work, reminding him that no man─or bird─is perfect. Thanks to your efforts, the Ixal are now one step closer to completing the Dezul Qualan.
TEXT_BANIXA601_01520_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
A particular school of supply chain management operates exclusively on barters, blackmail, and word of mouth, and Jezul Ahuatan the Second is an enthusiastic adherent of this philosophy.
※The crafting portion of this quest is recommended for Disciples of the Hand level 16 and above.
TEXT_BANIXA601_01520_SEQ_01:
Jezul Ahuatan has sweet-talked you into crafting components for escape flyers. But first, you must be the fisher of men─or of one woman, in particular. Catch three snow smelt in the Dragonhead latrines using moth pupae.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANIXA601_01520_SEQ_02: The woman you must reel in is known only as the stubborn sutler. The moniker notwithstanding, the three plump snow smelt now in your possession will surely soften her heart and persuade her to yield up the materials you need for your crafting task.
TEXT_BANIXA601_01520_SEQ_03: You have taken possession of the escape flyer component materials. Present them to Norbettaux at Camp Dragonhead in order to gain access to the crafting facility under his care.
TEXT_BANIXA601_01520_SEQ_04:
Norbettaux has prepared the crafting facility for your use. With the materials you have obtained, synthesize a high-quality escape flyer component, and deliver it to Jezul Ahuatan at Ehcatl.

※In the event that the status Facility Access: Specialization II wears off or the synthesis ends in failure, you may try again by speaking with Norbettaux.
TEXT_BANIXA601_01520_SEQ_05: Jezul Ahuatan squawks in excitement over the speed and sureness of your crafting. Who would have thought that your experience as a fisher would prove to be of such use in the making of escape flyers?
TEXT_BANIXA602_01521_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Jezul Ahuatan the Second knows that where the monetary system holds no sway, barter must come into greater play.
※The crafting portion of this quest is recommended for Disciples of the Hand level 16 and above.
TEXT_BANIXA602_01521_SEQ_01:
Jezul Ahuatan has bamboozled you into crafting spare tank components. But first, you must reap what you have─or rather, some other botanist has─sown. The forests around Camp Dragonhead are rich in quality timber; harvest fifteen ruby spruce branches and five ruby spruce logs.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANIXA602_01521_SEQ_02: Your arms are sticky with sap, and sawdust powders your hair. Ah, to be a lumberjack and work all day! The smell of fresh-cut spruce will surely lift the spirit of even the one they call the sullen sutler.
TEXT_BANIXA602_01521_SEQ_03: You have acquired a set of spare tank component materials. Present them to Norbettaux at Camp Dragonhead in order to gain access to the crafting facility under his care.
TEXT_BANIXA602_01521_SEQ_04:
Norbettaux has prepared the crafting facility for your use. With the materials you have obtained, synthesize two high-quality components for a spare ceruleum tank, and deliver them to Jezul Ahuatan at Ehcatl.

※In the event that the status Facility Access: Specialization II wears off or the synthesis ends in failure, you may try again by speaking with Norbettaux.
TEXT_BANIXA602_01521_SEQ_05: Jezul Ahuatan is excessively enthused about your bout of gathering and crafting, which has been rather heavier on industry than inspiration. Your ability to complete even the most tedious of tasks is apparently a gift. Cherish it.
TEXT_BANIXA603_01522_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
According to Jezul Ahuatan the Second, regard is to be treasured, praise is to be enjoyed, and flattery discarded for the dross it is.
※The crafting portion of this quest is recommended for Disciples of the Hand level 16 and above.
TEXT_BANIXA603_01522_SEQ_01:
Jezul Ahuatan has challenged you to craft refabrication components. But first, you must attend to a miner─er, minor─detail. The Camp Dragonhead area is a garden of earthly delights to a seasoned prospector such as yourself. Prise fifteen chunks of furite and five chunks of high-quality furite from the ground to trade for much-needed crafting materials.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANIXA603_01522_SEQ_02: There was an iciness to the ground that you trod, and you are glad to have all the minerals you need. The sprightly sutler may believe he has lost his best prospector, but after one look at you, he will surely discover that he has gained one instead.
TEXT_BANIXA603_01522_SEQ_03: The sprightly sutler trades you the material, but proves to be more interested in supper than superlatives. Still, barley soup goes down easier than humble pie. Think on that as you give Norbettaux the material and have him prepare the crafting facility.
TEXT_BANIXA603_01522_SEQ_04:
Norbettaux has prepared the crafting facility for your use. With the materials you have obtained, synthesize two high-quality refabrication components, and deliver them to Jezul Ahuatan at Ehcatl.

※In the event that the status Facility Access: Specialization II wears off or the synthesis ends in failure, you may try again by speaking with Norbettaux.
TEXT_BANIXA603_01522_SEQ_05: Jezul Ahuatan examines the fruits of your labor and pronounces himself satisfied─with a caveat. Could it be that the sharp-eyed Second somehow saw into your heart? Clearly, there is more to this birdman than showy wings and fast squawks...
TEXT_BANIXA604_01523_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
The newest request from Jezul Ahuatan the Second reminds you that transaction is a web, not a chain─and every web has its spider.
※The crafting portion of this quest is recommended for Disciples of the Hand level 16 and above, and the battle portion for Disciples of War or Magic level 49 and above.
TEXT_BANIXA604_01523_SEQ_01:
Jezul Ahuatan has asked you to craft isolator components for the airship Dezul Qualan, but talk of widespread material shortage tells you that this is no matter of a short jaunt to some sutler or the other. Only an audience with Tataramu will tell.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANIXA604_01523_SEQ_02: Ever dainty as a phial of nightshade and soft-spoken in the manner of someone accustomed to being listened to, Tataramu tells you that the only materials to be had are at the Gates of Judgement in Coerthas, where an Ishgardian trader awaits his sack of gil.
TEXT_BANIXA604_01523_SEQ_03: The Ishgardian trader has been met and paid, and you have had your fill of cryptic talk for the day. Think what a relief it would be to hand the materials to Norbettaux, and hear his easy chatter as he prepares the crafting facility for your use.
TEXT_BANIXA604_01523_SEQ_04:
With his usual deftness, Norbettaux readies the crafting facility for you. With the materials you have obtained, synthesize three high-quality isolator components, and deliver them to Jezul Ahuatan at Ehcatl.

※In the event that the status Facility Access: Detailing II wears off or the synthesis ends in failure, you may try again by speaking with Norbettaux.
TEXT_BANIXA604_01523_SEQ_05: Such is Jezul Ahuatan's relief at taking delivery of the isolator components that you are struck anew by the burden he bears as the Second of Ehcatl. In times of unrest, all must become adventurers─and trust in one another to acquire what is so urgently needed.
TEXT_BANIXA605_01566_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
A crafter makes and a warrior unmakes. What then is an adventurer, who does both and more?
※The crafting portion of this quest is recommended for Disciples of the Hand level 16 and above, and the battle portion for Disciples of War or Magic level 49 and above.
TEXT_BANIXA605_01566_SEQ_01:
Jezul Ahuatan wonders if you might be able to craft some hyperconductor components. You must begin by collecting an unusual material. In the Ogre's Belly in the Coerthas highlands, there are many fell things─among them a swarm of will-o'-the-wykes. Slaying one will draw the ire of St. Daniffen's fire, from the vanquished husk of which you can obtain a sample of semi-stable ectoplasm.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANIXA605_01566_SEQ_02: The ectoplasm pulses with hypnotic energy, but you have better things to do than stare slack-jawed into the light. Present the ectoplasm to Norbettaux at Camp Dragonhead, and ask him to grant you access to the crafting facility.
TEXT_BANIXA605_01566_SEQ_03:
Norbettaux has prepared the crafting facility for your use. With the materials you have obtained, synthesize two high-quality hyperconductor components, and deliver them to Jezul Ahuatan at Ehcatl.

※In the event that the status Facility Access: Detailing II wears off or the synthesis ends in failure, you may try again by speaking with Norbettaux.
TEXT_BANIXA605_01566_SEQ_04: Jezul Ahuatan pronounces the hyperconductor components more than satisfactory, and pays you the compliment of speaking to you as kindred. Though you have never been and never will be the Second of Ehcatl, you understand of what he speaks─that a  work is more than the sum of  jobs.
TEXT_BANIXA606_01567_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
A wise Ixal knows well the value of auxiliary systems, and Jezul Ahuatan the Second is no exception.
※The crafting portion of this quest is recommended for Disciples of the Hand level 16 and above, and the battle portion for Disciples of War or Magic level 49 and above.
TEXT_BANIXA606_01567_SEQ_01:
Jezul Ahuatan will not declare the Dezul Qualan finished until an auxiliary aerodynamo has been installed. Although their model is nearly complete, it lacks a key component─a component which can only be crafted with materials currently in the possession of the Ixal dwelling in Natalan. Though it be a dangerous task, you have no choice but to infiltrate the stronghold and steal the materials.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANIXA606_01567_SEQ_02: The auxiliary aerodynamo component materials are now yours. Present them to Norbettaux at Camp Dragonhead in order to gain access to the crafting facility under his care.
TEXT_BANIXA606_01567_SEQ_03:
Norbettaux has prepared the crafting facility for your use. With the materials you have obtained, synthesize a high-quality auxiliary aerodynamo component, and deliver it to Jezul Ahuatan at Ehcatl.

※In the event that the status Facility Access: Finishing II wears off or the synthesis ends in failure, you may try again by speaking with Norbettaux.
TEXT_BANIXA606_01567_SEQ_04: Within Jezul Ahuatan beats the heart of an idealist. To him, no risk is too great and no benefit is too small, should it serve to further his people's goals. Should you share his feelings, he would no doubt be grateful─and all the more willing─to entrust you with more dangerous tasks.
TEXT_BANIXA607_01568_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
To rule the skies is not enough; the Ehcatl Nine would do so in style.
※The crafting portion of this quest is recommended for Disciples of the Hand level 16 and above, and the battle portion for Disciples of War or Magic level 49 and above.
TEXT_BANIXA607_01568_SEQ_01:
As the Dezul Qualan nears completion, Jezul Ahuatan finds himself more concerned about the image the Ehcatl Nine will project with their new airship. To simply soar above their earthbound brethren is not enough; they must do so in an airship both powerful and aesthetically pleasing. To this end, Jezul Ahuatan would have you meet with a brother of Ehcatl in Natalan, who has infiltrated enemy ranks and stolen the materials needed to craft high-quality decorative plating components. Venture within the Ixali stronghold and, with the chat mode in Say, enter the password “Amid the Flowers” to identify yourself as a friend.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANIXA607_01568_SEQ_02: The Ehcatl infiltrator responds to your cryptic phrase with an equally cryptic reply of his own, before furnishing you with the decorative plating component materials you seek. Present them to Norbettaux at Camp Dragonhead in order to gain access to the crafting facility under his care.
TEXT_BANIXA607_01568_SEQ_03:
Norbettaux has prepared the crafting facility for your use. With the materials you have obtained, synthesize two decorative plating components, and deliver them to Jezul Ahuatan at Ehcatl.

※In the event that the status Facility Access: Finishing II wears off or the synthesis ends in failure, you may try again by speaking with Norbettaux.
TEXT_BANIXA607_01568_SEQ_04: Never let it be said that the Ehcatl Nine are lacking in passion, for upon receiving your components, Jezul Ahuatan is driven into a frenzy of Ixali pride. The Second echoes the words of his chieftain, declaring that his brethren shall soon fulfill the destiny for which they─and you─have long labored. Indeed, when the Dezul Qualan, that shining culmination of the Ehcatl Nine's hard work, one day takes flight, you can take pride in knowing that the obnoxious decorations which grace its hull are but one of your countless contributions.
TEXT_BANIXA099_01569_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
The Ehcatl Nine manciple has a job fit for an adventurer (which most likely means fetching something).
※The crafting portion of this quest is recommended for Disciples of the Hand level 1 and above.
TEXT_BANIXA099_01569_SEQ_01:
The manciple has asked that you fetch something for the Ehcatl Nine which appears to be in dire need of several somethings. Speak with the warehouse foreman to learn which somethings are in demand and then set about meeting your quota.

※Earn quota points by delivering requested items. A delivery quest is complete once you have earned all the points necessary to meet your quota. Current quota status can be viewed in the duty list.

※The list of currently requested items can be viewed by speaking with the Ehcatl Nine foreman, or by opening the Timers interface located under Duty in the main menu.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANIXA099_01569_SEQ_02: You have met your Ehcatl Nine quota. Speak with the Ehcatl Nine manciple and regale him with tales of your procurement exploits.
TEXT_BANIXA099_01569_SEQ_03: The thoroughly regaled manciple has promised to impart the legendary tale of your deeds to Ehcatl Nine chieftain, Sezul Totoloc. And with that, it should not be long before you have earned the trust of the entire faction, for this day you have learned that the quickest way to an Ixal's heart is through his warehouse.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_SEQ_00:
Sonu Vanu is troubled by a storm gathering in the distance.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_SEQ_01:
Sonu Vanu is grateful for your return to Ok' Zundu, for as if by heavenly coincidence, something is troubling him that only a courageous adventurer can help with. Zundu spies have reported unusual amounts of activity from Ok' Vundu Mok, in the heart of Vundu territory. The Zundu chief is anxious as to what this might mean for his tribe, but cannot risk the uneasy truce with the Vundu by sending his own spies. He asks that you make your way to Ok' Vundu Mok to ascertain what is causing the furor.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_SEQ_02: You gaze over Ok' Vundu Mok and are met with the sight of three Vanu─one wearing a crown of flowers─being chased by a group of Vundu. The three Vanu are cornered, and although they attempt to stand their ground, the Vundu war dance causes them to cower in fear. You stand fearless before the dance, however, and leap to the defense of the shivering Vanu.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_SEQ_03: You slay the Vundu warriors, and the three beleaguered Vanu are safe from harm. Speak with Linu Vali to hear their tale.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_SEQ_04: Linu Vali tells you of her troubled tribe, the Gundu, who were subjugated by the Vundu and now live in fear under their rule. Her tribe seeks freedom from the Vundu, but they will not allow it, threatening any opposition with violence and imprisonment. Linu Vali is surprised when you tell her of Sonu Vanu's request, and asks that you act as a mediator in helping the Gundu tell of their plight. Return to Ok' Zundu and inform Sonu Vanu of the occurrences at Ok' Vundu Mok.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_SEQ_05: You relate the story of your journey into Ok' Vundu to Sonu Vanu, and Linu Vali offers her greetings and gratitude to the chieftain. Taking the story of the Gundu's plight to heart, Sonu Vanu grants the refugees an island to use as a safe haven, despite his attendant's protestations. Linu Vali is ecstatic at this present, promising that the Gundu will be self-sufficient, and work to make a new settlement free from Vundu influence. Go to Nakki Island, to the west of Ok' Zundu, and speak with Linu Vali to listen to her plan for building her tribe's home.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_SEQ_06: Linu Vali seems eager to begin developing the island, but needs your help dealing with some airborne pests. She asks that you rid the surrounding trees of the midge clouds, which conveniently lack the taste for netherling blood. Speak with Luna Vanu to mount a sanuwa and use its powerful buffet to drive the midges from the trees.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_SEQ_07: The midges will no longer trouble the poor Vanu, and the island has become noticeably quieter. Report your success to Linu Vali and see if there is aught more that she requires.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_SEQ_08: Linu Vali appreciates your efforts to rid Nakki Island of its pests, although it seems she may require your aid in the future. She admits to you that she lacks the courage to continue on leading the Gundu towards a new life, expressing doubt in her ability to carry on without her brother and the others that were captured by the Vundu. She asks for your help in building up the Gundu's new home. Your agreement encourages her, and she dubs the new village “Ok' Gundu Nakki.” Eager to get started on construction, she asks you to speak with Muna Vanu to learn what tasks are required of you. Lend your aid to the refugee Vanu Vanu and help them build a new home.
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_SEQ_00:
Linu Vali has heard a rumor, and looks eager to share it with you.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_SEQ_01:
Linu Vali seems in the middle of preparations to leave, and upon speaking to her you find that she means to return to her old home of Ok' Gundu. Rumors tell of Vanu that still inhabit the village, and Linu Vali has a hunch that they may be fellow Gundu in hiding. She asks that you aid her in the search, assuring you that the Vundu likely have lost interest in the area by now. Meet with Linu Vali at the entrance to Ok' Gundu to begin the search for the lost Vanu.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_SEQ_02: You arrive at the entrance to Ok' Gundu to find Linu Vali standing next to an unfamiliar Vanu Vanu. Soon she introduces her companion as Ranu Vali, a botanist renowned among the Gundu. Apparently Ranu Vali fled along with another Gundu by the name of Eenu Vanu, who leapt over the edge of the island in an attempt to escape the Vundu pursuing the pair. Linu Vali, certain that Eenu Vanu survived the fall, asks that you search for him while they keep lookout for any remaining Vundu. Search for any signs of Eenu Vanu in the lower island of Voor Sian Siran.
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_SEQ_03: After searching Voor Sian Siran, you find Eenu Vanu, shaken but not visibly injured. After you tell him that Linu Vali sent you, he hurries to meet her. Return to Linu Vali to join in on the reunion.
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_SEQ_04: The Gundu are elated to finally be reunited, but their happiness is cut short when a group of hostile Gundu arrive, threatening them with capture. Linu Vali, wishing to avoid violence against her former allies, steps forward to drive them away with her sundrop dance. She is unable to muster the ferocity to unnerve her enemies, however, and they counter with their own powerful display. Linu Vali and the others are left shivering in fear, but you stand ready to fight the Gundu off.
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_SEQ_05: You defeat the Gundu warriors after a pitched battle. Check on the safety of Linu Vali and the other Gundu.
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_SEQ_06: Linu Vali expresses her gratitude, but is ashamed of her ineffectual dance. She is still traumatized by the memories of the Vundu attacking her home, and fear takes hold of her when she attempts the dance. However, the safety and health of her companions brings her happiness, and she proceeds to Ok' Zundu to introduce the village's newest residents to Sonu Vanu. Follow the trio and speak with Sonu Vanu when you arrive.
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_SEQ_07: Linu Vali introduces Eenu Vanu and Ranu Vali to Sonu Vanu, who is overjoyed to see the village's growth. However, his attendant Sanu Vanu expresses doubt at the Gundu's ability to sustain themselves. Despite Sanu Vanu's protestations, Linu Vali remains optimistic that the Gundu refugees will be able to make their new home flourish. The three Gundu return to Ok' Gundu Nakki. Go back with them and speak to Linu Vali when you arrive.
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_SEQ_08: Linu Vali admits that Sanu Vanu's objections had some merit, but resolves to grow Ok' Gundu Nakki further in order to dispel future doubts. Now that the village is self-sufficient, it is only a matter of time until the Zundu look towards Ok' Gundu Nakki with respect.
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_SEQ_00:
New friends have brought fortunate news to Linu Vali's ears.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_SEQ_01:
Thanks to the village's new residents, Ok' Gundu Nakki's growth is proceeding apace, and relations between the Gundu and Zundu are improving. The deepening bonds have already borne fruit, and Linu Vali has received word that a Vanu Vanu wearing Gundu colors has been sighted in Vundu territory, attempting to save another of his tribe from abuse at the hands of Vundu youths by shouting “No more violence!” at them. Linu Vali remarks that she had an old friend that often used that phrase to avoid conflict, and surmises that it must be him. She has come up with a plan to rescue him from his oppressors, and asks for your aid. Meet Linu Vali in front of Vundu Ok' Bendu and help her reunite with her erstwhile companion.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_SEQ_02: When you meet with Linu Vali, she explains her plan to draw Ginu Vanu to you with bones inscribed with a mark known only to the two friends. Once Ginu Vanu notices the mark, Linu Vali is sure that he will follow them to their source. Place the bones conspicuously around the area so the Vanu can find them.
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_SEQ_03: You have placed the bones in such a way that even the most oblivious observer could find them. Return to Linu Vali and await Ginu Vanu's arrival.
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_SEQ_04: All goes according to Linu Vali's plan, and Ginu Vanu finds the bones and follows their trail. Upon sighting you, Ginu Vanu puts on a show of aggression to playfully frighten his old friend, but his demeanor quickly becomes friendly. Ginu Vanu agrees to return with you to Ok' Gundu Nakki without argument, but before you can leave a group of Vundu scouts appears nearby. Instead of resorting to violence, Linu Vali decides to scare the Vundu away with her sundrop dance─but first she needs inspiration. /dance for the timid Vanu to awaken the spirit of the warrior within her.
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_SEQ_05: Your dancing rekindles Linu Vali's courage, and she puts on an impressive and terrifying display for the Vundu scouts, sending them running in fear. With your escape route secure, return to Ok' Zundu to introduce Ok' Gundu Nakki's new ally to the Zundu chieftain.
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_SEQ_06: The Zundu chieftain and his attendant are excited to meet yet another of the Gundu's artisans, and Sonu Vanu is eager to see what changes this will bring to the village. The Gundu return to their new home to welcome its new resident. Return with them and speak with Linu Vali when you arrive.
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_SEQ_07: Ok' Gundu Nakki has one more voice among its villagers, and Linu Vali is excited to continue developing her mastery of the sundrop dance. However, she still mourns the absence of her brother, rightful chief of the Gundu tribe, and vows to rescue him from the Vundu. The winds of change are always blowing, and Linu Vali once again asks for you to answer their call when next they beckon.
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_SEQ_00:
Linu Vali has finally received word of her sibling's whereabouts.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_SEQ_01:
Linu Vali can barely contain her excitement when she tells you that a captured Vundu spy has given up information about her brother. According to the spy, Linu Vanu has been moved to a skycage hanging from the Cromlech. Adamant not to miss this long-awaited chance, she rushes off without further explanation. Meet Linu Vali at the Cromlech to aid in the rescue of her brother.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_SEQ_02: You arrive at the Cromlech to find Linu Vali surrounded by Vundu, ready to attack after Linu Vali's ineffectual sundrop dance. Luckily, you dispatch them before any of the petals on Linu Vali's head come to harm. Speak with Linu Vali, who looks eager to get on with her brother's rescue.
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_SEQ_03: It seems the Vundu were lying in wait for any Vanu bold enough to try and rescue Linu Vali's brother. Your skirmish allows a brief window of safety, and Linu Vali asks you to give her brother a sanuwa horn, which he may use to summon a sanuwa and fly to safety. Find the skycage holding her brother and pass him the horn.
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_SEQ_04: After searching the skycages below, you come across a confused Linu Vanu. After you explain the situation to him, he eagerly accepts the sanuwa horn his sister gave you and uses it to summon a sanuwa to escape the stuffy skycage. He dismounts to greet his sister as she is being confronted by yet another group of Vundu warriors. The two share a knowing glance before starting a perfectly synced sundrop dance, the intensity of which sends the Vundu scurrying back to their roosts. The two siblings are safe to have their heartfelt reunion at last, and Linu Vali explains everything that has happened thus far with the Gundu refugees. Her brother seems somewhat skeptical as to the intent of the Zundu tribe's newfound generosity, but nonetheless agrees to visit Ok' Zundu and greet Sonu Vanu. Follow the siblings back to Ok' Zundu and take part in the greeting.
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_SEQ_05: Linu Vali is eager to introduce her brother to the Ok' Zundu chieftain, who affably greets the pair. Linu Vanu comments that Ok' Zundu has been left relatively untouched by the Vundu, and criticizes the Ok' Zundu chieftain for buying his tribe's safety with tributes while others, namely the Gundu, had their homes destroyed. Linu Vali is quick to silence her brother, explaining to him that if not for the Zundu, their tribe would be in an even worse off position. Her brother is surprised at his sister's boldness, and he apologizes for his actions. Sonu Vanu takes Linu Vanu's affront in stride, saying that he wants only for the two tribes to grow closer. The Gundu siblings depart to Ok' Gundu Nakki. Return with them and speak with Linu Vali upon your arrival.
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_SEQ_06: Linu Vanu is appointed chief of Ok' Gundu Nakki, and the village finally has a leader. Linu Vali is relieved that the responsibility of leadership has been passed to her brother, but is worried that their recent meeting with the Zundu may cause trouble between the two tribes further down the road. She has a plan to improve the relations between Zundu and Gundu, and asks that you prepare to lend your aid when she is ready.
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_SEQ_00:
Linu Vali is cooking up a plan to improve relations with the Zundu.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_SEQ_01:
The relations between the Zundu and Gundu have been strained ever since Linu Vanu's remarks at Ok' Zundu. However, Linu Vali has a plan to invite the Zundu to Ok' Gundu Nakki for a feast, an important gesture of friendship in Vanu Vanu culture. Her responsibility is to prepare fish for the main dish, but she requires a rare seasoning, Abalathian rock salt, which is possessed solely by the Vundu. She will head to Voor Sian Siran with her fishing pole, and she asks you to steal into Ok' Vundu Vana and procure a chunk of the salt from the Vundu stores.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_SEQ_02: After searching the Vundu village, you find their stores of Abalathian rock salt and pick the purest looking chunk you can find. Return to Ok' Gundu Nakki and give the salt to Linu Vanu.
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_SEQ_03: You hand over the Abalathian rock salt to Linu Vanu, who is confused as to why his sister asked you to deliver it to him. It seems Linu Vali has neglected to tell her brother of her plans for the feast. Linu Vanu is impressed at her initiative, but regrets that she must go to so much trouble on his account. He thanks you for standing by his sister's side during these troubled times, and even though he knows she has grown, he still worries for her safety, asking you to go check on her at Voor Sian Siran. Journey to the islands and see if the novice cloudfisher has caught anything.
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_SEQ_04: You arrive to see Linu Vali cowering before a hungry-looking cloudworm, and slay the beast before it makes a meal of the Vanu. Check on Linu Vali's safety.
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_SEQ_05: Linu Vali thanks you for saving her yet again. In her concentration she lost sight of her surroundings, allowing the beast to sneak up on her. However, it seems she was able to catch a fish suitable for the feast, and hurries off to Ok' Gundu Nakki to begin preparation.
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_SEQ_06: The feast is a rousing success, with Vanu Vanu of both tribes coming closer through the exchange of quips and stories. The progress of Ok' Gundu Nakki is continuing apace, but the question still remains as to how long this peace can last.
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_SEQ_00:
Even Linu Vali's crown of flowers cannot distract from the distressed look on her face.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_SEQ_01:
The Vundu have discovered Ok' Gundu Nakki's existence, and are demanding that the Zundu surrender the refugees lest both tribes face total destruction. Sonu Vanu has called a meeting at Ok' Zundu to discuss this new threat. Follow the others to Ok' Zundu and speak with Sonu Vanu on your arrival.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_SEQ_02: Upon your arrival to Ok' Zundu the Vanu Vanu begin discussing the Vundu's demands. Sonu Vanu is willing to fight, but it seems his people are hesitant to join a battle they have little chance of winning. After some terse words and arguments, Linu Vali suggests that if the two tribes cannot win by virtue of numbers, then they should rob the Vundu of their will to fight with the sundrop dance. The plan is met with some agreement, but the Zundu's fighting spirit is not what it once was. They need a mighty warrior to show them the sundrop dance and rekindle the flames of fury in their heart. All present agree that you, as the one who defeated Bismarck, should be the one to motivate the Zundu with the sundrop dance. Linu Vali will teach you the steps, but first you must perform the initiation ceremony. Meet Linu Vali at the entrance to Ok' Zundu to begin the ceremony.
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_SEQ_03: You find Linu Vali standing in front of a massive stone sculpture wrought in the shape of a birdlike creature. She explains that the statue depicts the mother of all Vanu, and that in order to earn the right to the sundrop dance, you must dance atop two such statues, baring your soul to their judgment. Ascend the statue and put your most energetic /dance on display.
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_SEQ_04: Through your dance, you lay bare your spirit to the mother of all Vanu. Return to Linu Vali to tell her of your stirring performance.
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_SEQ_05: Your dance impresses Linu Vali, and she guides you to the second ancestral statue. Follow Linu Vali to Vundu Ok' Bendu.
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_SEQ_06: You find Linu Vali standing in front of yet another enormous Vanu Vanu sculpture, this time depicting the father of all Vanu. Once again, /dance on the statue with all the passion your spirit can muster.
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_SEQ_07: The father of all Vanu has seen what your soul looks like. Return to Linu Vali to see what the final step of this ritual is.
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_SEQ_08: Your trial is complete, and Linu Vali can now teach you the dance of her people. Follow her to Ok' Zundu to begin your first lesson.
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_SEQ_09: Upon your arrival at Ok' Zundu, Linu Vali finally teaches you the sundrop dance. As you dance the steps, you can feel generations of Vanu ancestors give weight and power to your movements. After you master the dance, you perform it for the flagging Ok' Zundu citizens. They are so moved by your dance that they immediately agree to join the Gundu in their fight against the Vundu. Both tribes will practice their sundrop dance until the day of the decisive battle. When the time comes, be ready to lend the vigor of your dance as well.
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_SEQ_00:
Linu Vali is ready to face the Vundu, but first would ask one more favor of an old friend.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_SEQ_01:
A party of Vundu has been spotted approaching Ok' Zundu, and Linu Vali steels herself to meet them on the field of battle. However, she asks that you present yourself before the Gundu totem pole and perform the /sundropdance before facing the Vundu. By doing so, the ancestors of the Gundu tribe will grant today's warriors the will to achieve victory.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_SEQ_02: You perform a thunderous display in front of the Gundu totem pole. The ancestors of the Gundu tribe have answered your entreaty, and granted the brave Vanu Vanu strength for the upcoming battle. Report the news of the ancestors' generosity to Linu Vali.
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_SEQ_03: Linu Vali is emboldened by the news of her ancestors' blessing, and is ready to confront the Vundu forthwith. After thanking you for everything you have done for the Gundu, she states that today's battle should be left to the Vanu Vanu to settle, and asks that you go to Ok' Zundu to tell Sonu Vanu that the group's preparations are complete.
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_SEQ_04: Sonu Vanu tells you the Zundu are ready as well, but has one last request of you. You are to stand watch over the battle, so that you may tell the tale of the Zundu and Gundu tribes' last stand should the Vundu emerge victorious. Go to the northeast, where the Vundu have been sighted, and wait for the Vanu Vanu to arrive.
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_SEQ_05: You watch the fateful encounter from above the fields, and see the Vundu come face-to-face with the group of Gundu and Zundu, who respond to the Vundu chieftain's demands with a booming display of their sundrop dance. The Vundu seem unaffected, however, accepting the challenge with their own dance. Succumbing to the Vundu's ferocity, the Gundu and Zundu dancers lose the will to continue. Refusing to leave your allies to their fate, you descend from your position and show the Vundu your own sundrop dance. The Vundu are taken aback by your fury, and the Zundu and Gundu are inspired to match your steps. The renewed power of the sundrop dance strikes fear into the hearts of the Vundu, and they flee back to their village in defeat. With the Gundu and Zundu tribes victorious, they depart into the sunset to celebrate their newfound freedom.
TEXT_BANVAN101_02171_SEQ_00:
Muna Vanu is troubled by growing Vundu aggressions.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANVAN101_02171_SEQ_01:
Muna Vanu has heard troubling reports of Vundu activity at the border of Zundu territory. Unfortunately, his tribe does not have the manpower to respond to these threats. He asks that you patrol the border in his stead, and protect the Gundu from any encroachers you come across. Travel to the border in the northeast and search there for Vundu scouts.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANVAN101_02171_SEQ_02: You have defeated a number of Vundu scouts lurking just within the borders of Zundu territory. Return to Muna Vanu and let him know that this threat to the sovereignty of his tribe has been assuaged.
TEXT_BANVAN101_02171_SEQ_03: Muna Vanu offers his most sincere thanks for your efforts. His tribe still owes the Zundu a great debt of gratitude, and your efforts have gone a long way in repaying their kindness. By the same token, through your contributions to the Gundu, Muna Vanu finds they have become similarly indebted to you.
TEXT_BANVAN102_02172_SEQ_00:
Muna Vanu is looking for a capable adventurer to help procure some unusual ingredients.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANVAN102_02172_SEQ_01:
The Gundu tribe's stores of firewood dwindle. Should they be exhausted, the tribe will be forced to face the cold winds of the Abalathian nights without so much as a campfire to warm them. Wood is hard to come by in the Sea of Clouds, but the knights of Camp Cloudtop have been happy to trade in the past. Knowing that Vanu delicacies are prized by the troops manning the camp, Muna Vanu plans to prepare traditional Gundu catsfoot chew to trade for kindling. This required catsfoot herb can be found near Ok' Zundu, he tells you, northeast of his tribe's camp.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANVAN102_02172_SEQ_02: You find three particularly striking specimens of catsfoot. Hurry them back to Muna Vanu while they are still fresh.
TEXT_BANVAN102_02172_SEQ_03: With the fragrant wildgrasses you gathered, Muna Vanu is able to add the finishing touches to his authentic Gundu cuisine. Now the task remains to take it to Caribault at Camp Cloudtop and trade it for firewood.
TEXT_BANVAN102_02172_SEQ_04: When you show Caribault the catsfoot chew, his eyes light up. His camp has more firewood than they can store, so he is more than happy to let you take all you can carry in exchange for the delicious Gundu treat. See it safely back to Muna Vanu.
TEXT_BANVAN102_02172_SEQ_05: Muna Vanu thanks you sincerely for obtaining firewood for his tribe. He explains that they have a long history of trading with so-called netherlings in the past, and Gundu snacks have always been a powerful bartering resource─he even considers repaying his tribe's growing debt to you in catsfoot chew...
TEXT_BANVAN103_02173_SEQ_00:
Muna Vanu is dreadfully busy, and could do with a hand.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANVAN103_02173_SEQ_01:
Endymions have made a home for themselves in Ok' Zundu, and Muna Vanu bids you remove their nests. The perilous task of dislodging them from high atop the rooftops is made easier and safer by using a sanuwa, a creature capable of creating great gusts of wind that can blast away these aeries of mud and branches as though they were tiny affairs made of mere twig and down. Luna Vanu will have prepared such a beast for you to use in this endeavor─you need only say the word.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANVAN103_02173_SEQ_02:
You speak with Luna Vanu and he is more than happy to supply you with a sanuwa. Its powerful breath will make short work of the endymion nests.

※Speak with Luna Vanu in Ok' Gundu Nakki to mount a sanuwa.
TEXT_BANVAN103_02173_SEQ_03: With the help of the sanuwa, you effortlessly destroy the endymion nests. Return to Muna Vanu and tell him your mission has been completed.
TEXT_BANVAN103_02173_SEQ_04: The venerable Gundu greatly appreciates your contributions to his tribe's safety. He explains that the endymions' encroachment is a recent development, and that incursions by aggressive creatures from the north grow ever more frequent in recent years.
TEXT_BANVAN104_02174_SEQ_00:
Muna Vanu hopes your strength and guile can save his tribe from the risk of starvation.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANVAN104_02174_SEQ_01:
The Gundu's stockpiles of food grow scarcer by the day, while the Vundu larders swell to bursting with supplies. As his people come to terms with the imminent threat of starvation, he bids you slink into the Vundu camp and steal away with four of their pots of food.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANVAN104_02174_SEQ_02: You slip into the Vundu village and abscond with four potfuls of food. Return to Muna Vanu with your takings.
TEXT_BANVAN104_02174_SEQ_03: Ecstatic that his tribe is no longer faced with the grim threat of starvation, Muna Vanu explains the reasons for their lack of food and the Vundu's abundance of it. Now that the Gundu have been forced from the verdant land they once called home, they have nowhere to catch food, while the Vundu hunt and gather at their leisure. With only so much food to go around, and all of it in Vundu larders, the Gundu may have to help themselves to their enemy's supplies for the time being.
TEXT_BANVAN105_02175_SEQ_00:
The Gundu tribe would ask of your services once more.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANVAN105_02175_SEQ_01:
Muna Vanu tells you that your services are required by Luna Vanu. Though he has not been informed of the particulars, knowing well the current uncertainty surrounding the tribe's food supply, he has little doubt that you will be asked to assist in securing foodstuffs. Speak with him and find out.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANVAN105_02175_SEQ_02:
Luna Vanu has a hunger for chigoes. Unfortunately, these quick and cautious creatures are notoriously difficult to catch. However, he suggests a tried-and-true technique that can bag these bugs. A full-grown sanuwa is capable of creating a gust of wind that can blast a chigoe clean from its nest. A fast hunter, lying in wait, can snatch up the bug while it lies dazed by the attack. Three large, old trees at the Gauntlet are likely to have chigoe nests in them. Luna Vanu will wait beneath these trees while you, on sanuwa-back, blast your quarry from its place of hiding.

※Speak with Luna Vanu in Ok' Gundu Nakki to mount a sanuwa.
TEXT_BANVAN105_02175_SEQ_03:
All goes according to plan. The sanuwa effortlessly throws the chigoe from its nest and within seconds Luna Vanu snaps up his prey. Spurred on by the fruitfulness of your efforts, Luna Vanu is eager to visit two more similar trees on the island and gather the bugs making nest within them.

※Speak with Luna Vanu in Ok' Gundu Nakki to mount a sanuwa.
TEXT_BANVAN105_02175_SEQ_04:
You once again blast a chigoe from its nest into Luna Vanu's waiting arms. One tree remains to be harvested.

※Speak with Luna Vanu in Ok' Gundu Nakki to mount a sanuwa.
TEXT_BANVAN105_02175_SEQ_05: You catch yet another bug, fat and juicy, from the last of the trees suspected of housing chigoe nests. Satisfied with today's haul, Luna Vanu returns to the village. Return there yourself and let Muna Vanu know that your work is complete.
TEXT_BANVAN105_02175_SEQ_06: Muna Vanu thanks you for your work. He offers his apologies that his tribesmen ate each and every chigoe without offering you so much as a bite─it seems the bugs were so succulent that all who tasted them could not stop themselves.
TEXT_BANVAN106_02176_SEQ_00:
Muna Vanu is looking haggard and gaunt.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANVAN106_02176_SEQ_01:
You learn that the Gundu's water supplies are precariously close to running out. Muna Vanu is not content to gamble his tribe's fate on waiting for rain, and so asks you to collect spring crystals from Voor Sian Siran to fulfill the need for water. However, since the knights of Camp Cloudtop now gather crystals there, he suggests you seek authorization from the nearby Ishgardians, lest a diplomatic incident result. Travel to the Rosehouse and convince Lady Laniaitte to let you harvest these crystals.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANVAN106_02176_SEQ_02: Laniaitte is more than happy for you to gather spring crystals for the Gundu. In fact, she finds it odd that they even feel they need permission. Collect three spring crystals from Voor Sian Siran, then return to Muna Vanu and let him know that the Rose Knights bear his people no ill will.
TEXT_BANVAN106_02176_SEQ_03: You collect three large, clean spring crystals. Deliver them to Muna Vanu.
TEXT_BANVAN106_02176_SEQ_04: With the crystals you gathered for them, the Gundu tribe will now have enough water to meet their needs. Though they wish to foster a mutually beneficial relationship with the knights of Camp Cloudtop, troubles with the Vundu have left them too busy to work towards this goal. But by speaking to the Ishgardians on their behalf, you may have paved the way to further advancements on this front.
TEXT_BANVAN107_02177_SEQ_00:
Muna Vanu has an eggciting mission for you.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANVAN107_02177_SEQ_01:
Muna Vanu informs you that it is currently laying season for the anzu of Abalathia. Their eggs will make a wonderful supplement to the ever-dwindling stockpiles of food that the Gundu keep. Travel to the Nidifice, where these beasts make their nests, and collect three anzu eggs for him.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANVAN107_02177_SEQ_02: The great and ferocious anzu are unable to stop you from making away with their eggs. Deliver them back to Muna Vanu.
TEXT_BANVAN107_02177_SEQ_03: Muna Vanu is glad to have the succulent eggs you gathered, but even happier that you braved the fearsome anzu for the sake of his people. Only the most fearless Gundu warriors brave these terrifying monsters. That you would do so too puts your allegiance to the Gundu beyond doubt.
TEXT_BANVAN108_02178_SEQ_00:
Muna Vanu is consumed in a fit of pique.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANVAN108_02178_SEQ_01:
A band of lawless Vundu youths have been carousing in the former Gundu village, and Muna Vanu is loath to overlook so disrespectful a display. Bringing the full force of your power against mere children would be a crime, so the wise Gundu suggests a different approach─to buffet them with humiliating blasts of wind from a sanuwa. Luna Vanu will be able to provide you with a beast suitable for this task.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANVAN108_02178_SEQ_02:
Luna Vanu is eager to help you show the belligerent Vundu youths that Ok' Gundu is not their playground. Fly to the former village and give them a good, solid fright with the aid of the sanuwa he has supplied you with.

※Speak with Luna Vanu in Ok' Gundu Nakki to mount a sanuwa.
TEXT_BANVAN108_02178_SEQ_03: You buffet the Vundu delinquents with blasts of air from your sanuwa. Faced with the proposition of continued humiliation, they quickly leave Ok' Gundu. Report back to Muna Vanu with news that the situation has been resolved without exacerbating the tense relationship between the Gundu and Vundu tribes.
TEXT_BANVAN108_02178_SEQ_04: Muna Vanu is glad to hear that you were able to dislodge the Vundu without having to resort to violence. Enough blood has already been spilt over the old Gundu village. There is no need for further slaughter.
TEXT_BANVAN109_02179_SEQ_00:
Muna Vanu knows there are tasks you are uniquely suited to.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANVAN109_02179_SEQ_01:
The comings and goings of the Vundu tribe are largely unknown to the Gundu. This greatly concerns Muna Vanu. He worries that they secretly plot to attack his people, but without the manpower to observe this threat, he remains unable to adequately appraise the situation. Fortunately, the accomplished knights of Camp Cloudtop keep a close eye on all that transpires around them, and should be well aware of what the Vundu are doing. Fearing they will be uneager to take sides in Vanu Vanu politics, he suggests you speak with the knights on his behalf and find out whether his concerns of Vundu attack are unfounded.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANVAN109_02179_SEQ_02: The Ishgardians stationed at the camp tell you that the Vundu have been spotted in the vicinity of Voor Sian Siran. With little further information forthcoming, you will need to travel there yourself to allay Muna Vanu's suspicions.
TEXT_BANVAN109_02179_SEQ_03: You happen upon a Vundu scout muttering something to himself about the Gundu. Report back to Muna Vanu with this news.
TEXT_BANVAN109_02179_SEQ_04: Muna Vanu is pleased with your work. The information you have gathered will help him in taking steps to ensure the safety of all those under his care.
TEXT_BANVAN110_02180_SEQ_00:
Muna Vanu looks like something the gaelicat dragged in.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANVAN110_02180_SEQ_01:
The Vanu Vanu are starting to molt, their oldest feathers falling away to make place for fresh new plumage. But the process leaves them looking disheveled and unkempt. This misfortune is easily ameliorated through simple use of a comb─an item the Gundu find themselves distinctly lacking right now. Fortunately, the Zundu are nearby, and are famed for the quality of their combs. Muna Vanu asks that you obtain some for his tribe, but notes that the Zundu will not part with their craftsmanship for free. He suggests you kill wamouracampae and gather their meat for trade. Start by collecting wet straw to draw these cautious creatures from their nests. It can be found some way south of Ok' Gundu Nakki.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANVAN110_02180_SEQ_02: You find the wet straw where Muna Vanu said it would be. Burn it at a wamoura nest, found near the Blue Window, to draw your prey from its hiding place so that you may slay it and gather its meat.
TEXT_BANVAN110_02180_SEQ_03: You make short work of the wamouracampae and quickly butcher the flesh from their abdomens. Take your prize to Guna Vanu to trade for the combs the Gundu need.
TEXT_BANVAN110_02180_SEQ_04: When you show him the wamouracampa meat, Guna Vanu is more than happy to give you as many combs as you need in exchange for it. Deliver these combs back to Muna Vanu before his tribe starts molting in earnest.
TEXT_BANVAN110_02180_SEQ_05: Muna Vanu thanks you profusely on behalf of the whole Gundu tribe. Without proper combing, the feathers the Vanu Vanu shed will remain hidden within their plumage for days, causing discomfort and itching, and making them look altogether much more scruffy than is respectable. As such, regular combing is a part of life for them─all the more so during molting season.
TEXT_BANVAN201_02181_SEQ_00:
Muna Vanu is watching Ranu Vali sow seeds with little success.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANVAN201_02181_SEQ_01:
Muna Vanu comments that Ranu Vali looks frustrated when she sows her seeds. When he offered to help her, she apparently asked for your help instead. Speak with Ranu Vali about how you can assist in the village's tilling.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANVAN201_02181_SEQ_02: Ranu Vali laments the pitiful soil on their new home and has her doubts whether the island can sustain itself by growing crops in the sandy dirt. Fondly recalling the richness of the soil around her former village, she asks you to return to retrieve some sackfuls to be used on Ok' Gundu Nakki, as well as some fire-touched wind crystals to treat the existing soil.
TEXT_BANVAN201_02181_SEQ_03: You have retrieved three sackfuls of soil from the Gundu village and a handful of fire-touched wind crystals. Return to Ok' Gundu Nakki to deliver the items to Ranu Vali.
TEXT_BANVAN201_02181_SEQ_04: You have handed over the items to Ranu Vali, who holds her ancestors' chosen soil with delight. With the right nutrients and a helping of wind crystals, Ranu Vali claims the earth of Ok' Gundu Nakki will soon bear delicious fruit for all.
TEXT_BANVAN202_02182_SEQ_00:
Muna Vanu is sourly swatting the air around him.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANVAN202_02182_SEQ_01:
Muna Vanu is irritated by the never-ending swarms of biting insects, but notices he is not the only one getting harassed by the pests. Speak to a displeased Ranu Vali about the state of her crops.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANVAN202_02182_SEQ_02: Ranu Vali has tried all manner of remedies to keep midge clouds from taking bites out of her crops, but to no avail. She suspects the vilekin plaguing the island are being blown in on wind drifts from Ok' Zundu. The agitated Gundu pleads with you to ask Luna Vanu to take a village sanuwa with you to eliminate the breeding grounds of the midge swarms.
TEXT_BANVAN202_02182_SEQ_03:
Luna Vanu agrees to lend you one of his precious cloudkin. Ride the sanuwa around Ok' Zundu and curb the stinging midges from flowing on the wind stream.  

※Speak with Luna Vanu in Ok' Gundu Nakki to mount a sanuwa.
TEXT_BANVAN202_02182_SEQ_04: The swarms of midges have been dissipated. Return to Ok' Gundu Nakki to report your success to Ranu Vali.
TEXT_BANVAN202_02182_SEQ_05: Ranu Vali feels relieved from your efforts to control the billowing clouds of pests in Ok' Zundu. The breeding grounds bring new nuisances with each rainfall, but the garden patches of Ok' Gundu Nakki are able to grow in peace for the moment.
TEXT_BANVAN203_02183_SEQ_00:
Muna Vanu is watching Eenu Vanu miss one catch after another.

TEXT_BANVAN203_02183_SEQ_01:

TEXT_BANVAN203_02183_SEQ_02: Eenu Vanu explains that his Zundu friend took his advice to try the fishing spots near Neverreap, but ignored his warning about going to the perilous area alone. As his friend has not returned since last sunrise, Eenu Vanu wants you to check the area to confirm his friend's well-being.
TEXT_BANVAN203_02183_SEQ_03: Focusing entirely on the large fish biting at his line, the Zundu cloudfisher brushes off Eenu Vanu's concern and fails to notice a handful of starved paissas approach the cliff, lured by the scent of the fish basket. You slay the beasts before they have a chance to pounce on the preoccupied cloudfisher. Speak to him again to tell him how close he came to losing his day's work.
TEXT_BANVAN203_02183_SEQ_04: The Zundu cloudfisher is surprised by the attack and grateful to you for fending the paissas off, but he still wants to have one more go at the one that got away. Relay to Eenu Vanu that his cloudfisher friend will return to the village shortly.
TEXT_BANVAN203_02183_SEQ_05: You return to Ok' Gundu Nakki to explain what happened to Eenu Vanu, who seems relieved to know his friend is all right and will return soon. As the fishing spot near Neverreap can be an unpredictable place, he vows to go with his friend next time to make sure they have safety in numbers.
TEXT_BANVAN204_02184_SEQ_00:
Muna Vanu's stomach growls subtly like distant thunder.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANVAN204_02184_SEQ_01:
Muna Vanu recalls it has been a while since he enjoyed a reasonably plump cloudfish and asks you to inquire with Eenu Vanu about when the next haul will arrive.

He asks you to ride on sanuwa-back to the fishing spot near Neverreap in the east and stop the cloudfishers from bleeding the Sea of Clouds dry. Approach Luna Vanu and ask him to lend you one of his cloudkin for the journey.
TEXT_BANVAN204_02184_SEQ_03:
With Luna Vanu's generosity in lending one of the village sanuwas, you mount the cloudkin and set course for Ok' Vundu Vana. Travel to the Vundu tribe's fishing spot and pester the cloudfishers out of their catches using the sanuwa's blustery breath.

※Speak with Luna Vanu in Ok' Gundu Nakki to mount a sanuwa.
TEXT_BANVAN204_02184_SEQ_04: With the fish populations no longer in peril of being depleted, return to Ok' Gundu Nakki and report to Eenu Vanu.
TEXT_BANVAN204_02184_SEQ_05: Eenu Vanu has a good laugh over the reactions of the Vundu cloudfishers when their day's catch was foiled, calling their misery “striking two paissas with a single lightning bolt.” Now that the stock has returned to the wind, the Gundu tribe will once again feast upon fat cloudfish.
TEXT_BANVAN301_02185_SEQ_00:
Muna Vanu stares off into the distance, sighing dejectedly.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANVAN301_02185_SEQ_01:
Muna Vanu is concerned with how long the construction of new Gundu huts is taking. He asks that you speak with the resident builder, Ginu Vanu, and see what can be done to help things along.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANVAN301_02185_SEQ_02: Ginu Vanu explains that the construction materials available are not conducive to expedient work. Good, steel nails, like those used by the Rose Knights, would help him finish his work much more quickly. To acquire said nails, he plans to offer them meat from tsanahales in exchange. This meat is at its most delicious─and valuable─immediately after being butchered, so you will need to slay the beasts yourself. Ginu Vanu recommends using wamoura, found on an island to the south, as bait to draw them out.
TEXT_BANVAN301_02185_SEQ_03: After surveying a nearby island as Ginu Vanu suggested, you happen upon the remains of a recently deceased wamoura, saving you the trouble of slaying one yourself. Head further south to Provenance and use the wamoura meat to lure out two tsanahales.
TEXT_BANVAN301_02185_SEQ_04: No sooner do you arrive at Provenance than two tsanahales attack, lured by the scent of the wamoura meat. You make swift work of them to acquire all that you need to trade with the Rose Knights. Travel to Camp Cloudtop and see about making a trade for nails.
TEXT_BANVAN301_02185_SEQ_05: You present Fabrellet with the Gundu's trade proposition. Seeing the fresh tsanahale meat, he agrees without a second thought. Handing over enough nails to meet any needs Ginu Vanu might have, he assures you that Camp Cloudtop would be more than willing to trade again in future. Return to Ok' Gundu Nakki with your hard-earned nails.
TEXT_BANVAN301_02185_SEQ_06: Ginu Vanu is taken aback by the quantity of steel nails the Rose Knights offered in exchange for meat. Now able to employ proper fasteners in his woodworking, Ginu Vanu is sure that any hut he builds will be capable of weathering even the harshest conditions.
TEXT_BANVAN302_02186_SEQ_00:
Muna Vanu seems unimpressed with huts in Ok' Gundu Nakki.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANVAN302_02186_SEQ_01:
According to Muna Vanu, their resident hut builder, Ginu Vanu, is in need of assistance to continue his work. Speak with him to see what you can do to help.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANVAN302_02186_SEQ_02: Ginu Vanu feels that his work so far is too plain. He insists that Ok' Gundu Nakki needs something unique to set it apart from other settlements, and he has a plan to make it happen. For his idea to work, however, he needs special stones taken from the living masses of rock known as groundsreapers. He asks that you travel to the eastern region of the Blue Window and slay them for building material.
TEXT_BANVAN302_02186_SEQ_03: You make swift work of two groundsreapers and retrieve a golem wart from each. Take them to Ginu Vanu, and see if they suit his needs.
TEXT_BANVAN302_02186_SEQ_04: Ginu Vanu is thrilled to see you have brought him material in near-perfect condition. As he tells it, the groundsreapers, birthed from the soil of islands, sustain themselves using rain and other rocks for sustenance. With building blocks that can essentially feed on bad weather, Ginu Vanu is all but certain the next hut he builds will be the envy of all Vanu villages.
TEXT_BANVAN303_02187_SEQ_00:
Muna Vanu is starting to feel his age.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANVAN303_02187_SEQ_01:
No longer the spirited young hatchling of his youth, Muna Vanu was contemplating how to go hunting as you happen to walk by. It turns out that Ginu Vanu is in need of a hunter to retrieve more materials for building. Muna Vanu asks that you speak with him and see how you can be of assistance.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANVAN303_02187_SEQ_02: Ginu Vanu needs a sturdy material to serve as the frame for the hut he is building, and he insists on using dhalmel bone. He asks that you travel to Last Step and retrieve four from the most hale and hearty dhalmels you can find.
TEXT_BANVAN303_02187_SEQ_03: After careful observation, you locate and make quick work of two stalwart dhalmels, claiming a femur from each. Continue scouting the area to find two more healthy specimens of dhalmel.
TEXT_BANVAN303_02187_SEQ_04: You find yet another pair of dhalmels, and it is not long before you have claimed a shinbone from each of them. Hurry and deliver your bony bounty to Ginu Vanu in Ok' Gundu Nakki.
TEXT_BANVAN303_02187_SEQ_05: Ginu Vanu thanks you for your help. Between the firmness of the femurs and pliability of the shinbones, he assures you the hut he builds will be nigh indestructible.
TEXT_BANVAN304_02188_SEQ_00:
Muna Vanu looks a little blue.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANVAN304_02188_SEQ_01:
Muna Vanu tells you that their stores of paint have run low, but Ginu Vanu has a plan to obtain the supplies he needs. Speak with him to learn what he has in mind.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANVAN304_02188_SEQ_02: Ginu Vanu is nearly finished with the construction of huts, but lacks the paint necessary to complete his work. The reason, he explains, is that he was only able to bring essential building tools when moving to Ok' Gundu Nakki. Unable to make paint with their limited resources, Ginu Vanu believes the only option is to steal paint from the Vundu tribe. He implores you to go swiftly and stealthily to procure three pots of dye from the Vundu.
TEXT_BANVAN304_02188_SEQ_03: Though you could not avoid all eyes of the Vundu, you manage to obtain three pots of dye without incident. Deliver them to Ginu Vanu that he may continue in his work.
TEXT_BANVAN304_02188_SEQ_04: Ginu Vanu is overjoyed to have dye with which to decorate the Gundu huts. As he tells it, every tribe has a distinct color used to represent themselves. And now the Gundu tribe will adorn its homes with a beautiful azure hue.
TEXT_BANVAN401_02189_SEQ_00:
Muna Vanu is scratching his head, puzzled.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANVAN401_02189_SEQ_01:
Muna Vanu tells you that a foreboding rumor has been floating on winds from Ok' Zundu in the east. Speak to Linu Vanu to hear more about the curious whisper. 

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANVAN401_02189_SEQ_02: Linu Vanu tells you the nestlings of Ok' Zundu are anxiously claiming the advent of an airborne beast of Zundu myth. Curious of the tribe's myth and its palpability, he asks that you seek out one of the Zundu nestlings and listen to what they have to say.
TEXT_BANVAN401_02189_SEQ_03: You speak with the unnerved Zundu nestling, who tells you he has spotted the legendary beast's feathers scattered northeast of Ok' Zundu, directly feeling the “bite” of impending darkness. He asks you to challenge the beast in a daring display of strength.
TEXT_BANVAN401_02189_SEQ_04: The fallen feathers that allegedly came from a mythical beast which attacked the nestlings of Ok' Zundu are not feathers at all, but metal claws from an encroaching Garlean legion. Mythical beast or not, the claws still pose a considerable danger. Speak with the cowering Zundu to find the location of the other “feathers.”
TEXT_BANVAN401_02189_SEQ_05: The Zundu nestling is impressed by your combat with the Garlean metal claws, and guides you to the other location the magitek was sighted. Wait at the designated spot until the enemy compels you to display another courageous performance.
TEXT_BANVAN401_02189_SEQ_06: You have defeated the Garlean metal claws with a daring display of fearlessness. Speak with the Zundu nestling nearby.
TEXT_BANVAN401_02189_SEQ_07: The Zundu nestling is confident that the legendary beast is satisfied with your bold movements, running home to tell the other nestlings about the birth of a new legend. Return to Ok' Gundu Nakki to relay the outcome to Linu Vanu.
TEXT_BANVAN401_02189_SEQ_08: Linu Vanu has already heard whispers on the wind about the outcome of the search for the legendary beast and how you narrowly avoided the end of the world. He expresses gratitude for listening to the nestling, and states that the Gundu tribe will also remain on the lookout for the claws.
TEXT_BANVAN402_02190_SEQ_00:
Muna Vanu is looking right through you with ruffled feathers. 
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANVAN402_02190_SEQ_01:
Muna Vanu seems distracted by news from his former home in Ok' Gundu. Inquire with Linu Vanu about the elderly Vanu Vanu's distress.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANVAN402_02190_SEQ_02: You speak with Linu Vanu, who tells you that after the group left their village in Ok' Gundu to pursue independence, Vundu shamans swept in and desecrated their ancestors' burial sites by bewitching their totems. With Muna Vanu and Linu Vanu's ancestors unable to rest in peace due to the incessant chanting, the Gundu chief bids you to travel to Ok' Gundu and expel the cursed totems.
TEXT_BANVAN402_02190_SEQ_03: You have destroyed the cursed totems plaguing the Gundu ancestral grounds. Report your success to Linu Vanu.
TEXT_BANVAN402_02190_SEQ_04: Linu Vanu is pleased with the news that the foul totems' chanting has been silenced. While it may be a long time before the tribe members can erect new ones to honor their forefathers, the burial sites will remain quiet and peaceful for their eternal rest.
TEXT_BANVAN403_02191_SEQ_00:
Muna Vanu is looking intently at his sash.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANVAN403_02191_SEQ_01:
