Muna Vanu points out a noticeable hole in his sash, but is too embarrassed to ask Linu Vanu to make a new one for him. Speak with Linu Vanu on his behalf.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANVAN403_02191_SEQ_02: Linu Vanu realizes that many of the Gundu's sashes are becoming tattered as they build their new home and decides to make fresh traditional garments for the entire tribe. To do so, he needs silk cocoons from the wamoura breeding ground south of Ok' Zundu. Harvest the cocoons and bring them back to Linu Vanu.
TEXT_BANVAN403_02191_SEQ_03: You have harvested the wamoura cocoons. Return to Ok' Gundu Nakki to deliver them to Linu Vanu.
TEXT_BANVAN403_02191_SEQ_04: Linu Vanu is impressed with the cocoons you have delivered to him, and remarks that the silk used for the sashes will undoubtedly make the Vundu envious of Ok' Gundu Nakki's prosperity. He anticipates with bated breath that the cocoons might hold juicy wamoura grubs as a surprise snack, and suggests you try one next time...if you are daring.
TEXT_BANVAN404_02192_SEQ_00:
Muna Vanu looks happy to see you.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANVAN404_02192_SEQ_01:
Muna Vanu says Ginu Vanu has been looking for you for a task that involves quick reflexes.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANVAN404_02192_SEQ_02: Ginu Vanu has requested that you bring him a clowder of gaelicats, hale and hearty. Handing over the Gundu tribe's “secret dried herb,” he asks you to search the areas around Camp Cloudtop for the flying felines and capture five.
TEXT_BANVAN404_02192_SEQ_03: You have successfully captured the gaelicats, which are now writhing and purring pleasantly in your sack. Return to Ok' Gundu Nakki and deliver the precious cargo to Ginu Vanu.
TEXT_BANVAN404_02192_SEQ_04: After traversing the large swaths of land around Camp Cloudtop to retrieve a sackful of euphoric gaelicats, you hand them over to a satisfied Ginu...who intends to release them back to the sky as per the Gundu nest-building custom.
TEXT_BANVAN501_02193_SEQ_00:
Muna Vanu of Ok' Gundu Nakki desires your assistance.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANVAN501_02193_SEQ_01:
Muna Vanu tells you that Ranu Vali is in need of your assistance. Speak with her to learn how best you might be of help.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANVAN501_02193_SEQ_02: Ranu Vali needs korrigans─fresh ones, plucked straight from the dirt. But the earsplitting screeches they emit when uprooted drive even the most stalwart Vanu to distraction. Travel to Last Step and retrieve four of these clamorous creatures for her.
TEXT_BANVAN501_02193_SEQ_03: The piercing cry of the mandragoras chills you to the bone─for a moment─before it echoes and fades. A race more sensitive to certain sounds might well find these screams unbearable. Return to Ok' Gundu Nakki and deliver the fruits of your harvest to Ranu Vali.
TEXT_BANVAN501_02193_SEQ_04: Ranu Vali thanks you profusely for your work. Sliced korrigans, marinated in honey, are a Gundu delicacy that will perfectly complement the banquet she is preparing for the Zundu.
TEXT_BANVAN502_02194_SEQ_00:
Muna Vanu is pulling at his feathers, fretting over something.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANVAN502_02194_SEQ_01:
Muna Vanu is working on a gift to present to the Zundu in recognition of their kindness in accepting the Gundu. However, what he currently has to show for his efforts is decidedly plain. He asks that you procure something bright and colorful with which to decorate it. Luna Vanu may be able to help in this regard.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANVAN502_02194_SEQ_02: Luna Vanu suggests gastornis feathers─lustrous and iridescent, they can even be gathered without engaging in the hazardous business of slaying the gastornis themselves. Search Cloudtop for the nests of these beasts and recover three of their feathers.
TEXT_BANVAN502_02194_SEQ_03: You gather three gastornis feathers as requested, their opalescent hue shimmering as they flutter in the breeze. Return these marvelous specimens to Luna Vanu.
TEXT_BANVAN502_02194_SEQ_04: The Gundu merchant opines on the beauty of the feathers when you deliver them to him. They will no doubt be a superb addition to the gift Muna Vanu plans to present to the Zundu.
TEXT_BANVAN503_02195_SEQ_00:
Muna Vanu has a request to make of you.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANVAN503_02195_SEQ_01:
Muna Vanu tells you that Linu Vanu has asked for your assistance. Speak with him to learn just what his request entails.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANVAN503_02195_SEQ_02: In a bid to foster a spirit of cooperation between the Gundu and the nearby detachment of Ishgardian forces, Linu Vanu has prepared a gift of traditional Vanu Vanu catsfoot chews to present to them as an offer of goodwill. Rather than putting the knights on alert by having a Vanu approach their camp with the gifts, he asks that you deliver these presents to Laniaitte at Camp Cloudtop on the tribe's behalf.
TEXT_BANVAN503_02195_SEQ_03: Laniaitte thanks you for your gift, but suggests that it might be more appreciated by the tired and hungry knights out on patrol right now. Find them and deliver the catsfoot chews to them.
TEXT_BANVAN503_02195_SEQ_04: The knights under Laniaitte's command are delighted to receive the gifts you deliver. Report back to Linu Vanu and let him know that his gesture was well received.
TEXT_BANVAN503_02195_SEQ_05: Linu Vanu thanks you for your help. He explains that catsfoot chew was made using an ancient recipe passed down by his ancestors. Hopefully these gifts can come to represent another formative step in the development of amiable relations between the Gundu and Camp Cloudtop.
TEXT_BANVAN504_02196_SEQ_00:
Muna Vanu needs a skilled hand to attend to a difficult task.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANVAN504_02196_SEQ_01:
Muna Vanu has need of a strong, energetic paissa, but due to his responsibilities to the tribe, he has not the time to undertake the drawn-out task of capturing such wily prey himself. Furnishing you with a large sack in which to hold the beast, he bids you travel westward to where these creatures are most plentiful. They can be caught by digging a hole, which the careless creatures will fall into, finding themselves stuck.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANVAN504_02196_SEQ_02: You dig a hole, deep and wide enough to trap the sturdiest of paissas. Now you must wait for just such a beast to fall for this obvious─but apparently effective─ploy.
TEXT_BANVAN504_02196_SEQ_03: It's not long before a spry but oblivious paissa falls straight into the hole you dug. Put the creature into the sack the Vanu gave you before it escapes.
TEXT_BANVAN504_02196_SEQ_04: The paissa puts up little resistance as you extricate it from the hole and place it in the sack. Return your prize to Muna Vanu.
TEXT_BANVAN504_02196_SEQ_05: Muna Vanu explains that he has been challenged by a friend from the Zundu tribe to a paissafight. Though his tribe owes theirs a great debt, the elderly Vanu cannot bring dishonor on his people by losing the fight. Once properly trained, the spry and stalwart creature you captured should help secure his victory in the upcoming challenge.
TEXT_BANVAN601_02197_SEQ_00:
Muna Vanu is practicing his moves.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANVAN601_02197_SEQ_01:
As his responsibilities to the tribe grow, the time Muna Vanu has to devote to practicing the sundrop dance dwindles. Linu Vanu seems insistent that all Gundu perfect this dance─a dance you yourself have mastered. Speak with him and see what you can do to help.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANVAN601_02197_SEQ_02: Linu Vanu explains that the sundrop dance acts as a show of force, through which the Gundu keep the Vundu intimidated, securing their independence. But the elders grow older, and the youths that stand up to take their place fail to carry out the dance with the same strength and energy. Your performance, however, is an exemplar of all that the sundrop dance represents. Linu Vanu asks that you find the Gundu youths that are practicing at Hengr's Crucible. Show them the marvel of a well-executed sundrop dance, and ignite the spark of passion in them.
TEXT_BANVAN601_02197_SEQ_03: Your dancing serves as a shining beacon of inspiration to all fortunate enough to witness it. The youths of Ok' Gundu Nakki are filled with a renewed passion to refine their performances and show the Vundu that they are not to be trifled with. Report back to Linu Vanu with this encouraging news.
TEXT_BANVAN601_02197_SEQ_04: Linu Vanu is relieved to hear that you were able to fire up his clansmen so well. He tells you that, since the Gundu have so few warriors compared to the Vundu, they cannot hope to win a direct confrontation. Their only hope is to avoid all-out war by intimidating the enemy with their fearsome sundrop dance. Thanks to you, it seems this strategy remains viable.
TEXT_BANVAN602_02198_SEQ_00:
Muna Vanu would have you assist his tribesmen.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANVAN602_02198_SEQ_01:
Muna Vanu tells you that Linu Vanu has been seeking you, with an aim to enlisting your assistance. Speak with him and find out what he needs help with.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANVAN602_02198_SEQ_02: You learn that the Vundu are training strong and skilled warriors whose prowess in the Vanu Vanu sundrop dance grows more daunting by the day. He bids you seek these threats out, and intimidate them with your own rendition of the dance, that they might lose faith and abandon their training.
TEXT_BANVAN602_02198_SEQ_03: You awe the young Vundu dancers with your impeccable dancing capabilities. Not one of the warriors holds his ground before your terrifying display. Report back to Linu Vanu and tell him that the Vundu whelps have been put in their place.
TEXT_BANVAN602_02198_SEQ_04: Linu Vanu is greatly relieved to hear that the Vundu dancers have been dealt with before they could pose a real and certain threat to the safety of his people. While thankful that his tribe has your strength to draw on, he resolves to also work on refining his own dancing abilities, to better serve in his tribe's protection.
TEXT_BANVAN603_02199_SEQ_00:
Muna Vanu has a message to pass on to you.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANVAN603_02199_SEQ_01:
Muna Vanu passes on a message that a concerned Linu Vanu wishes to speak with you. Details are lacking─you will need to speak with him yourself for further details.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANVAN603_02199_SEQ_02: Upon speaking with Linu Vanu, you learn that his recent attempts at soothsaying bear ill portent for the tribe. A gaelicat he released fell promptly from the sky, to be seen no more. Fearing that the Gundu's ancestors look down upon the tribe with disdain, he bids you travel to the Gundu totem at old Ok' Gundu, and place an offering of weeping wildwort. Present this offering along with the sundrop dance to quell their fury. Weeping wildwort can be found growing wild in patches at the Cromlech.
TEXT_BANVAN603_02199_SEQ_03: You have obtained the weeping wildwort. Take these flowers to Ok' Gundu and place them before the Gundu totem.
TEXT_BANVAN603_02199_SEQ_04: The weeping wildwort flowers lie at the foot of the Gundu totem. Dedicate this offering to the ancestors by performing the sundrop dance.
TEXT_BANVAN603_02199_SEQ_05: The flowers have been accepted. The contract is sealed. Return to Linu Vanu.
TEXT_BANVAN603_02199_SEQ_06: Linu Vanu thanks you for your assistance in calming the rage of his ancestors. However, he does now recall that the gaelicat he released to obtain this omen smelled strongly of intoxicating cloudcrawler...
TEXT_BANVAN604_02200_SEQ_00:
Muna Vanu is lost in a sea of troubles.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANVAN604_02200_SEQ_01:
Despite the Gundu's best efforts, they are still subject to intermittent Vundu harassment. At a loss as to how to deal with this himself, Muna Vanu asks that you speak with Linu Vanu, and find out how you can assist in the defense of his tribe and village.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANVAN604_02200_SEQ_02: After speaking with Linu Vanu, you learn that a rough and violent Vundu has been driving Gundu hunters from Gundu land. He asks you to help in letting this Vundu brute know firsthand the shame of being driven from his own land─by chasing him from his home with violent blasts of wind from a trained sanuwa. Speak with Luna Vanu. He will gladly supply you with a sanuwa to do just that.
TEXT_BANVAN604_02200_SEQ_03:
Eager to help give the Vundu a taste of their own medicine, Luna Vanu provides you with what he claims is the strongest sanuwa in the village. Now find the Vundu brute and use the sanuwa to buffet him with wind.

※Speak with Luna Vanu in Ok' Gundu Nakki to mount a sanuwa.
TEXT_BANVAN604_02200_SEQ_04: You blast the Vundu brute with the full force of the sanuwa's attack, but he merely relocates, continuing his activities elsewhere. Seek him out again and buffet him once again with another flurry from the sanuwa.
TEXT_BANVAN604_02200_SEQ_05: The Vundu brute stands strong in the face of yet another onslaught from your sanuwa. After speaking a few words of defiance, he relocates yet again. Track him down once more and show him that you will not give up so easily.
TEXT_BANVAN604_02200_SEQ_06: You buffet the Vundu brute one last time. With no end in sight to these attacks, the bully loses heart and flees. Report back to Linu Vanu that this thug has now been put in his place.
TEXT_BANVAN604_02200_SEQ_07: Linu Vanu is pleased with your work and grateful that his tribe's hunters need no longer fear assault by this violent Vundu warrior. He does note, however, that these hunters would do well to train ever harder to master the sundrop dance, such that they may defend themselves when you are not around to do so for them.
TEXT_BANVAN008_02225_SEQ_00: Linu Vali smiles at you warmly, and it looks like she has something to say.
TEXT_BANVAN008_02225_SEQ_01: Linu Vali once again expresses her gratitude for everything you have done for her tribe. Her brother also wishes to express his thanks, and looks deep in thought. Speak with him to hear what words his meditative mood has brought to him.
TEXT_BANVAN008_02225_SEQ_02: You speak with Linu Vanu, and despite his initial difficulties in figuring out what to say, he finally finds words that adequately express his gratitude. He names you an honored guest of the Gundu, and says you will be welcome with open arms whenever you wish to visit Ok' Gundu Nakki.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_SEQ_00:
The Vath storyteller looks at you, clicking his mandibles nervously.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_SEQ_01:
The storyteller explains that Loth ast Vath has a newcomer, who has yet to find his purpose and thus remains nameless. Determined to make himself useful, the new Vath set out towards the Chocobo Forest in search of food to bring back to his brothers and sisters; alas, he has not yet returned. Worrying that the hunters may have mistaken him for a Gnath, the storyteller urges you to venture out to Tailfeather and inquire as to his whereabouts.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_SEQ_02: You find the nameless Vath at Tailfeather, where he has been detained by the hunters for devouring a great amount of gysahl greens set in chocobo traps. Marcechamp offers to release the beastman on the condition that he repays the hunters for the greens by harvesting branches from young meliae, with which to make arrow shafts. The nameless one agrees, and Marcechamp asks you to accompany him so that he does not flee from his task.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_SEQ_03: You follow the nameless one into the Smoldering Wastes, where he tells you he intends to return to Loth ast Vath instead, without repaying his debt. But with a little persuasion on your part, he soon acquiesces to the hunters' task, asking you to help him gather the branches.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_SEQ_04: You harvest the melia branch with little effort. Return to the nameless one with the branch so he may pay his debt to the hunters.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_SEQ_05: You hand the sapling branch to the nameless one. Upon doing so, you notice the little Vath has also gathered a prodigious quantity of his own. Make for Tailfeather to deliver them to Marcechamp.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_SEQ_06: Marcechamp is visibly surprised that the Vath returned to Tailfeather, with a large quantity of branches besides. Satisfied with the Vath's hard work and amused by his honesty, he also offers a reward: a sack of gysahl greens for the nameless one to take home to Loth ast Vath. The nameless one grows excited at the prospect of retrieving items for rewards to share among the colony and declares his resolve to become an adventurer. Report the good news to the Vath storyteller in Loth ast Vath.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_SEQ_07: At Loth ast Vath, the nameless one offers his rewards to the Vath storyteller. While pleased with the gysahl greens he has brought, the storyteller and the fleetfoot are troubled by their colony's sustainability. Though their link with the Overmind has been severed, they continue to depend on the Onemind by stealing what little resources they can from Loth ast Gnath. The nameless Vath, steadfast in his resolve to become an adventurer, offers to travel to faraway lands and obtain rewards for his services to lessen the Vath's reliance on the Onemind. The storyteller accepts this as the nameless one's purpose, and allows him to set up an Adventurers' Guild in Loth ast Vath.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_SEQ_08: The nameless one intends to introduce you to his closest brothers, the stickpeddler, and the keeneye. But the stickpeddler mentions that the keeneye left the colony in search of food. When he notes that he may be surveying the river near the bridge, the nameless one recalls that ferocious dragons are often seen in the area. Fearing for the keeneye's safety, he asks you to check the bridge for dragons, but not to slay them for fear of reprisal. Instead, he bids you ride a kongamato to the bridge and use the smoke-spewing contraption strapped to its belly to drive away any dragons you discover.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_SEQ_09: You seek out the “ferocious” dragons the nameless one mentioned, only to find younglings guarding the bridge playfully. Using the putrid incense strapped to the kongamato's stomach, you spray the younglings, who irritatedly fly away. As the keeneye is nowhere to be seen, return to Loth ast Vath to see if the nameless one has had any luck with finding the keeneye.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_SEQ_10: You arrive at Loth ast Vath to find the keeneye has returned safe and sound. He expresses gratitude and willingness to help the nameless one with finding quests for the Adventurers' Guild to undertake. All that remains is to find a seasoned adventurer to teach the others the tricks of the trade─and that adventurer happens to be you. Overjoyed with the help of his brothers and his established role, the nameless Vath declares a new name for himself: the deftarm.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_SEQ_00:
The Vath deftarm looks to be in high spirits.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_SEQ_01:
The colony has used some of its newfound wealth to procure second-hand cannons for their defense. However, the cannons did not come with the stock of firesand required to operate them. Not to be discouraged by the Gnath's fierce guard of the sulphur needed to make the powder, the deftarm sought advice from Marcechamp. The hunter made mention of the Convictors of Coerthas, who own cannons similar to the deftarm's second-hand ones. The Vath adventurer concludes that the dragonslayers must have a large supply of firesand on hand, and is eager to make their acquaintance. Before making your way to Coerthas, rendezvous with the deftarm on the edge of the Chocobo Forest. 

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_SEQ_02: You meet with an anxious Vath deftarm near the edge of the forelands, who remarks that this would be the furthest he has been from his home. But your journey is soon interrupted by a familiar foe.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_SEQ_03: You find yourself face-to-face with a Gnath brandishing a musket, whom you quickly dispatch. Afterwards, an ashamed deftarm explains that he was unable to join the fray because the voices of the Gnath struck fear in him. Turning his thoughts to the task at hand, he bids you continue onward to Coerthas.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_SEQ_04: The deftarm is overwhelmed by his first sight of snow. Unfortunately, he appears rather less comfortable in the cold. Shivering, he slowly makes his way towards the Convictory.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_SEQ_05: Jantellot quickly overcomes his astonishment at being addressed by a giant talking crab once the deftarm expresses his desire for firesand. The fledgling adventurer makes the mistake of declaring he will perform “any task” in exchange, prompting Jantellot to bid the Vath rid the camp of lesser dragons entirely. After failing to convince Jantellot to change his request, the deftarm is at a loss as to how to slay a horde of dragons on his own. However, recalling the Vathic methods of driving dragons away, he quickly departs the camp to search for herbs to make incense, but not before asking that you prepare a fire outside the camp.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_SEQ_06: You build a fire with the bundle of wood that Jantellot provided, and wait for the Vath's return. Just as the scouts have spotted lesser dragons flying over the ridge towards the camp, the deftarm appears with the dried herbs. He tells Jantellot if he lights them aflame, it will produce a smoke so potent that it forces dragons to retreat. The Convictor seems doubtful of its effectiveness at first, but is pleasantly surprised when he sees the results for himself. He offers firesand to the deftarm in exchange for more of the herbs to which the deftarm gleefully accepts. With mention of the guild and its services, a deal is struck between the Vath and the Convictor leader. Speak with the deftarm before you set off for Loth ast Vath.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_SEQ_07: The deftarm is satisfied that he was able to fulfill his quest, but expresses relief that he can now leave the freezing climate of Coerthas. Return to Loth ast Vath to apprise the storyteller of the developments.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_SEQ_08: You arrive at Loth ast Vath, but the storyteller informs you that the deftarm has not returned yet. Sensing something amiss, he asks you to search for him.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_SEQ_09: You find the deftarm in front of the colony. Strangely enough, it appears he lost his way on the path home. Speak to him once more at the Adventurers' Guild.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_SEQ_10: The deftarm deems the trip to Coerthas a success, as he has been able to secure a supply of firesand for Loth ast Vath's cannons. Although the colder clime was not to his liking, he is pleased with his first journey outside of the Dravanian forelands. The deftarm dreams of seeing more of the realm, but his next foray will have to wait as his responsibilities as head of the guild will keep him busy for a while.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_SEQ_00:
The Vath deftarm is looking at the colony's store of muskets, shaking his head.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_SEQ_01:
The Vath deftarm is pleased with the progress his guild is making, but with progress comes the need for more tools and weapons. He notes that the muskets that the Nonmind have stolen from the Gnath are falling into disrepair, and he seeks a way to procure more without relying on their enemy. The Vath inquires to you about the goblins, who he heard were quite adept at metalworking. Seeking your help for an introduction to the goblins of Idyllshire, he excitedly sets off to prepare for his new journey. You agree to rendezvous at the border, in the west of Avalonia Fallen. 

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_SEQ_02: Just as you and the deftarm are about to depart for the hinterlands, it soon becomes evident that the Gnath have been following you. With the deftarm rendered immobile by their whispers, the task is left to you to silence them.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_SEQ_03: When the deftarm comes to his senses, he relays to you that the Gnath had been ordered to obstruct him from leaving the forelands. But he is confused as to why the Overmind gave such a command, given his trivial position among the Vath. Nevertheless, he shakes off his confusion and bids you both continue onward to the hinterlands.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_SEQ_04: You find an alarmed deftarm standing next to a deceased Illuminati goblin, and the Vath quickly explains he fired out of self-defense. Upon your explanation of how the Illuminati work in contrast to the Idyllshire goblins, he breathes a sigh of relief that he did not murder one of his possible clients. Your journey continues onwards towards Idyllshire.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_SEQ_05: Slowfix is surprised by the presence of the Vath deftarm in Idyllshire, but seems willing to oblige the request for metalwork. He points you both in the direction of Drydox, who appears to know something of Gnath weaponsmithing.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_SEQ_06: The deftarm is confused by her request for “jinglyshine,” and admits that he has none. An unimpressed Drydox agrees to create better muskets for the deftarm, but not before he toils to clear the stone rubble scattered throughout the Collectors' Quarter. The deftarm initially declines her request, remarking that such a simple labor is beneath him. But after your stern guidance, he reluctantly accepts and heads off to complete his task.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_SEQ_07: The request proves no simple task, as the deftarm struggles to clear the immense rubble. Discouraged after his fruitless attempts, he takes a break to enjoy a favorite snack: nanka eggs. Drydox, who came to check on the Vath's progress, immediately notes the eggs' foul stench and grows curious. After a single taste, the goblin takes an immediate liking to the Vathic delicacy. Seeing an opportunity, the deftarm asks Drydox to change the conditions of their arrangement, offering nanka eggs in exchange for metalwork. Drydox excitedly agrees, and a new deal is struck.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_SEQ_08: The storyteller suspects that something is indeed wrong when, once more, the deftarm fails to return promptly. He reveals to you that all Vath have a lingering connection to the Onemind, and that some retain a stronger connection than others. These Vath must fight harder to reinforce their sense of self against the whispers of the Onemind, for should they forget their purpose, they will lose their individuality and rejoin the colony of Loth ast Gnath. Fearing that the deftarm has fallen victim to their whispers, he asks you to find him and bring him back to his senses before it is too late.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_SEQ_09: You find a silent deftarm slowly shuffling towards the main colony. With the chat mode in Say, attempt to break his entranced state by calling his name, “Deftarm!” aloud.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_SEQ_10: The Vath adventurer hears your voice and reaffirms his own identity. While now in control of his mind, it seems he lost his memory after departing from Idyllshire. Confused, he returns towards Loth ast Vath. Speak to him in front of the Adventurers' Guild.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_SEQ_11: The deftarm tells you he spoke with the storyteller about his strange experience when he gave his report, and the storyteller explained his remaining potent connection to Loth ast Gnath. While the deftarm expresses fear over the thought of losing himself once more, he surmises that his individuality may be preserved should his purpose outweigh the whispers of the Onemind. He vows to do whatever it takes to strengthen his identity as an adventurer.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_SEQ_00:
The Vath deftarm is trying very hard to stand still.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_SEQ_01:
After an awkward attempt at a prank, the deftarm is eager to tell you about a daring idea he has. In a bid to put an end to the colony's thieving of clay, he wishes to venture to Anyx Trine, another area rich with the deposits, albeit a lair of the Gnath's hated enemy, the Dravanians. Knowing well he would face certain death were he to travel alone, he recalls you have met with the dragons before, and requests you to accompany him to formally ask the dragons for permission to harvest the clay─an idea the Onemind would not dare to consider. 

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_SEQ_02: At Anyx Trine, the deftarm trembles before the looming tower. Remarking to you that he may be the closest the Vath have come to the dragon's lair, he takes a deep breath and enters. Follow him inside, and proceed to Vidofnir's chamber.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_SEQ_03: Vidofnir grants you an audience, but is soon perplexed as to why you brought a Gnath into her presence. The deftarm quickly explains that he is Vath, not Gnath, and that they have a need to strengthen their settlement's walls. He further stresses that by aiding their cause, the Dravanians would benefit from their presence as a buffer between Anyx Trine and Loth ast Gnath. Still suspicious of his loyalties, however, Vidofnir declares that the deftarm must first prove he is not in league with the Gnath by slaying one. Despite his reservations, the deftarm has no choice but to agree.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_SEQ_04: You find a distressed deftarm outside Anyx Trine, at a loss how to proceed. You attempt to encourage your pupil, however his emotions get the better of him, and he asks to be left alone. Leaving him to wallow in pity, you set out to search for Gnath who may be lurking nearby, in the hopes he will join you.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_SEQ_05: Regrettably, the deftarm never appears to join you as you perform your fair share of Gnath-slaying. Return to Anyx Trine to see how he is faring.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_SEQ_06: The deftarm attempts to apologize to you, but he is soon interrupted by a remaining Gnath scout who escaped your view. The deftarm struggles with the Onemind's voices, but soon steels himself, affirming his identity and striking the Gnath down with his musket. He declares that he can no longer hear their thoughts, overcoming his biggest obstacle.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_SEQ_07: While the deftarm's slaying of a Gnath is a small victory, his duty remains incomplete. Return to Vidofnir and corroborate his success.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_SEQ_08: The deftarm declares himself triumphant in slaying a Gnath, and Vidofnir concurs, having seen it herself from the tower. As he has proved himself, she allows the Vath to partake of the clay deposits from within their domain. After both agree to work towards peaceful coexistence, the deftarm sets out for the colony to relay the news to the storyteller.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_SEQ_09: The storyteller and the fleetfoot can scarcely believe their ears when they hear that the deftarm was not only able to meet with Vidofnir and live to tell the tale, but was granted her permission to reap a precious resource. The storyteller is delighted to hear that the hive has finally weaned themselves from the Gnath's resources, and of the deftarm's personal victory of resisting the link to the Onemind. For the moment, Loth ast Vath seems to be turning out for the better...that is, until the deftarm falls deep into a trance, speaking in a different tone. The speaker soon reveals himself as the Overmind of Loth ast Gnath, using the deftarm as a mouthpiece with which to deliver a message: rejoin the main colony, or perish. When the deftarm regains himself, he is dismayed by the colony's crisis, and commits himself to finding a way to avoid war.
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_SEQ_00:
The Vath deftarm sighs soberly.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_SEQ_01:
The deftarm, feeling responsible for the misfortune that has befallen the hive, reveals to you his idea to avoid war. Having faith in the strength of his individuality, the Vath adventurer intends to willingly submit himself to the Gnath to enter their colony. Once the Overmind is lured out to claim him, he would fell the king-like Gnath, ending his threat to the Vath. The deftarm tries to reassure himself of his cause before saying farewell to you and setting off for Loth ast Gnath.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_SEQ_02: You divulge the deftarm's plan to the storyteller and fleetfoot, who quickly deny its feasibility, explaining that the Overmind would be all too willing to use the deftarm. The fleetfoot also reveals that the Overmind cannot truly be killed, for where one dies, another soon appears. As time grows short to save the deftarm from completely losing himself, the storyteller bids you pursue him while he sends out the call for help.
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_SEQ_03: You discover the deftarm, but he has already submitted himself to the thoughts of the Onemind who surround him. You dispatch them in an attempt to quell their whispers. Speak to your pupil to see if he is yet himself.
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_SEQ_04: Your efforts to reach the deftarm prove fruitless, as he silently proceeds towards the Gnath colony. Continue to pursue him into the heart of the hive.
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_SEQ_05: You follow the entranced deftarm deep into Loth ast Gnath, where he is welcomed by the Overmind himself. The Overmind claims triumphantly that the Vath adventurer's individuality has been removed and he has taken his place among the Onemind once more. After berating mankind for their thirst of war and discord, the Overmind hisses at you to leave his domain. He uses his power over the deftarm to raise his musket toward you, but you stand firm, trusting in your pupil's power. The storyteller soon arrives with the allies the deftarm has gathered over the course of his travels, and they attempt to call out to him. Their voices soon reach him, and the Overmind senses the imminent threat posed by the deftarm's overwhelming sense of self. Shocked beyond comprehension upon losing power over his thralls and the deftarm's assault, the Overmind soon retreats to the recesses of its lair. As impending war becomes less of a possibility, the deftarm appears to be exhausted, and suggests everyone return to the hive.
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_SEQ_06: At Loth ast Vath, the deftarm attempts to thank his friends for coming to his rescue, but they brush aside his sentimentality, humor lost on the Vath. The storyteller explains how the colony has become an important part of others' lives, and their security will be guaranteed so long as the Adventurers' Guild continues to reciprocate the assistance they receive from others. The deftarm is grateful to you for taking him under your wing to guide him in the ways of adventuring, but assures you he is ready to stand on his own. In addition to his duties to the guild, he declares his resolve to continue training his skills so that he may one day embark on an adventure with you.
TEXT_BANGNA006_02260_SEQ_00: The Vath deftarm overlooks the guild with satisfaction.
TEXT_BANGNA006_02260_SEQ_01: The Vath deftarm greets you warmly and tells you that the colony is thriving. Many new Vath are inspired by the guild's humble beginnings, choosing their purpose as adventurers under the deftarm's tutelage. Admitting that he is no good with sentimentality, he asks you to visit the storyteller, who also wanted to speak with you.
TEXT_BANGNA006_02260_SEQ_02: The storyteller expresses gratitude on behalf of Loth ast Vath for your efforts to help the hive. He observes that while the Overmind is well aware of the Vath's strength in allies and has been keeping tight guard over his subjects, there are always those who escape to the sanctuary, and he is eager to tell their story. The storyteller imparts upon you the Vath will not forget what you have done for them, and to ever consider yourself a part of the hive.
TEXT_BANGNA301_02261_SEQ_00:
By the clacker of his mandibles, the Vath keeneye seems happy to see you.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANGNA301_02261_SEQ_01:
Not long ago, hunters from Tailfeather put in a request for melia branches, a pliable wood perfect for making arrows. The Vath keeneye asks that you venture out into the Smoldering Wastes in his stead. Marking your map with three locations known to be melia budding grounds, he asks that you slay any meliae you find and collect their branches.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANGNA301_02261_SEQ_02: You visit the three budding grounds, but only obtain branches from two of the meliae that appeared. Nevertheless, you can do no more than what was asked of you. Return to Loth ast Vath and deliver what melia branches you found.
TEXT_BANGNA301_02261_SEQ_03: The Vath keeneye is more than happy with the branches you provide him. As an aside, he tells you of his offer of nanka eggs to the hunters of Tailfeather, in addition to the branches they requested. Though his intentions were pure, he was surprised at the hunters' reaction. It would seem the Vath keeneye has much to learn of the likes and dislikes of other races.
TEXT_BANGNA302_02262_SEQ_00:
The Vath keeneye is tilting his head, lost in thought.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANGNA302_02262_SEQ_01:
The Vath keeneye is perplexed by a recent request from Tailfeather: herbs to be smoked for recreational purposes. Hoping you might have a better appreciation for this unusual custom, he asks that you travel to the Smoldering Wastes to gather three herb sprouts for the hunters.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANGNA302_02262_SEQ_02: You find three herb sprouts growing along the Whilom River. Hurry back to Loth ast Vath and deliver them to the Vath keeneye.
TEXT_BANGNA302_02262_SEQ_03: You hand over the herb sprouts to the Vath keeneye, who speedily prepares them for delivery. Unfamiliar with this use of herbs, he insists you deliver them, lest he embarrass himself. The two hunters who requested these herbs, Loupard and Grimold, can be found at Tailfeather.
TEXT_BANGNA302_02262_SEQ_04: The hunters are surprised and delighted to receive their packages. Return to Loth ast Vath and inform the Vath keeneye of your successful delivery.
TEXT_BANGNA302_02262_SEQ_05: You return to find the Vath keeneye suffering from an unseemly fit of coughing. Ever curious of foreign customs, he confesses to trying the smoking herbs. He fails to understand why hunters would use them, describing the herbs as foul smelling. Should anyone request these herbs again, he intends to warn them of their potential hazards.
TEXT_BANGNA303_02263_SEQ_00:
The Vath keeneye is clacking his mandibles nervously.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANGNA303_02263_SEQ_01:
A crop of gysahl greens at Tailfeather has been besieged by insects, and the Vath keeneye is beside himself with worry. Luckily, the Vath have a potent insect repellent for just such an occasion. He asks that you make for Tailfeather with great haste to dispel these horrid pests. First, you must speak with the Vath kintamer to mount a kongamato equipped with vilekin repellent.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANGNA303_02263_SEQ_02: You speak with the Vath kintamer who helps you mount a kongamato. Fly to Tailfeather and do away with the insect menace.
TEXT_BANGNA303_02263_SEQ_03: You spray the gysahl greens with a powerful blast of the repellent. Unfortunately, a hunter─Louisonet─happened to be standing in the patch of greens when you did so. After regaining composure, he informs you that you have not sprayed the greens in their entirety. He asks that you aim more carefully when you tend to the remaining portion of the plot.
TEXT_BANGNA303_02263_SEQ_04: You successfully do away with the remaining insects, inadvertently dousing Louisonet a second time in the process. He thanks you all the same, and asks that you make one more stop before returning to Loth ast Vath. These insects are quite persistent in their search for gysahl greens, and have gone so far as eating them from traps in the Chocobo Forest. He asks that you fumigate those greens as well before there is nothing left of their traps.
TEXT_BANGNA303_02263_SEQ_05: With no other potential targets in sight, you spray the remaining gysahl greens with abandon, driving off the remaining insects. Return to Loth ast Vath, and let the Vath keeneye know the greens are safe.
TEXT_BANGNA303_02263_SEQ_06: The Vath keeneye is overjoyed to hear the gysahl greens are safe. He recalls the first time they used this repellent and the praise showered upon him by Louisonet. However, it would seem the Vath still have much to learn of their new friends and their turns of phrase.
TEXT_BANGNA304_02264_SEQ_00:
The Vath keeneye seems relieved to see you.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANGNA304_02264_SEQ_01:
Relations between the Vath and hunters of Tailfeather are improving by the day. However, a recent rash of animal attacks have hindered travel and trade between their two settlements. The Vath keeneye, eager to preserve their burgeoning friendship, asks you to survey the area and slay the beasts that plague travelers in the forest.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANGNA304_02264_SEQ_02: While following the path between Loth ast Vath and Tailfeather, you are attacked by brown bears. Thankfully, the bears are no match for you. Return to the Vath keeneye, and assure him that the road to Tailfeather is safe once more.
TEXT_BANGNA304_02264_SEQ_03: You return to Loth ast Vath to find the Vath keeneye with a look of relief about him. He confesses they received this request some time ago. Upon hearing there were bears, however, they decided it best to wait for a hunter─one such as yourself─to handle the job. He hopes someday the Vath will muster the courage to undertake these more daunting requests.
TEXT_BANGNA305_02265_SEQ_00:
The Vath keeneye's beady eyes look at you expectantly.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANGNA305_02265_SEQ_01:
The hunters of Tailfeather have requested a particular set of goods found only within Loth ast Gnath. Unable to sneak past their heightened security, the Vath keeneye asks you to raid the enemy settlement in his stead. Your goal is to procure three jars of a special paste and three bags of blackloam.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANGNA305_02265_SEQ_02: You have obtained the jars of paste and bags of blackloam. Return quickly to Loth ast Vath and deliver them to the Vath keeneye.
TEXT_BANGNA305_02265_SEQ_03: The Vath keeneye is pleased to see you return safely. As you hand over the spoils taken from the Gnath stronghold, you cannot help but notice his quizzical expression. He tells you these items are a special food reserved for soldiers of the Onemind, which is why he is so puzzled by the hunters' plans. The paste, he says, will be used for rearing chocobos. Though admittedly strange by his standards, this is a reasonable use for such nutritious food. However, he seems more perplexed by their intended use of the blackloam, which the hunters refer to as manure...
TEXT_BANGNA401_02266_SEQ_00:
The Vath keeneye seems very pleased with himself.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANGNA401_02266_SEQ_01:
The Convictors have been searching for a more potent firesand to power their newest cannons, and the Vath keeneye has taken it upon himself to solve their problem. After many tireless hours of trial and error, he has finally found the answer to their quandary; however, all these experiments have left him with no components to make more of his new blend. He asks that you go and gather some of these items and bring them back to him. Travel to Avalonia Fallen and the Smoldering Wastes to collect three branches of deadwood and three sacks of redsand.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANGNA401_02266_SEQ_02: You obtain three branches of deadwood and three sacks of redsand. Return to Loth ast Vath and deliver them to the Vath keeneye.
TEXT_BANGNA401_02266_SEQ_03: The Vath keeneye is elated to see you return with the items he has requested. In his excitement, he launches into an explanation on how his firesand is created, but stops himself when he realizes divulging the secrets of this process to you could jeopardize future sales.
TEXT_BANGNA402_02267_SEQ_00:
The Vath keeneye stares dejectedly at a single sprig of wilted silver dew.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANGNA402_02267_SEQ_01:
The Vath keeneye requires four sprigs of silver dew to complete his order to the Convictory and asks that you go and gather them from Avalonia Fallen for him. Before you leave, he urges you to remain vigilant, stating that many of the Gnath have been spotted frantically collecting this very same dew.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANGNA402_02267_SEQ_02: You have found and gathered the sprigs of silver dew. Return to Loth ast Vath and deliver them to the Vath keeneye.
TEXT_BANGNA402_02267_SEQ_03: The Gnath's actions suggest they are planning a preemptive strike against the dragons. The Vath keeneye fears that this could lead to a silver dew scarcity and that his people would be left with no means of sustaining themselves. To avert a potential disaster on the horizon, he deems it time they begin planting their own silver dew.
TEXT_BANGNA403_02268_SEQ_00:
The Vath keeneye looks at you, a puzzled glimmer in his hard beady eyes.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANGNA403_02268_SEQ_01:
Despite finding the concept of drinking alcohol to be extremely unappealing, the Vath keeneye turns out to be a dab hand at making wines, and his home-brew causes quite a stir over at the Convictory. Overwhelmed by the amount he has been asked to produce, he turns to you for assistance. Make your way to the Chocobo Forest and gather three ripe caelumtree fruits.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANGNA403_02268_SEQ_02: You have found three ripe caelumtree fruits. Return to Loth ast Vath and deliver them to the Vath keeneye.
TEXT_BANGNA403_02268_SEQ_03: You deliver the ripe caelumtree fruits to the Vath keeneye who sets to work, just as a knight from the Convictory appears at the Vath sanctuary. The Convictor is in a desperate hurry to get his wine, but unfortunately for him, it is far from ready. The clever Vath somehow foresaw this would happen, and produces a bottle from his reserve. He asks that you hand it to the restless knight, in hopes that it will tide him over until the new batch of wine is ready.
TEXT_BANGNA403_02268_SEQ_04: You hand the bottle of caelumtree wine to the impatient Convictor knight, and his anxious twitching seems to subside. He is eager to know what gives the wine its full flavor, but before you can disclose any details, he comes to the conclusion that only the best of ingredients could make such a fine drink. He leaves the Vath sanctuary with a spring in his step and blissfully unaware of the rather dubious additives which have been sprinkled into his wine.
TEXT_BANGNA404_02269_SEQ_00:
The Vath keeneye is sniffing at a plant with silver leaves.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANGNA404_02269_SEQ_01:
Silver dew, known to ward off dragons with its distinctive scent, has become one of the guild's most popular commodities. Sales have continued to soar and to prevent exhausting their limited supply, the Vath have begun cultivating their own. While their fields have grown thick with these herbs, most of their plants do not have as potent a smell as those found in the wild. Sending an inferior product to their customers would tarnish the guild's good name, so it is decided each bundle must pass a test. The Vath keeneye hands you a bunch of these herbs and asks that you help them evaluate the quality of their plants. Take the silver dew and speak with the Vath kintamer.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANGNA404_02269_SEQ_02:
The Vath kintamer mumbles and grumbles about the current state of their crops as he helps you climb onto a kongamato and load it with your silver dew. While he is clearly distraught, he seems hopeful that you will bring back good news. Now that you are securely mounted, fly to the Smoldering Wastes and find a dragon to test your dew on.

※Simply by speaking with the Vath kintamer you will be able to mount the kongamato.
TEXT_BANGNA404_02269_SEQ_03: The wyvern is disgusted by the silver dew and hurries to escape, but your job is still far from over. Follow him.
TEXT_BANGNA404_02269_SEQ_04: You once again shower the defenseless dragon in silver dew spray. Upset that you have not only attacked him for a second time, but that the putrid stench has also invaded his mouth and eyes, he takes flight and disappears from sight. Pursue him to test your dew for the last time.
TEXT_BANGNA404_02269_SEQ_05: As you douse him with the silver dew spray for a final time, the wyvern gasps for breath. In between fits of coughing he makes it very clear that should you follow him again, he will not hesitate to dismember you. Return to Loth ast Vath and report your success to the Vath keeneye.
TEXT_BANGNA404_02269_SEQ_06: The Vath keeneye is very pleased to add another batch of silver dew to the crates being delivered to the Convictory. He tells you that he has high hopes for the future, believing that with time and effort they should one day be able to fill a majority of their orders with silver dew from their own fields.
TEXT_BANGNA405_02270_SEQ_00:
The Vath keeneye has a rather hairy task for you to tackle.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANGNA405_02270_SEQ_01:
The Adventurers' Guild must send pelts to the Convictory, but the Vath are not familiar enough with Coerthan climates to accurately judge which furs are best suited to such extreme temperatures. To prevent any mistakes, the Vath keeneye asks Grimold to take charge of this venture and requests that you go and provide assistance. Make your way to Tailfeather and speak with Grimold.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANGNA405_02270_SEQ_02: Grimold informs you that the warmest furs can be obtained from bandersnatches. He tells you he would like to divide the work and asks that you go and hunt down the beasts, while he remains behind to finish preparations for curing the hides you bring back.
TEXT_BANGNA405_02270_SEQ_03: You slay two bandersnatches and a Gnath. Find Grimold and deliver the bandersnatch pelts to him.
TEXT_BANGNA405_02270_SEQ_04: Grimold is not only pleased with the number of bandersnatch pelts you deliver to him, but he is also impressed by their quality. Upon learning of your encounter with the starved Gnath, he is very glad to have sent you. Make your way back to the Vath keeneye and give him his share of the payment.
TEXT_BANGNA405_02270_SEQ_05: As you recount your adventure in the woods, the Vath keeneye is shocked to hear one of his Onemind brothers was lured out of hiding by the scent of meat. Knowing you would have had little trouble dispatching a lone drone, he is more relieved that he did not make the mistake of sending his brethren to assist Grimold. He is convinced they would have found the succulent meat far too difficult to resist.
TEXT_BANGNA501_02271_SEQ_00:
The Vath keeneye seems anxious about something.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANGNA501_02271_SEQ_01:
The Vath keeneye sent one of his brethren, the Vath farwalker, to Idyllshire with a cartload of goods. His delayed return, however, has left the Vath keeneye fearing the worst. He asks that you travel south toward the Dravanian hinterlands in search of the wayward Vath.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANGNA501_02271_SEQ_02: You find the Vath farwalker, but the reason for his delay is not what you feared. In truth, he was startled by the nearby wyverns and stumbled, knocking over his cart. Still fearful of wyverns nearby, he asks you to search the area for any unbroken cargo that he may complete his delivery.
TEXT_BANGNA501_02271_SEQ_03: You find an unbroken jar amidst the fallen cargo. Carry it back to the Vath farwalker, that he may load it back into his cart.
TEXT_BANGNA501_02271_SEQ_04: The Vath farwalker is overjoyed to see not all of his cargo was destroyed. However, he cannot shake the feeling the Vath keeneye will be displeased to hear he delivered only one jug. Hoping to appease his overseer, he asks you to search for more unbroken jugs.
TEXT_BANGNA501_02271_SEQ_05: You search what remains of his fallen cargo and find one last jug is still intact. Take it back to the Vath farwalker.
TEXT_BANGNA501_02271_SEQ_06: The Vath farwalker thanks you for finding a second jug. Though he can now finish his delivery, he still fears the scolding he is sure to receive upon returning. He recalls the reason you were sent, however, and devises a surprisingly deceptive plan to abate the Vath keeneye's anger. He asks you to tell the Vath keeneye that he was, in fact, assaulted by the Onemind, and that you saved him. He then sets off for Idyllshire, and suggests you think carefully about the story you will tell.
TEXT_BANGNA501_02271_SEQ_07: You relay a fabricated story of the farwalker's rescue, and the Vath keeneye is glad to hear he is safe and sound. As he tells it, there are Vath with links to the Onemind still strong enough to turn them back to the side of the Gnath. Though he worries his brothers may give in to the pull of their still-unbroken bonds, he believes that, with effort, they will one day be truly free.
TEXT_BANGNA502_02272_SEQ_00:
The Vath keeneye sighs dejectedly.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANGNA502_02272_SEQ_01:
The goblins of Idyllshire have an insatiable appetite for nanka eggs. So much so, the Vath keeneye explains, that they travel to the forelands in search of more in spite of constant deliveries from the Vath. Always near the river, the goblins are now beleaguered by swarms of insects. They refuse to leave, however, asking for the Vath's repellent so they may continue foraging. Speak with the Vath kintamer and prepare for a trip to the Whilom River.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANGNA502_02272_SEQ_02: You speak with the Vath kintamer who helps you swing into the saddle. He bids you a safe journey to the Whilom River, asking that you treat the kongamato gently.
TEXT_BANGNA502_02272_SEQ_03: As you head south, you find a goblin somewhat removed from the riverbank, troubled by the bugs buzzing about his head. You spray him with the repellent and the bugs immediately disperse. The goblin thanks you, and asks that you head to the river to help his two companions.
TEXT_BANGNA502_02272_SEQ_04: You find two goblins near the river and give them a quick spray of the repellent. They thank you profusely then set about their task of scavenging for nanka eggs. Return to Loth ast Vath and inform the Vath keeneye the deed is done.
TEXT_BANGNA502_02272_SEQ_05: The Vath keeneye thanks you for your efforts, but still seems unsure of what to make of this influx of goblin visitors. On the bright side, he supposes, more goblins coming to Loth ast Vath means less traveling to Idyllshire for requests.
TEXT_BANGNA503_02273_SEQ_00:
The Vath keeneye has something he wants to show you.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANGNA503_02273_SEQ_01:
After greeting you in a most unusual manner, the Vath keeneye tells you of yet another request from the goblins. As always, their appetite for nanka eggs is endless, and he would ask you help fill their most recent order. To lure out nankas heavy with eggs, he says you will need to retrieve bait from a trap set up north in the waters of the Hundred Throes.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANGNA503_02273_SEQ_02: You find the trap at the Hundred Throes and inside is a succulent shrimp. Now all that remains is to set your bait upstream of the Whilom River, and wait for nankas to come and take it.
TEXT_BANGNA503_02273_SEQ_03: No sooner do you place the shrimp down in the water than two nankas appear. You dispatch them quickly and procure an ample number of nanka eggs. Return to Loth ast Vath and deliver the eggs to the Vath keeneye.
TEXT_BANGNA503_02273_SEQ_04: The Vath keeneye is grateful for your assistance, and thankful the Gnath do not hunt nanka eggs to make matters worse. He tells you that, unlike the Vath, the Gnath eat the same dreary food every day. All the more reason he and his brethren are glad to be free of the Onemind, able to make decisions for themselves.
TEXT_BANGNA504_02274_SEQ_00:
The Vath keeneye is covering his mandibles, trying not to snigger.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANGNA504_02274_SEQ_01:
Goblins have requested a variety of herbs to be used in the filter of their masks. Because they requested so many, however, the Vath keeneye has decided to split up the work. He asks that you travel to Avalonia Fallen and retrieve leaves from two of the ten herbs requested─specifically, Danner sage and Whilom mint.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANGNA504_02274_SEQ_02: You procure three leaves of Danner sage and Whilom mint respectively. Take them to the Vath keeneye at Loth ast Vath that he can finish preparing the goblins' order.
TEXT_BANGNA504_02274_SEQ_03: The Vath keeneye quickly prepares and packs the herbs for an impatient goblin waiting nearby. However, he does not seem eager to complete the delivery in person. He explains that the Vath have not yet grown accustomed to the peculiar look of goblin masks, and cannot help but laugh at the sight of them. Rather than offending his client, he asks that you take them over in his stead.
TEXT_BANGNA504_02274_SEQ_04: The goblin's anger is replaced with joy when he sees the fine selection of herbs you brought. He happily makes his way back to Idyllshire, practically singing of the profits he will make.
TEXT_BANGNA505_02275_SEQ_00:
The Vath keeneye has need of a capable fleshling.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANGNA505_02275_SEQ_01:
A band of treasure hunters hoping to strike it rich have come from Idyllshire. Though they initially requested an escort, caution gave way to avarice, and they decided to depart unaided. The Vath keeneye fears for their safety, and so he asks you make for Anyx Trine to ensure they have not come to harm.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANGNA505_02275_SEQ_02: You find two of the treasure hunters none the worse for wear, but you recall the Vath keeneye spoke of four in total. Continue your search of Anyx Trine for the remaining hunters.
TEXT_BANGNA505_02275_SEQ_03: You find two more hunters visibly shaken. They claim to have been chased by dragons ever since arriving in Anyx Trine. No sooner do they finish speaking than a pair of hippocerfs appear, ready to attack. Thankfully you are there to dispatch them with relative ease. With the beasts slain, check that the hunters remain uninjured.
TEXT_BANGNA505_02275_SEQ_04: The Lalafellin hunter and his companion are as yet unharmed, and intend to leave before encountering more dragons. In addition to thanking you, he asks that you send his best regards to the Vath. Return to Loth ast Vath to inform the keeneye of their well-being as well as pass along their gratitude.
TEXT_BANGNA505_02275_SEQ_05: The Vath keeneye is glad to hear the hunters are safe, but still fails to understand why they seek treasures that have long since become unusable. It would seem the Vath still have much to learn of fleshlings.
TEXT_BANGNA601_02276_SEQ_00:
The Vath keeneye appears flustered.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANGNA601_02276_SEQ_01:
Anyx Trine is facing a parasitic flea infestation and many of its residents find themselves playing host to these nasty bugs. Itchy and irritable, they ask the Adventurers' Guild to send someone to exterminate them. All necessary preparations to deal with the pests have been made, but the Vath adventurers are petrified at the thought of having to deal with agitated dragons. This mission now falls to you.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANGNA601_02276_SEQ_02: As he helps you onto the kongamato, the Vath kintamer expresses his amazement at your willingness to attend to the afflicted dragons. Make your way to Anyx Trine and deliver them from their misery.
TEXT_BANGNA601_02276_SEQ_03: You exterminate the parasitic fleas without any complications, and the dragons are extremely thankful to be rid of the pests. Head back to Loth ast Vath and tell the Vath keeneye the good news.
TEXT_BANGNA601_02276_SEQ_04: The Vath keeneye listens intently, and is once again impressed with your ability to address any type of situation at a moment's notice. He tells you of how he aspires to one day become as courageous and skilled an adventurer as you.
TEXT_BANGNA602_02277_SEQ_00:
The Vath keeneye has a parcel clasped firmly in his claws.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANGNA602_02277_SEQ_01:
All of the Vath keeneye's attempts to deliver a package addressed to a dragon by the name of Uhm Ala have ended in dismal failure. Aside from the name stenciled neatly on the parcel, the only tidbit of information he has to go on is that Uhm Ala has yellow scales. Unfortunately, many dragons residing in the towers fit this description. He thinks that maybe an experienced adventurer like you will have better luck delivering the package, and asks that you take over this assignment for him. With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter any phrase that contains the name “Uhm Ala” to find the dragon whose package remains undelivered.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANGNA602_02277_SEQ_02: You approach several yellow-scaled dragons, none of which turn out to be the great Uhm Ala. You do, however, gain some valuable insight from speaking to them, and now know to look for a regal dragon residing somewhere within the tower. Make your way to the upper level of Anyx Trine and with the chat mode in Say, enter any phrase containing “Uhm Ala” to ascertain the identity of the yellow dragon that dwells there.
TEXT_BANGNA602_02277_SEQ_03: You finally find Uhm Ala. Present his parcel to him.
TEXT_BANGNA602_02277_SEQ_04: You deliver the package to Uhm Ala. Return to Loth ast Vath and report to the Vath keeneye.
TEXT_BANGNA602_02277_SEQ_05: You report back to the Vath keeneye, who thanks you for your service. He laments the fact that he has so much trouble telling the dragons apart.
TEXT_BANGNA603_02278_SEQ_00:
The Vath keeneye needs you to search for a lost child.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANGNA603_02278_SEQ_01:
One of the younglings of Anyx Trine has gone out to play but does not return, and an anxious mother dragon enlists the guild's services. While many Vath have been scouring the nearby lands to find this missing child, their latest encounter with a vicious monster has left all of them far too shaken up to press on in their search. The Vath keeneye turns to you once more, and asks that you look for the baby dragon in their stead.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANGNA603_02278_SEQ_02: The mother dragon tells you that her son often plays in the Sohm Al foothills. As per her suggestion, go there and search for him.
TEXT_BANGNA603_02278_SEQ_03: You find the playful pup, who starts a game of tag. Follow him.
TEXT_BANGNA603_02278_SEQ_04: You catch up to the little dragon, who insists on continuing his little game. Pursue him.
TEXT_BANGNA603_02278_SEQ_05: You finally corner the dragon pup. He tells you he is tired and will now return home. Report to the mother at Anyx Trine.
TEXT_BANGNA603_02278_SEQ_06: You speak with the mother, who is relieved to have her son returned to her safe and sound. She thanks you for finding him, and tells you that he was ecstatic to have made acquaintance with those from outside of the tower. Return to Loth ast Vath and report to the Vath keeneye.
TEXT_BANGNA603_02278_SEQ_07: After learning of your success in retrieving and returning the naughty dragon pup, the Vath keeneye breathes a sigh of relief. He is extremely happy that he will not need to contend with any angry mother dragons in the near future.
TEXT_BANGNA604_02279_SEQ_00:
The Vath keeneye is deep in thought.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANGNA604_02279_SEQ_01:
Silver dew smoke hovers in a thick cloud draped about Anyx Trine, and the dragons inhabiting the tower believe the Vath to be the perpetrators of this heinous crime. The Vath, however, suspect the true source of this smoke to be the censers that have recently been appearing across Gnath territory. The Vath keeneye believes there to be four new censers, having counted four distinct wisps of smoke from a distance. Make your way to the Smoldering Wastes, disable the Gnath censers, and help the Vath clear the air.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANGNA604_02279_SEQ_02: You disable all the Gnath censers. Return to Loth ast Vath and report to the Vath keeneye.
TEXT_BANGNA604_02279_SEQ_03: The Vath keeneye thanks you for your hard work. He is convinced the Vath can remain in the dragons' good graces now that the Gnath censers have been disabled.
TEXT_BANGNA605_02280_SEQ_00:
The Vath keeneye stares off into the distance, his unwavering gaze set upon Mourn.
※The difficulty of this quest will be synced to your current level.
TEXT_BANGNA605_02280_SEQ_01:
Mourn has been overrun by pesky dinosaurs, and the Adventurers' Guild is asked to find a way to reduce their numbers. Deciding it to be the safest course of action, the Vath keeneye sends the Vath braveheart to steal their eggs. What was to be a quick job has resulted in the braveheart disappearing for days and now the keeneye needs someone to find─and possibly rescue─his friend. Travel to the caverns of Mourn and look for the braveheart.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANGNA605_02280_SEQ_02: You speak with the Vath braveheart, who is paralyzed with fear but adamant about seeing his duties through. Search Mourn for a tyrannosaur egg and deliver it to the braveheart.
TEXT_BANGNA605_02280_SEQ_03: You pick up one of the tyrannosaur eggs. Deliver it to the Vath braveheart.
TEXT_BANGNA605_02280_SEQ_04: In his panic the Vath braveheart forgot to tell you that he must take back two tyrannosaur eggs. He would like for you to bring him another. Search Mourn for a second egg.
TEXT_BANGNA605_02280_SEQ_05: Your last trek through the caves seems to have given you a good idea on where to find the dinosaur eggs and you are quick to locate another one. Pick it up and deliver it to the Vath braveheart.
TEXT_BANGNA605_02280_SEQ_06: The Vath braveheart is very upset that the Vath keeneye did not disclose to him all the necessary details before having him embark upon this mission. In a trembling voice, he claims that he will be staying behind in the caverns of Mourn with the beasts he so fears as a form of protest.
TEXT_BANGNA605_02280_SEQ_07: The Vath keeneye is stunned and insulted to learn that the Vath braveheart believes him to be unworthy of managing their Adventurers' Guild. He shakes his head and tells you that running an organization is a great deal more difficult than he had ever expected it to be.
TEXT_BANMOG101_02290_SEQ_00:

Mogek the Marvelous is in need of a master .
TEXT_BANMOG101_02290_SEQ_01:
Having inducted a large number of new recruits into his ranks, Mogek the Marvelous is running low on the tools and supplies necessary to see that they are properly trained. He requests that you craft the aforementioned items and directs you to speak with Mogwon, who has been rushing about Asah to gather materials for you.

TEXT_BANMOG101_02290_SEQ_02:
