TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_SEQ_02: When you arrive at the Last Dregs, you see that your new customers are Grebuloffs─the diminutive tribe whose last days you witnessed in the Dead Ends. Their memories of the grim occasion are apparently quite similar to yours, as you find one sobbing into their salad while the other sighs mournfully. It would appear that they long for a glorious yesteryear, though that is about as much as you can glean before they take off at a sprint, heedless of Jammingway's shouted offer of tea.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_SEQ_03: You make for the unmemoried portal only to find that the Grebuloffs have already departed Ostrakon Hena. N-7000 helpfully suggests inquiring with patrol units at Base Omicron who may have detected their passing.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_SEQ_04: N-7000 transmits recorded data of the Grebuloffs to nearby Omicron patrol units. They in turn provide useful data of their own, indicating that your rogue patrons ran through Base Omicron in the direction of the clouded portal, and have likely passed through it already.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_SEQ_05: You relay the information you collected to N-7000, who agrees with your conclusion. With little hope of catching up to the Grebuloffs without knowing where in Ostrakon Tria they have disappeared to, your party resolves to ask the Ea if they have seen any tiny creatures in diving suits sprint past their abode.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_SEQ_06: When you meet N-7000 and Jammingway in the abode of the Ea, they have already located an informative individual, who tells you that the Grebuloffs did indeed come this way. As they were apparently in search of water, the Ea directed them to the wellspring of regret, where they may yet remain.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_SEQ_07: Though you at last locate your Grebuloff customers at the wellspring, it seems they are not much happier for having reached a water source, as it pales in comparison to the ocean of their own star─which was, as both you and they recall, horrifically corrupted along with almost the entire Grebuloff population during their version of the apocalypse. In the hopes of evoking even slightly less depressing memories in these poor souls, Jammingway suggests that you prepare a dish using ingredients with the comforting fragrance of the sea. As you head off to procure just such a thing, they and N-7000 set about coaxing the Grebuloffs out of their breakdown and back to the Last Dregs.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_SEQ_08: Fortunately, both management and patrons make it back to the café intact, and no sooner do you provide N-7000 with sufficiently sea-smelling ingredients than do it and Jammingway prepare a cerulean soup for your beleaguered customers. The dish does its work in reminding them of happier times, and though they fervently wish that they had taken better care of their most precious natural resource, the memory of the many joys it brought their people cheers them significantly. This emotional about-face seems to trigger something in the dynamis of Elysion, for you immediately receive a transmission from Stigma-4 indicating that changes have been wrought upon the star.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_SEQ_09: You proceed to Elysion with your allies to find the Grebuloffs happily playing at a seaside identical to those once found in their homeland. Though N-7000 appears to be the Omicron version of “inspired” by your success in turning the creatures' soul-deep despair into this hopeful scene, it confesses that it yet harbors doubts about what meaning can be found in the life of a replicated being. Jammingway, however, confidently assures it that, though the Omicrons and your café patrons may have been created from the memories and emotions of the long dead, the ability of their feelings to affect dynamis proves that they matter just as much to the cosmos as anyone else─and should behave accordingly.

TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_SEQ_02: To say that all is not going as well as your colleagues anticipated would be an understatement, given that you arrive to find that Patron-005 and Patron-006─of the nihilistic Nibirun civilization─have triggered an existential crisis in one of the Omicron barkeeps. N-7000 steps in to prevent a complete system shutdown and is fortunately able to redirect Nibirun attentions to the other settlements of Ultima Thule for a time, but it is clear that making satisfied customers out of these individuals will be a monumental undertaking. Seeking a better source of emotional influence and potential custom, the three of you agree to try the Ea, instead.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_SEQ_03: You journey to the abode of the Ea, where Jammingway proposes dividing your forces in the hopes of striking upon a likely customer. As ordered, you direct your attention to the mysterious stone formation where members of the ethereal civilization seem to congregate.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_SEQ_04: Though you speak to two Ea, neither seems the least impressed by your offers of quality food and beverages. Perhaps Jammingway and N-7000 have had better luck─but probably not.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_SEQ_05: Indeed, your fellow Last Dregs managers have met with round dismissal at the spindly hands of the Ea. Having taken this all rather personally, Jammingway insists that you make another attempt to pique their curiosity─this time, together.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_SEQ_06: You speak again with the sophistic Ea, this time petitioning it to answer just a few questions. It has no objections─evidently, incessant questioning is something of a pastime among the Ea─and goes so far as to invite a friend to join in. Though the pair end up asking more questions than you do, your rousing discussion nevertheless manages to stimulate their desire to learn more of the gustatory sensations they may have once experienced. To this end, your fellow managers propose experimenting with various dishes to see if any resonate, and send you off in search of unfamiliar flavors.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_SEQ_07:
Having delivered the necessary ingredients to
N-7000, you gaze with trepidation upon the various dishes Jammingway has prepared. As your role as taste-tester demands, however, you bravely sample all that you can manage, providing gustatory data for N-7000 to pass along to the Ea. They are pleased─if slightly flummoxed─by the result, managing even to identify shellfish as a flavor their people may have once enjoyed. Curious to see if this has had any effect on the star, Jammingway leads the way to Elysion.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_SEQ_08: You arrive on Elysion to find it inhabited by new life─a species of jellyfish-like creatures matching naught real or reconstructed in N-7000's database. The Ea speculate that these creatures might be born of some long-lost memory of their infant forms, and dub them the “Miw Miisv” in hopes that they may unlock further insights into the corporeal Ea that once were.

TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_SEQ_03: You proceed to Reah Tahra, where Jammingway attempts to hail a representative of the Dragonstar. TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_SEQ_04: Though she is aware of her people's history with the invaders from the Alphatron Star, Vidofnir elects to concern herself with the welfare of her fellow dragons rather than ancient grudges. TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_SEQ_05: Armed with the knowledge of which terrestrial resources once brought a nostalgic tear to Midgardsormr's eye, you gather the perfect ingredients near Anyx Trine, and set about making a confectioner's Sohm Al. TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_SEQ_06: Alongside your allies, you venture to Elysion, a portion of which has now been transformed into a vision of the Dragonstar. You settle on an idea that would allow them to communicate with the people of Etheirys regardless of distance─radio. As you have only ever been on the listening end of such devices, however, the technical requirements will need to be gleaned from experts before you can set to work. In the meanwhile, Dreamingway asks that you accompany him to tempt no-longer-Counselingway with word of the project.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_SEQ_02: You and Dreamingway find the ashen-furred Loporrit in their usual spot, gazing at the faraway Etheirys. The mention of radio prompts the lengthiest proclamation you've heard from them thus far, revealing that they maintain a keen interest in being of the utmost aid to mankind. Whether they will follow through on their stated intent to provide additional input on programming remains to be seen, but it appears you have at least piqued their interest...
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_SEQ_03: Back in Hoper's Hold, you consult Dreamingway and Managingway about the equipment required for creating radio transmissions. Though the instructions are somewhat unclear, your craftsman's competence has carried you through thus far, and there is no reason to believe it shall not do so again.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_SEQ_04: You present the necessary equipment─probably─to Dreamingway, and the broadcasting station is created with minimal incident. With some encouragement, the ashen-furred Loporrit is persuaded to voice the inaugural broadcast, transmitting a message of newfound hope to people across Etheirys. Are you listening?

TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_SEQ_03: The second letter is for Inventingway, whose passions have resonated with the mechanically minded people of Garlemald. A representative of the fallen nation entreats his aid in rebuilding─a request to which he is most willing to acquiesce. One can only imagine what surprises might await next you visit the Garlean capital...
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_SEQ_04: You carry your next letter to Cookingway, who has seen a surge in orders at the cooking station. Despite the popularity of his proffered fare, he is concerned that carrots remain a dominant ingredient, and, with a solely Loporrit clientele, has few sources of inspiration as to alternatives. Fortunately, his delivery is from Dickon at the Last Stand, who has helpfully included a recipe of his own design, along with a request that Cookingway send along any ideas he subsequently dreams up. With this fruitful partnership established, Hoper's Hold is certain to be home to fresh flavors in no time.
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_SEQ_05: The final two letters are intended for the erstwhile Counselingway. They open the missives to find words of gratitude and admiration, and are deeply moved to learn that they have touched hearts on Etheirys after all. They offer you their thanks for helping them find their way, and introduce you to their new appellation─Talkingway─in anticipation of many friendly conversations to come.
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_SEQ_06: Having seen each letter to its rightful recipient, you report to Dreamingway. He reflects on the unlikely but indisputable success of the Dreaming Workshop, thanking you for your contribution on behalf of Loporrit-kind. You part ways with a formal invitation to visit any time you like─for, even with new dreams in their hearts, the Loporrits will always be waiting for you.

TEXT_BANALL310_04787_SEQ_00: A manager's work is never done─or so Jammingway's muttering would indicate.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_SEQ_01: Though the patrons of the Last Dregs are highly satisfied with its menu and service, Jammingway continues─in spite of N-7000's better judgment─to search for means to make the café a source of even greater joy in the universe. They are fresh out of inspiration at the moment, however, leading you to suggest that they consult with their most creative of kin: the Loporrits in Hoper's Hold.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_SEQ_02: You accompany Jammingway to Bestways Burrow, where they thoroughly search each station in Hoper's Hold for inspiration. Alas, though they find many activities to tempt a Loporrit such as themself, they see naught that would uniformly suit the diverse café-goers of Ultima Thule. Not wont to give up so easily, they resolve to consult Dreamingway, who may yet have big ideas up his tiny sleeve.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_SEQ_03: Dreamingway, for his part, suggests calling upon Talkingway's knowledge of events on Etheirys, accumulated via letters from the radio station's listeners. Doing so yields a promising lead─the Hippo Riders' Hannish Hippo Hustle has become the talk of Thavnair and beyond. Convinced that such an event is guaranteed to excite even the most nihilistic of Last Dregs patrons, Jammingway insists that you speak to Trna about taking her hippos on the intergalactic road immediately.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_SEQ_04: Upon arriving in Svarna, you and Jammingway speak with Trna. She, however, turns down your request to host a hippo hustle in Ultima Thule, citing her own overwhelming workload as head of an in-demand delivery business.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_SEQ_05: Disappointed but not defeated by Trna's response, Jammingway asks that you meet a discreet distance away to decide if anything might be done to convince her. You are joined shortly by none other than Acala, who is ill content to let Trna decline an opportunity to pursue her passion for racing. He encourages you to remind her that she has a whole team of enthusiastic Hippo Riders eager to share her burdens, as she has always shared theirs.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_SEQ_06: Inspired by Acala's sincerity, you appeal to Trna's innate zest for adventure and trust in her team. Though she is stubborn to the last, you ultimately convince her to follow the siren song of the racetrack to parts unknown.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_SEQ_07: Jammingway is thrilled to report your success in securing rousing entertainment to N-7000, but the Omicron cuts their conversation short─apparently due to an emergency at the Last Dregs. Given the café's unique operational parameters, one hesitates to even guess at what has gone wrong this time...
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_SEQ_00: Jammingway appears moderately concerned about the unidentified calamity that may or may not be befalling the Last Dregs at this very moment.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_SEQ_01: Jammingway requests that you visit the Last Dregs, on the off chance that whatever caused N-7000 to terminate its transmission poses a serious threat to the café. As alternative duties likely involve cleaning up after terrified hippos being transported beyond the boundaries of their known world, you readily agree.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_SEQ_02: Upon inquiring with N-7000, you learn that the previous commotion was the patrons' sudden and fervent desire to join the upcoming race─it seems that they have all gone off to prepare their own vehicles while Last Dregs employees and the Dreaming Ways set up for the contest. N-7000 indicates that Inventingway wishes to consult you about a related matter, and thus do you set off for Base Omicron to seek him out.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_SEQ_03: You speak with Inventingway, who cheerfully convinces you to participate in the race yourself. He has already prepared a modified moon-hopper for the occasion, so you need only make for A-4 Research and inform N-7000 of your intentions.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_SEQ_04: After registering you for the race, N-7000 provides an overview of the course, which will take contestants across multiple regions of Ultima Thule. Jammingway volunteers to bring your moon-hopper along to the starting line─the starship Ragnarok─and instructs you to wait for them there.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_SEQ_05: With every team's preparations complete, the Hyper Hustle begins. Though several racers are knocked off of the course, you deftly avoid its perils and glide to the front of the pack. For a time, Trna and Ra-la remain a threat to your victory, but with a little help from Inventingway's enhancements to your hopper, you speed past both to edge across the finish line.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_SEQ_06: Back at the Last Dregs, Jammingway congratulates you on your victory by way of an enormous trophy. The other participants will also not be going home empty-handed, as the Dreaming Ways have provided new radios for diners in both the nekropolis and Svarna. Though the Hyper Hustle will soon be but a fond memory, you know in your heart that reasons to rejoice in this wide, wide universe are never-ending.

In Bayside Bevy you meet Liplu, a childhood friend of Mablu's, who was apparently waiting for you to pass through. Delighted, the young Pelupelu quickly launches into a proposal, offering you the role of special advisor for her new venture, the Turali Travel Agency. She does not expect an immediate response, though, and requests that you visit her in the Kozama'uka village of Ok'hanu should you wish to know more.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_SEQ_02: You receive a warm welcome from the enterprising Pelu and her associates in Ok'hanu, who go on to state their main goals for the travel agency. Inspired by Vow Wuk Lamat's experience of growing to love her people even more by getting to know them better, many Turali are eager to learn about their neighbors, and Liplu's new travel agency would serve to facilitate such experiences. Moreover, this venture would help to revitalize Kozama'uka, which is still in the process of rebuilding following the recent great storm. Liplu wishes to further explain her plans, however.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_SEQ_03: Liplu informs you that the core business will be to provide accommodations and guided tours of the local area. After you officially consent to assist as a special advisor, she immediately asks that you help by assessing plans for prospective tours. She bids the three guides head to the sites of their respective tours, and gives you a moment to catch your breath.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_SEQ_04: Without further ado, you and Liplu venture forth to listen to the plans of the Hanu guides, beginning with Genuhanu, who awaits you in the Fields of Gold.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_SEQ_05: Genuhanu details his idea to show guests around the reed fields that dominate the landscape. Liplu in turn suggests including a tour of the village, providing visitors with an insight into the local way of life, and thus the context to appreciate the crucial role that reeds play in Hanuhanu culture. Leaving the Fields of Gold behind, you head for Breath Between to speak with Zelihali, who has another potential tour in mind.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_SEQ_06: You find the Hanu gazing at the raging waters feeding into Ku'uxage. Snapping out of her reverie, she reveals her plan to take visitors on a linguistic and historical stroll along the river. After offering your insights, you set off to meet Xenuhanu outside Cave Kikitola, that you might assess yet another tour idea.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_SEQ_07: The soon-to-be guide speaks of the cave's cultural significance and breathtaking natural beauty. Liplu sees the potential for a truly special experience, but one best reserved for experienced travelers, given the remote location and threat of fiends in the area. You leave Xenuhanu to finish fine-tuning his plan, and make your way back to Ok'hanu.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_SEQ_08: You rendezvous with Liplu in the Hanu village, where the young Pelu mulls over what exactly the Turali Travel Agency will provide its customers. She invites you to join her by Dock Poga, where Yubli and Wuk Evu have been establishing the agency's base of operations.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_SEQ_09: While expressing her determination to make the venture a success, Liplu informs you that construction is ready to begin. You watch on as Wuk Evu leads his team of laborers, who are soon heaving the last timber into place. The newly built Turali Travel Agency is almost ready to open its doors. Only time will tell what awaits you as the fledgling enterprise's special advisor.

TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_SEQ_03: Keen to ensure that naught goes wrong during Tseeya's visit, Liplu bids you keep an eye on the Hhetsarro and his guide, Zelihali. You dutifully head for Ok'hanu, where the tour begins.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_SEQ_04: You stand watch as Zelihali recounts the role played by Wuk Lamat in the Lifting of Wings. A fascinated Tseeya gazes up at the woven festival float, struck by the significance of the Hanuhanu's prize crop. Cultural lesson complete, the pair make for Breath Between for the next activity on the agenda: a spot of fishing.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_SEQ_05: With the ever-flowing waters of Ku'uxage in view, you look on as your charges bask in their surroundings and wait for the fish to bite. Before long, though, Tseeya asks his guide if she knows of any waters off the beaten track. Eager to oblige, Zelihali suggests they try Cave Kikitola, well known among local anglers for its abundance. Yet the more remote location may also prove more hazardous...
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_SEQ_06: Sure enough, not long after your arrival, a pack of voracious orobon emerge from the gloom. You dispatch the foul beasts and continue to stand guard over the oblivious Tseeya and Zelihali.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_SEQ_07: Thanks in no small part to your vigilance, the tour ends without incident─for your charges at least. You make your way back to Dock Poga, where Liplu awaits your return.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_SEQ_08: It seems your encounters with the fiends did not go entirely unnoticed. After raising his concerns regarding guest safety, Tseeya reveals that the Wing of Reflection is considering supporting Tural's nascent tourism industry. Buoyed by this expression of interest from the government itself, Liplu decides to invest in a facility for guides to train in the art of visitor protection. As the Turali Travel Agency continues to grow, there will be much and more required of you to ensure its continued success.

In response, Zanuhali offers an unexpected solution: an ancient rite to imbue punutiys with the power of flight, thereby making the upper reaches of Kozama'uka more readily accessible. TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_SEQ_03: Before leaving for Tuliyollal in search of beastkeepers and punutiys, Liplu assigns you the unglamorous task of gathering reeds for the Hanu's flight-giving effigy. Gonahanu awaits your arrival in the Fields of Gold.
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_SEQ_04: The friendly Hanu gives you unfettered access to the paddies, insisting you take as many reeds as you need. You prepare to harvest a suitable quantity.
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_SEQ_05: Having selected a fine crop of the lushest reeds you could find, it is time to visit Lanuhali in Kozanuakiy to make your delivery.
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_SEQ_06: You hand over the freshly harvested reeds to Lanuhali, who explains that she and her fellow Hanu will be responsible for completing the effigy. Liplu will no doubt be keen to hear of your progress.
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_SEQ_07: Thanks to the Hanuhanu and their wind magicks, the punutiys are now capable of flight. With the gentle airborne giants permanently housed at Dock Poga, the Turali Travel Agency is poised to expand into upstream Kozama'uka. More ground to cover will no doubt entail more responsibilities for the agency's special advisor, but you steel yourself for the challenges ahead.

TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_SEQ_06: You come across the Tonawawta gasping for breath in the lee of a rocky outcrop. Resigned to whatever fate lies in store for him, Wawkesa agrees to speak with Liplu. You prepare to reconvene with the pair in the Dewspun Bank.
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_SEQ_07: Convinced at last that Liplu's proposal was genuine, the Tonawawta shares the harrowing tale of his past. Having been forced to toil in Shaaloani mines as children for many years, Wawkesa and his comrades one day realized they would need to escape or die beneath the earth. Though they made good their escape, their foreman attempted to hunt them down, and it was only by fleeing to Kozama'uka and turning to crime that they managed to evade recapture. Hearing this, Liplu reassures Wawkesa that she does not wish to bind or send him back, and once again extends him and his crew an invitation to earn an honest living at the Turali Travel Agency. Though he is unsure how precisely they may be of service, he is willing to accept, and so all leave to discuss matters further at Dock Poga.
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_SEQ_08: Back at the agency, Liplu is quick to assuage Wawkesa's concerns about returning to public life. TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_SEQ_05: What might have been a disastrous reunion ends in friendly agreement, and Kageel Ja offers to lend his support. Ruvoll Ja is hopeful that all must be in readiness by now, but it may be good to check with Anggir on that point first.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_SEQ_06: Anggir bids you bring her materials replete with charcoal so as to balance the acidity of the soil. No stranger to gathering, you venture forth to the Xobr'it Cinderfield for what she requires.

TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_SEQ_08: The banquet is held successfully, establishing a newfound understanding between the peoples of Iq Br'aax and Mamook. While some scars may never fade, tomorrow will always offer new avenues of hope, if only one chooses to take that first step forward. With Gok Golma's success, Mamook has proven itself not only capable of change but a champion of it, and you can only anticipate with pride the ever-brighter future of a community that once suffered so greatly.

TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_SEQ_00:
Fahrafahr seeks a skilled hand for an enormous task.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_SEQ_01:
A Yok Huy introducing herself as Fahrafahr seeks the aid of a skilled artisan─a need which you conveniently fill. She informs you that the snow spirits living in the nearby mountains have gone berserk, triggering an avalanche that buried a remote location that contained a ceremonial altar. Apparently, performing a ceremony called the Pact at this altar is the only way to quell the rage of the spirits, and Fahrafahr requests your aid in rebuilding it. Before agreeing to the task, you ask to see the extent of the damage, and together you and Fahrafahr go to the mountain pass leading to the site of destruction.

※Please note that you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_SEQ_02: You arrive at Zirgorteh the Open-armed, and the crumbled buildings that dot the small valley make clear the enormity of the task before you. Fahrafahr tells you that she knew of the area and the Pact because of one Dartorgor, a dear friend who was the last of an ancient group of caretakers that kept the snow spirits placated. Dartorgor unfortunately died in a tragic accident, and Fahrafahr states that although there is yet much to learn, she intends to follow in her departed friend's footsteps. You agree to help the young Yok Huy, and for your first task, she asks you to come with her to Worlar's Echo and recruit extra hands while she prepares for the work ahead.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_SEQ_03: After asking around Worlar's Echo, you manage to recruit a few Yok Huy eager to help with the reconstruction, with the promise of more to come. You head back to the mountain pass to report your success to Fahrafahr.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_SEQ_04: Fahrafahr is overjoyed at the number of new helpers which have joined her cause, and with the most essential roles of the project decided, it seems she is ready to assign you your first task. You ask her what your first contribution to this impressive undertaking shall be.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_SEQ_05: The first order of the day is to create a comfortable place where the Hands of Zirgorteh can live on the mountain. To that end, Fahrafahr means to restore Dartorgor's former home, and she tasks you with creating materials to help with insulation. You take tools in hand and get to work.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_SEQ_06: Fahrafahr is impressed with your final product, and before long she and the other Yok Huy finish restoring Dartorgor's former household, thus establishing a base from which to conduct further work. With this first step, you begin the long journey towards seeing peace restored to the snowcapped peaks of Urqopacha.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_SEQ_00:
Fahrafahr seems pleased with how work is coming along─most of it, anyway.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_SEQ_01:
With the first step of the Zirgorteh of the Open-armed's restoration complete, Fahrafahr has already moved on to the next. She and the Hands have begun building a workshop wherein Yok Huy masons can craft stone using their traditional methods, but it seems progress has come to a halt. Fahrafahr is sparse on the details, but asks you to follow her and meet the stonemason Girzorhor to find out what the problem is.

※Please note that you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_SEQ_02: You meet the stonemason Girzorhor, who seems to have been stricken by an immobilizing fear. You search for the right words to /soothe his troubled heart.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_SEQ_03: At your calming words, Girzorhor regains his composure long enough to tell you that a group of snow spirits attacked him while he was working. Bemoaning the hazardous conditions of his workplace, the stonemason practically flees from the mountain. However, Fahrafahr is determined to make him see reason, as his knowledge is essential to building the workshop. She asks you to accompany her, and together you descend to Worlar's Echo.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_SEQ_04: In an effort to allay Girzorhor's fears, Fahrafahr tells him Dartorgor's tale─how she was the sole keeper of the Breathless Altar and kept the spirits appeased with the Pact. You also pitch in to remind him how vital the work being done is, and Girzorhor is impressed by the courage of company both past and present. Seemingly at ease, he agrees to help the Hands of Zirgorteh again, but confesses that he lost some of his tools in his flight from the spirits. Luckily, a capable artisan is close at hand, and Fahrafahr asks you to create tools to replace the lost ones.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_SEQ_05: You deliver the tools to Girzorhor, and inspired by the quality of your work, he returns to Zirgorteh the Open-armed with a newfound sense of purpose. Fahrafahr commends you on your work, but must return to resume her own tasks. She asks you to visit with her next time you make the trek up the mountain pass.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_SEQ_06: It seems Girzorhor's inspiration was such that by the time you return to Zirgorteh the Open-armed, the workshop is already complete. Now that they can create the traditional stonework of the Yok Huy, the Hands of Zirgorteh are ready to rebuild in earnest. Proud to have honored the memory of her mentor, Fahrafahr encourages you to hone your skills for when next step in their project begins.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_SEQ_00:
Fahrafahr would send someone into Worlar's Echo.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_SEQ_01:
The next step towards rebuilding the altar is to restore a larder the Hands of Zirgorteh uncovered which once housed foodstuffs and ceremonial offerings used in the Pact. However, Fahrafahr is uncertain which items were used in the ritual, and asks that you visit Worlar's Echo to speak with a merchant that supplied Dartorgor with provisions. While you do that, she and the other Yok Huy will continue to clear the snow which even now lies thick in the mountain valley.

※Please note that you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_SEQ_02: You find Kurbulur and the old merchant fondly recalls his trades with Dartorgor. Apparently she eschewed coin and instead bartered with corn and corn seeds grown in the frigid mountains. Recalling that Dartorgor said they were tailored to the tastes of someone or something held as important by their group, Kurbulur surmises that it might have something to do with the Pact. He then asks to accompany you back to Zirgorteh so he might find a way to help Fahrafahr and the others, and together you depart.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_SEQ_03: Fahrafahr welcomes the addition of a new member to her group, and together she and Kurbulur ponder the meaning of the corn once grown in the snowy valley. Before they come to a definitive answer, one of the workers informs you that they recently uncovered a sepulchre buried in the snow, which may very well be Dartorgor's. However, it seems to be frozen in ice, meaning special tools are required if the stone is to be freed without damage to its inscriptions. Hoping that the answers she seeks are on the sepulchre, Fahrafahr shifts focus and asks you to accompany her to Shelter to begin construction of the tools you require.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_SEQ_04: Fahrafahr appoints you with your next task: craft tools to help free Dartorgor's living sepulchre from the ice. With unlimited supplies at your disposal, you get to work.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_SEQ_05: Your work meets with effusive praise from Fahrafahr, and finally her intrepid group of Yok Huy workers manage both to free Dartorgor's sepulchre from the ice and finish restoration of the larder. While she is eager to move forward with rebuilding the altar, Fahrafahr must take time to carefully read the stories written on her mentor's sepulchre. In the meantime, there are many tasks big and small around the workshop, each of which are begging for an eager artisan to complete them.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_SEQ_00:
Fahrafahr is eager to share news of recent progress.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_SEQ_01:
Fahrafahr happily informs you that she has deciphered Dartorgor's living sepulchre and that new workers of both flesh and stone have joined the cause. Everything appears to be proceeding apace, and Fahrafahr asks you to follow her to the sepulchre so she might share the secrets it holds.

※Please note that you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_SEQ_02: Fahrafahr reads Dartorgor's living sepulchre for you, which starts with the story of her ancestors and the first Pact. Apparently the spirits are partial to a corn liquor called kirkahryar, which has been the centerpiece of the ritual for generations. This makes apparent the purpose of the corn Dartorgor used as currency, and Fahrafahr decides to speak with Kurbulur to see how viable it would be to make kirkahryar on the mountain. You follow the eager Yok Huy to the larder.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_SEQ_03: As luck would have it, Kurbulur tells you that a ruined building was but recently discovered. He surmises it was once the very place where kirkahryar was produced, and Fahrafahr decides to make its restoration a priority. The stone golem would make the task much easier, but its viability as a tool is yet to be determined. Fahrafahr bids you follow her to the outskirts of Worlar's Echo to check on the progress of the golem's testing.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_SEQ_04: The Yok Huy in charge of the golem has unfortunate news: the construct's components have worn with age, and it cannot move until some of them have been replaced. Namely, the golem requires something to power its body, and Fahrafahr volunteers you to make the replacement. Together you and Fahrafahr visit Wurfurtar to see if he has any aetherically conductive materials.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_SEQ_05: Having already spoken with Wurfurtar, Fahrafahr furnishes you with the materials required to create highly conductive parts. You take your tools in hand and set to work.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_SEQ_06: Your work is met with approval by Fahrafahr, and together you return to the golem's keeper. The ancient construct comes to life, and with its aid both the brewery and altar are restored to their former glory. Zirgorteh the Open-armed is now as pristine as in the days Dartorgor and her kin lived there, and all that is left is to wait for the kirkahryar to finish fermenting before the Pact can begin.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_SEQ_00:
Fahrafahr appears anxious to get your attention.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_SEQ_01:
With the kirkahryar finally complete, the smell of corn liquor wafts through the mountain pass, and Fahrafahr informs you that the scent has drawn snow spirits to the area. She is determined to go forward with the Pact immediately, and honors you with the task of getting a barrel of the libation from the kirkahryar house and placing it on the Breathless Altar.

※Please note that you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_SEQ_02: The eager brewer happily provides you with a jar of kirkahryar, and laments that he cannot see the Pact for himself. Taking the heavy container in hand, you begin your journey to the Breathless Altar, which you see is located at the top of a lengthy set of stairs.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_SEQ_03: As the ritual begins, one of the larger snow spirits approaches and indulges in the offering of kirkahryar. After a few tense moments, the spirit begins to speak in a calm voice. Relief at this development is short lived, however, as the spirit is quick to condemn Dartorgor and all the other Yok Huy for having the temerity to abandon them through death. The spirits depart before listening to reason, and you turn to Fahrafahr to see how she is handling this new development.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_SEQ_04: Fahrafahr admits that something must be done before the spirits once again succumb to rage. She asks you to follow her to Dartorgor's living sepulchre so you may share thoughts on potential solutions to this new challenge.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_SEQ_05: You and Fahrafahr discuss how best to make the spirits understand the Yok Huy view on life and death and settle upon the idea of building a living sepulchre to immortalize the bond between the snow spirits and Yok Huy. It falls upon you to convince the spirits to return to the altar, and Fahrafahr suggests telling them that the frostblooms have blossomed at the site. The Yok Huy sets to work on getting the sepulchre built as quickly as possible, and you head towards Worqor Zormor with your eyes peeled for powdery white creatures.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_SEQ_06: The snow spirits are receptive to your invitation, and while they mourn Dartorgor's absence, the appeal of viewing flowers in bloom seems to perk them up. With an audience for the unveiling of the sepulchre secured, you return to Shelter to report your success to Fahrafahr.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_SEQ_07: Fahrafahr is pleased at your news, but it seems there is a problem with the sepulchre that she would recruit your aid in solving. While the stone monuments are usually engraved with symbols which tell the stories of their subject, Fahrafahr is aware that the spirits likely cannot read them. She hopes to imbue the sepulchres with magical energy that will convey the sentiments of the sepulchre in a way the spirits can grasp, and asks you to construct materials that will help achieve that end.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_SEQ_08: With the final touches you provide, the Yok Huy artisans complete the living sepulchre and Fahrafahr invites you to its unveiling. With the aid of the magic imbued in the stone, the spirits come to an understanding that friends both old and new will be there to play with them for a long time to come. Overcome with joy, the spirits invite all present to frolic among the snowdrifts, marking the first celebration of a friendship given warmth anew.
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_SEQ_00:
Fahrafahr looks like she's been rolling around in the snow.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_SEQ_01:
It seems the snow spirits are back to their playful selves, and Fahrafahr informs you that more come to visit the altar by the day. She asks you to accompany her to Zirgorteh the Open-armed and speak with the spirits yourself, so you might drink in the festive atmosphere with your own eyes.

※Please note that you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_SEQ_02: Throughout the snowy valley, the sounds of laughter and lively conversation can be heard from Yok Huy and spirits alike. It is plain an old fellowship has been rekindled, and after taking everything in, you return to Fahrafahr to speak of what is to come.
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_SEQ_03: Fahrafahr is overjoyed at how things have turned out, and feels closer to Dartorgor for the struggles she endured to get here. The snow spirits, as well, seem to have come to an understanding of the Yok Huy perspective on death, and now look forward to new friendships that will endure generations. The living sepulchres stand as testament to this fellowship, and as the days come and go, they will surely be filled with stories of joy shared between the Yok Huy and the spirits of the snowy mountains.

TEXT_BANALL410_05462_SEQ_00: Zelihali wears a tired but fulfilled expression on her face.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_SEQ_01: It appears business at the Turali Travel Agency is booming, as Zelihali so enthusiastically informs you. After chatting about recent happenings in your lives, the Hanu remembers that Wawkesa wanted to speak with you about something─likely a new venture that he and Liplu are planning. She soon takes her leave to attend to new arrivals, leaving you to make for the eatery and find out what the pair has in store for you.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_SEQ_02: Liplu and Wawkesa ask whether you are behind the recent stories told by their customers across Tural of a lone traveler with skilled hands and a selfless heart. After admitting your role in helping both Zirgorteh the Open-armed and Gok Golma flourish, Liplu declares you the perfect  to deliver a missive to the people in charge of each endeavor. Apparently she is planning some sort of “joint venture,” and while neither she nor Wawkesa are forthcoming with details, they waste no time in sending you on your way, suggesting you stop first at Zirgorteh the Open-armed.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_SEQ_03: Your old friend Fahrafahr happily accepts the letter from the Turali Travel Agency, although something about her demeanor becomes decidedly coy after she begins reading it. She does not say why, but encourages you to visit with the snow spirits in Zirgorteh the Open-armed while she finishes reading the letter with Vuyargur. You traverse the passage up the mountains, where snow and playful creatures await.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_SEQ_04: You arrive in the snowy valley to see Nopli and Murfurlur standing before Ryoqor Terteh, who eagerly invites you to play. Before frolicking in the snow, however, you ponder the contents of Liplu's letter with those present. Is it a business proposal? Something else entirely? None can say for sure, and after Ryoqor Terteh becomes impatient with the conversation, you indulge the spirits in their snowy games. After an exhausting few bouts, Nopli suggests that you return to Shelter, that you might finally learn your purpose for coming to Urqopacha.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_SEQ_05: While it seems Fahrafahr has indeed read the letter in its entirety, she shares no new information other than that she would love to be a part of Liplu's plan. The nature of this plan yet remains elusive, but your first task is done. Now, you must deliver the second letter. You say good-bye to the towering peaks of Urqopacha and set forth to the thick canopies of Yak T'el.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_SEQ_06: Ruvoll Ja catches you up on recent developments within Gok Golma before you hand him the letter from Liplu. In a somewhat familiar turn of events, the Mamool Ja asks you to wait while he shares the contents of the letter with Anggir, and suggests you head to the kitchen and meet some familiar faces. There, you see Ty'at Roh, Bol Tst'ei, and Gotoll Ja deep in conversation about a new dish of Bol Tst'ei's creation. Your arrival sparks a discussion about food's role in the future of Mamook, and after sampling the dish, you regale the trio with stories of the myriad meals you have partaken in during your travels. After some time, Ruvoll Ja and Anggir finally join you, and it seems both are eager to help Liplu. Although you still know little about what her “plan” entails aside from the fact it may take place in Urqopacha, your duty is done, and you make the long trek back to Yak T'el to report to Liplu.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_SEQ_07: The industrious Pelu is overjoyed to hear that all parties have agreed to her proposal, and it seems she intends to rush headlong into the final stretch of preparations. Preparations for what, exactly, is as of yet a mystery to you, but it is plain that your participation is expected─and perhaps mandatory.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_SEQ_00: Liplu is never one to leave hard work unrewarded.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_SEQ_01: Liplu is grateful for your efforts and suggests that you lodge at the travel agency as reward. While you are waiting for your room to be made, you encounter a familiar pair: Fonjeantaine and Rediroq, who are in Yak T'el on a delivery. It seems the potsworn's work has been well received, much to the joy of the Moblin. Fonjeantaine thanks you for helping him find his confidence before saying his farewells, and as the two depart, Genuhanu arrives to show you to your lodgings.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_SEQ_02: Genuhanu seems almost starstruck as he expresses his pride in attending you. You take in the breathtaking scenery as you head to your lodgings, and yet another familiar voice calls out. It belongs to Tseeya, the Turali Travel Agency's first ever customer. Like the others before him, the worker from the Wing of Reflection has nothing but gratitude for your selfless contributions and seems certain that they will lead to a brighter Tural. After he takes his leave, you sit and ponder all the events that have led you to this moment, and then remember that Wawkesa wished to speak with you. You break from your reverie and head to the eatery to hear what the bandit-turned-chef has to say.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_SEQ_03: The diligent Wawkesa presents you with a hefty boxed meal as soon as you arrive, saying you are to bring it to Panaqpelu Retreat in Urqopacha, where Liplu awaits. Before you depart, however, the chef abashedly gives you his thanks for the mercy you showed him and his partners in crime after they kidnapped Wuk Lamat. Having said his piece, Wawkesa bids you farewell, and you set forth toward the hot springs of Panaqpelu Retreat.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_SEQ_04: Waiting for you at the hot springs is most everyone you have talked to throughout this mysterious odyssey. It seems this was all an elaborate plan to celebrate your efforts in revitalizing the various communities throughout Tural, and those present are eager to get to know you better. Food and drink are plenty, but before the party begins, Liplu suggests changing into something more fitting for the occasion.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_SEQ_05: The party kicks off with enough food and drink to feed a whole village, and its attendees regale each other with stories from their respective corners of Tural. A visit to the hot springs sees Ryoqor Terteh almost melt itself in the steaming waters, and a Pelu eater attempts to crash the festivities, but luckily disaster is averted in both cases. The party continues late into the night, with bonds being forged and horizons broadened. As the celebration winds down, you have a chat with Liplu, whose hard-but-secretive work brought this all together.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_SEQ_06: Liplu is happy that you had a chance to forget your responsibilities for even just a moment. However, all good things must come to an end, and before the party wraps up, you catch up with the other guests, starting with Ruvoll Ja.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_SEQ_07: Ruvoll Ja and Anggir are inspired to make Gok Golma into the pride of Mamook. In fact, they and Fahrafahr have a proposal for Liplu, and ask you to be there when they discuss it with the Pelu travel agent. In the meantime, you decide to catch up with Fahrafahr.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_SEQ_08: As with the others, Fahrafahr is optimistic about the future of her home, and it seems she is also eager to discuss the proposal with Liplu. Having spoken with everyone, you have one last chat with the host of the celebrations.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_SEQ_09: Liplu once again thanks you for coming to the party, and the rest of the guests express their mutual desire to bring the various disparate societies of Tural together as one. To that end, they decide to partner with the Turali Travel Agency to bring travelers and sightseers to their respective homes. While it remains to be seen what the future holds, the outlook has become just a little brighter thanks to food, drink, and hot springs.
